prompt: Follow-up channel chosen. You clarify whether an unresolved point should continue with the whole group or only the affected people.
idea: Survey everyone right to left, narrow the alternating attention to the affected people, then center in a right questioning tilt.

prompt: Final dissent recorded. You acknowledge a remaining disagreement accurately while allowing the group to proceed.
idea: Turns left to the final dissent, acknowledges it with one nod, then returns center and settles steadily for the group to proceed.

prompt: Demonstration blocked. You stop explaining when your own position prevents the listener from seeing the object.
idea: Looks down at the object, checks the listener left, turns head and body right to clear the view, then looks down-left back to the object and waits.

prompt: Pointer held too long. You realize your pointing gaze is still fixed on an old reference after the conversation has moved on.
idea: Holds the old reference left, freezes at the mismatch, returns through center, then selects the new right reference and nods.

prompt: Listener reaches early. You pause a demonstration because the listener starts handling the object before your setup is complete.
idea: Inspects the setup down, stops sharply at the early reach, looks left to the learner and waits, then restarts with a small controlled dip.

prompt: Listener reaches late. You keep the relevant object in view while waiting for someone to finish a delayed handoff.
idea: Indicates the near object down, looks right toward the partner, keeps a raised ready pose while waiting, then nods after the handoff.

prompt: Demonstration copied backward. You notice the learner reproducing the release before the preparation.
idea: Follows the learner's reversed motion down, stops and squares up, then draws back before a clear forward-down snap and recovers.

prompt: Demonstration copied literally. You clarify that a large teaching gesture should become a much smaller practical action.
idea: Draws back and demonstrates a broad downward snap, checks the imitation, inspects the actual target, then repeats only a small precise dip.

prompt: Teaching safe recovery. You show that returning to a stable pose is part of the task rather than an optional extra.
idea: Draws back before striking forward-down, pauses low, rises deliberately to balance, then nods to mark the recovery as part of the task.

prompt: Partner loses the count. You hold the current stage while helping someone recover which step comes next.
idea: Marks one counting beat, freezes briefly to preserve the stage, looks left toward the partner, then resumes one deliberate beat.

prompt: Partner repeats a step. You notice a completed action being attempted again and gently interrupt before it changes the result.
idea: Checks the finished result down-left, jolts upward at the repeated attempt, stops firmly, then points attention down to the completed state and confirms.

prompt: Partner skips a safety pause. You interrupt a rushed action to restore the missing inspection stage.
idea: Dips before reacting upward to the rush, braces low and still, inspects down-left, then releases the pause and nods readiness.

prompt: Showing both viewpoints. You demonstrate that a movement looks different from the learner's opposite side.
idea: Checks the learner's left-side view, turns head and body right to present the opposite angle, then returns together to a shared center.

prompt: Position before instruction. You wait until the listener has moved into a useful viewing position before continuing.
idea: Scans right to left for the listener, settles toward their new position on the right, waits, then returns down to the demonstration and nods.

prompt: Shared load timing. You coordinate taking weight together instead of letting one partner release too early.
idea: Checks the partner left, crouches into a load-bearing brace, waits for alignment, then rises under the shared weight and stabilizes centrally.

prompt: Release confirmation delayed. You keep holding your end because the receiving partner has not yet confirmed control.
idea: Strains under the held load, checks the receiver right, freezes the centered handoff briefly, then nods before releasing tension.

prompt: Object orientation handoff. You correct the orientation of an imaginary tool before presenting it to someone.
idea: Inspects the near tool, tilts left to check its end, straightens to verify, then turns right and makes a careful presenting dip.

prompt: Handoff path crosses. Two simultaneous exchanges cross in front of you and you pause one to prevent confusion.
idea: Follow the crossing handoffs left and right, stop centrally and wait for clearance, then lift and track the remaining exchange downward.

prompt: Recipient changes midhandoff. You redirect a prepared presentation when someone identifies a different intended receiver.
idea: Turns left and rises to present, halts at the changed recipient, returns center, then checks right and makes a careful delivery dip.

prompt: Empty handoff noticed. You realize that the object you were about to present is missing.
idea: Begins presenting down, freezes at the missing object, inspects the empty space, searches low right to left, then returns with a questioning tilt.

prompt: Fragile transfer wait. You let the receiver finish positioning before making a delicate final movement.
idea: Inspects close, steadies upright, checks the receiver left and waits, then makes a tiny final dip and relaxes centrally.

prompt: Two-part delivery. You distinguish giving the main item from providing its small matching piece afterward.
idea: Lifts before presenting the main item down, verifies receipt with a nod, looks down for its matching piece, then makes a smaller separate presentation.

prompt: Borrowed object returned. You indicate that an item belongs back in its original place rather than with you.
idea: Inspects the returned object, looks left to its proper place and nods there, then turns head and body right to clear the path.

prompt: Tool offered at wrong end. You pause an exchange to prevent presenting the awkward end of a tool first.
idea: Inspects the offered end, stops, tilts right, rotates head and body right to correct it, then returns squarely and verifies.

prompt: Lip view restored. You pause while a listener repositions to see your face clearly.
idea: Faces the listener squarely, stabilizes at eye level and waits for a clear lip view, then gives a small acknowledgment without turning away.

prompt: Caption reading catchup. You wait for someone to finish reading the displayed words before beginning another point.
idea: Indicates the display left, lowers centrally to the text, waits for reading to finish, then returns to the listener and nods.

prompt: Signing space respected. You move your attention out of the way so a partner's signing remains visible.
idea: Checks the signer left, turns head and body right to clear the signing space, holds still briefly, then returns together and acknowledges.

prompt: Tactile confirmation awaited. You hold a pose until a partner finishes checking a physical reference by touch.
idea: Inspects the tactile reference, braces low and completely still for the check, then acknowledges and rises only afterward.

prompt: Auditory cue repeated on request. You give one repeated cue after the listener signals that the first was missed.
idea: Offers a small cue beat, waits, tilts left to hear the repeat request, then gives one isolated nod and stops.

prompt: Visual cue held longer. You maintain an indicating pose so someone can locate it at their own pace.
idea: Selects the right reference, tilts right clearly toward it, holds the same target, then returns slowly to center.

prompt: Alternate channel chosen. You stop relying on a sound cue and use a visible head indication instead.
idea: Listens with alternating ear attention, waits for a response, checks the failed sound cue, then turns left and gives a visible target nod.

prompt: Slow response preserved. You avoid treating a long response delay as permission to interrupt.
idea: Rises ready to speak, lowers the bid, holds a receptive left tilt through the delay, then gives a restrained acknowledgment.

prompt: Movement cue simplified. You replace a complicated demonstration with one clearly separated directional action.
idea: Starts a complicated right-to-left scan, stops and resets, then draws back before one readable forward-down release and recovery.

prompt: Confirmation without speech. You recognize a partner's deliberate physical acknowledgment and stop asking the same question.
idea: Waits attentively, follows the partner's physical nod, gives one verifying nod, then releases into a relaxed neutral pose.

prompt: Display switched unnoticed. You gently redirect someone still looking at the previous screen location.
idea: Checks the old screen location left, returns to the listener, then indicates the new right location and holds until their attention follows.

prompt: Shared focus drifts. You notice both participants discussing the same item while looking at different nearby objects.
idea: Compares the left and right objects, pauses in a right tilt, returns down to one near reference, then lifts and confirms shared focus.

prompt: Demonstration shadow confusion. You realize the listener is following your shadow rather than the actual movement.
idea: Looks down at the shadow and freezes it, rises to the real action, then demonstrates one small controlled probe and returns level.

prompt: Reflected gesture confusion. A partner follows the mirror image of your gesture instead of its intended direction.
idea: Inspect the reflection below, compare its left and right views, then reset square and perk toward the actual reference.

prompt: Reference removed during speech. The object you are discussing is moved away before you finish explaining it.
idea: Tracks the reference from low to high as it departs, stops explaining, scans right to left, then perks centrally on reacquiring it and resumes with a nod.

prompt: New participant lacks reference. You briefly reestablish the physical object of discussion for someone joining late.
idea: Acknowledges the newcomer right with a nod, turns down to reestablish the object, pauses for inspection, then returns to group center.

prompt: Two meanings of here. You clarify whether a speaker means their own location or the shared object space.
idea: Checks the speaker left, checks the near workspace down, tilts right at the two meanings of here, then straightens and confirms the reference.

prompt: Remote delay check. You pause after a gesture to see whether a distant partner has received it.
idea: Gives a clear remote nod, holds still through the short delay, listens in a right tilt, then straightens for one final acknowledgment.

prompt: Instruction names wrong part. You stop a demonstration when the spoken label conflicts with the component being indicated.
idea: Inspects the indicated part, freezes at its wrong label, checks the speaker left in a right tilt, then returns down-left and verifies precisely.

prompt: Correction changes the start. You redo the preparation after learning that the initial position was wrong.
idea: Begins a probe, stops and fully resets, crouches into the corrected setup, then tries a controlled forward-down action and recovers.

prompt: Correction changes the finish. You retain the completed preparation but alter where the action should end.
idea: Coils backward, pauses for the changed finish, inspects the new target down, then releases gently toward it and holds the endpoint.

prompt: Sequence explained in reverse. You demonstrate a process backward to show how to undo it.
idea: Inspects the final low state, draws upward and backward through the reversed action, pauses, then returns to the earlier stable pose and verifies.

prompt: Recovery instruction prioritized. You interrupt discussion of the next step because the current pose is still unstable.
idea: Wobbles right then left, stops further action in a low brace, finds upright balance, then nods readiness to continue.

prompt: Error named without blame. You identify the failed action itself while keeping an open orientation toward the learner.
idea: Checks the failed result down-left, returns neutrally to the learner, makes one small corrective dip, then lifts and waits supportively.

prompt: Evidence requested before retry. You ask to inspect the previous result instead of immediately repeating the same action.
idea: Starts drawing back for a retry, stops, examines the previous result down-left, then holds a patient small right checking tilt.

prompt: Retry permission withdrawn. You pause a planned second attempt when the partner signals that the task should end.
idea: Regathers low for another attempt, freezes at the stop cue, releases the buildup, bows slightly, then returns neutral without retrying.

prompt: Success signal corrected. You retract an early completion nod after noticing an unfinished stage.
idea: Nods completion too early, freezes, checks the unfinished stage down-left, performs a small completing probe, then verifies afterward.

prompt: Cleanup explicitly included. You show that clearing the working area is the final stage of the interaction.
idea: Verifies the main result, scans the near surface right to left, makes a broader clearing sweep, then settles down-left and centers to finish.

prompt: Demonstration speed negotiated. You pause until the learner indicates a pace they can follow.
idea: Lifts before a quick downward probe, stops, tilts left to hear the pace request, then repeats a slower downward inspection and returns level.

prompt: Movement extent negotiated. You show a small range first and wait before extending farther.
idea: Probes a small range, returns and freezes for feedback, then stretches upward to the agreed extent and recovers balance.

prompt: Left-right frame negotiated. You establish whether directions refer to your body or the listener's viewpoint.
idea: Checks left and right frames, returns squarely, holds a right questioning tilt, then straightens and confirms the shared directions.

prompt: Stop gesture rehearsed. You practice halting immediately when a partner gives the agreed signal.
idea: Begins a controlled descent, stops sharply at the signal, braces motionless, then resets without another action.

prompt: Resume gesture rehearsed. You wait in a stopped pose until the agreed continuation signal arrives.
idea: Clamps low and still, waits for the cue, perks the ears, then resumes one small downward action and settles.

prompt: Completion gesture distinguished. You separate a temporary pause from the signal that the demonstration is finished.
idea: Pauses midway through a small dip, resumes the probe, returns neutral, then gives a distinct final nod and holds still.

prompt: Mirrored video established. You check whether a remote demonstration is mirrored before copying its directional movement.
idea: Checks left with a right tilt and compares right, freezes before copying, returns squarely, then confirms the remote reference frame.

prompt: Tool tip reference. You follow the end of a speaker's pointing tool instead of treating the tool itself as the object being discussed.
idea: Inspects the near pointer, follows its line upward and outward, fixes on the endpoint, then looks left to the speaker and confirms.

prompt: Rehearsal cue withheld. You recognize that a demonstrated start signal is part of an explanation rather than permission to begin.
idea: Perks at the demonstrated cue, starts drawing back, stops the preparation, listens in a left tilt, then returns without releasing the action.

prompt: Occluded gesture repeated. You repeat a single important gesture only after the listener's view becomes clear again.
idea: Makes a small beat, lifts at the blocked view and freezes, checks the listener right, then repeats one isolated nod and settles centrally.

prompt: Tennis lob. You follow a lob overhead then mime the descending smash.
idea: Tracks the lob from the right up overhead, draws back at its crest, then smashes forward-down and recovers centrally.

prompt: Table tennis rally. You track two low returns then drive a final shot.
idea: Track the low rally right-left-right in an even beat, draw back, then drive the final shot down and recover.

prompt: Basketball free throw. You sight the hoop then follow an imaginary release.
idea: Sights the hoop from a low gaze, sinks into a free-throw preparation, rises into the release, then follows the ball upward and settles.

prompt: Soccer header. You watch a high cross and meet it with your forehead.
idea: Watches the high cross left, crouches beneath it, springs upward with the head drawn back, then heads forward and recovers.

prompt: Volleyball block. You watch a setter then spring into a blocking pose.
idea: Tracks the setter right, centers and crouches, springs tall into the block, holds its crest, then lands low and rises balanced.

prompt: Badminton drop. You prepare an overhead stroke then soften its finish.
idea: Sights the shuttle high to the left, winds overhead, then softens into a small precise downward drop stroke and recovers.

prompt: Cricket cover drive. You watch the pitch and rotate through a low drive.
idea: Watches the pitch low to the right, coils the torso right, rises into the drive, sweeps the body left, then tracks the ball farther left and resets.

prompt: Baseball bunt. You square toward the pitcher and absorb contact.
idea: Turns the torso left and squares the head to the pitcher, leans into the bunt, absorbs contact with a small withdrawal, then settles low and resets.

prompt: Golf putt. You read a short putt then follow the rolling ball.
idea: Read the putt along right and left sightlines, draw back slightly, then stroke down and follow the rolling ball left before recovering.

prompt: Golf bunker shot. You settle low then lift through imaginary sand.
idea: Settles deep in the bunker, coils body and head right, then lifts sharply through the sand into a leftward high follow-through before resetting.

prompt: Archery release. You align sideways and hold before the arrow leaves.
idea: Aligns the body right and sights left, steadies drawn back, holds briefly, then releases with a tiny recoil and returns squarely.

prompt: Fencing lunge. You measure distance then make one sharp forward thrust.
idea: Measures distance with the head back, sinks into a compact crouch, draws back again, then lunges sharply forward-down and recovers.

prompt: Boxing slip. You duck under a hook then return through the center.
idea: Watches the hook to the left, crouches under it, slips into a left bank, passes low through center, then rises squarely.

prompt: Bowling delivery. You sight the lane and lean through a rolling release.
idea: Sights the lane low, rises into the approach, compresses for delivery, then extends through the rolling release and looks up after the ball.

prompt: Curling release. You slide low and follow the stone toward its target.
idea: Slides low into the curling release, sights the near stone, then follows its travel with a gradually lifting gaze before recovering upright.

prompt: Hockey slapshot. You wind back and drive through a puck.
idea: Coils head and torso right, draws the head up and back, snaps down through the puck, then turns left in follow-through and recovers.

prompt: Lacrosse pass. You wind across one shoulder then send a pass.
idea: Winds the torso right against a leftward gaze, brings the head high to the right, then sweeps left into the pass and tracks its raised path.

prompt: Rugby sidestep. You sell a run one way then cut across.
idea: Sells the run with a rightward look and body feint, snaps the gaze left, then cuts the torso left and drives onward before resetting.

prompt: Football snap. You crouch at the line and explode on the count.
idea: Crouches at the line, holds the count briefly still, explodes upward, then drives forward with short running bobs and settles.

prompt: Quarterback scan. You check two receivers then commit to a throw.
idea: Scan receivers right then left with the torso fixed, coil right against the chosen target, then throw left and recover square.

prompt: Sprint start. You wait in the blocks then drive forward.
idea: Crouches in the blocks and freezes briefly, gathers forward, then surges into running bobs before lifting into recovery.

prompt: Hurdle clearance. You approach a hurdle and lift cleanly over it.
idea: Approaches with rhythmic running bobs, compresses at the hurdle, springs to a high crest, then lands softly and straightens.

prompt: Long jump. You gather at the board then extend into landing.
idea: Gathers with short approach bobs, compresses at the board, extends upward into flight, then folds into a cushioned landing and recovers.

prompt: High jump. You curve toward the bar and arch across it.
idea: Curves right into the approach, compresses low, springs upward, arches back with a right tilt, turns left across the bar, then recovers.

prompt: Pole vault. You plant an imaginary pole then rise and rotate.
idea: Plants forward and low, compresses beneath the pole, rises in a long backward extension, then rotates left with the head counterturned right and settles.

prompt: Discus throw. You coil sideways and unroll through the release.
idea: Coils the torso right against a left gaze, gathers farther right, then unrolls left and tracks the discus high to the left before resetting.

prompt: Shot put. You gather under a heavy weight then drive upward.
idea: Gather the heavy shot looking left with a right tilt, brace low with a loaded tremble, then drive upward and straighten through the release.

prompt: Javelin throw. You draw back then cast toward a distant mark.
idea: Sights the distant mark high to the right, coils the body right against a left gaze, gathers forward, then casts left and tracks the flight.

prompt: Hammer throw. You circle under imaginary load then release.
idea: Coils right under the hammer, circles rhythmically through the torso, gathers back, then releases left and follows the rising weight before resetting.

prompt: Rowing catch. You reach forward then lean through one strong stroke.
idea: Reaches forward into the rowing catch, compresses low, pulls backward through one strong stroke, then returns forward and resets.

prompt: Kayak slalom. You lean around a gate then correct downstream.
idea: Leans forward into paddling, banks left and turns right through one gate, then banks right and turns left through the next before centering downstream.

prompt: Swimming breath. You mime a stroke cycle with one side breath.
idea: Lowers the face into a stroke rhythm, turns left and lifts for one breath, then returns centrally under the water before resetting.

prompt: Diving platform. You look below then commit to a tucked dive.
idea: Looks down from the platform, extends upward, compresses briefly before takeoff, then rises and folds into the tucked dive before recovering.

prompt: Water polo shot. You bob at the surface then rise to shoot.
idea: Bobs at the water surface, compresses below it, rises tall to shoot, then rotates left through the release and settles.

prompt: Surfboard pop-up. You rise from a low stance and settle onto a wave.
idea: Starts low on the board, gathers forward, pops upward, then settles into a left bank with small balancing rolls before recovering.

prompt: Skateboard ollie. You compress before a board lift and soft landing.
idea: Rolls in with a forward stance, compresses deeply, pops to a high ollie crest, then lands low and rises smoothly.

prompt: Skateboard kickturn. You shift weight back then turn on the rear wheels.
idea: Shifts weight back with an upward gaze, pivots the torso right on the rear wheels, looks farther right, then leans forward and returns squarely.

prompt: Snowboard carve. You sink into an edge and sweep across the slope.
idea: Sinks into the snowboard edge, banks left while turning the torso right, carries a low rightward gaze through the carve, then rises and centers.

prompt: Alpine slalom. You round two gates then straighten.
idea: Bank left around the first gate and right around the second, let the body swing across the turns, then straighten into the runout.

prompt: Ski jump. You hold a tucked run then extend into flight.
idea: Holds a tucked ski run, briefly still at the takeoff, then extends sharply into a high flight silhouette and recovers gradually.

prompt: Ice skating spin. You draw inward and rotate before opening out.
idea: Draws low and coils right, circles through a rhythmic torso spin, then turns left and opens upward before returning center.

prompt: Figure skating landing. You finish a rotation and absorb the landing.
idea: Finishes a leftward rotation high and drawn back, absorbs the landing low, banks left into balance, then straightens and holds the recovery.

prompt: Speed skating corner. You crouch and lean into an oval bend.
idea: Crouches into the corner, banks left with a right torso turn, drives through rhythmic skating pushes, then rises and centers.

prompt: Ballet skating glide. You trace a long edge and look over the shoulder.
idea: Glides tall, turns the torso right against a leftward shoulder look, extends the gaze farther left, then arcs the body left and returns center.

prompt: Cycling hill climb. You rock under load then crest the hill.
idea: Leans forward into the climb, lowers under load and rocks with pedaling effort, then pushes over the crest and lifts toward the horizon.

prompt: Cycling sprint. You duck low then drive in a short finishing surge.
idea: Ducks into a sprint tuck, drives in compact rhythmic bobs, gathers back briefly, then commits forward to the finish and recovers.

prompt: Mountain bike drop. You look over an edge then absorb the drop.
idea: Looks down over the drop, shifts back, absorbs the descent in a low forward fold, then rises and steadies.

prompt: Motorcycle corner. You spot an exit then bank through a curve.
idea: Spots the exit high to the left, banks right, turns the torso left through the motorcycle curve, then levels the head and unwinds the body.

prompt: Climbing reach. You study a high hold then stretch toward it.
idea: Studies the hold from low right, looks high, anchors into a crouch, then stretches tall and looks slightly left at the reached hold before resetting.

prompt: Bouldering dyno. You coil under a distant hold and spring upward.
idea: Sights the high hold slightly right, coils deeply and freezes, springs upward, then stabilizes beneath the caught hold and recovers.

prompt: Belaying partner. You follow a climber upward while taking in slack.
idea: Watches the climber high, makes repeated small downward slack checks, then returns to a steady upward watch.

prompt: Slackline balance. You correct two sways and recover the center.
idea: Leans left then right to correct slackline sways, damps the remaining rocking, then returns quietly upright.

prompt: Tightrope turn. You pause centered then carefully change facing.
idea: Balances centered, holds a brief still pause, turns the torso right and then carefully left with level gaze, then returns squarely.

prompt: Weightlifting clean. You brace low then pull a heavy load upward.
idea: Brace low beneath the bar with a loaded tremble, check the motion, pull sharply into a high catch, then steady and lower.

prompt: Weightlifting jerk. You dip briefly then lock into a tall finish.
idea: Sets the weight at shoulder height, dips to load, then drives sharply upward into a held jerk lockout and recovers.

prompt: Deadlift lockout. You rise against a heavy imaginary bar.
idea: Brace deeply with a tremble under the bar, rise against its weight, lock tall briefly, then lower in control.

prompt: Kettlebell swing. You hinge down then swing through upward.
idea: Hinges down into a kettlebell swing, drives back upward, repeats the pitch pendulum, then lets the motion settle centrally.

prompt: Battle ropes. You brace and drive two alternating waves.
idea: Braces low for the ropes, drives a left wave then a right wave, repeats the alternating rocking, then straightens.

prompt: Jump rope entry. You wait for the rope then join the rhythm.
idea: Waits for the jump-rope cue, dips to enter, then joins a low repeating bounce and lands softly.

prompt: Trampoline seat drop. You bounce high then drop and rebound.
idea: Builds trampoline bounce rhythm, compresses for a high crest, drops into a deep seat landing, then rebounds and settles.

prompt: Gymnastics salute. You finish a tumbling pass and present upright.
idea: Finishes a leftward tumbling turn, absorbs the landing low, then rises squarely into a clean gymnastics salute and holds it.

prompt: Pommel rhythm. You circle around an imagined support.
idea: Coils right over the pommel support, circles through rhythmic torso motion, turns left and looks farther left, then opens and settles squarely.

prompt: Balance beam dismount. You sight the landing then spring off.
idea: Sights the beam landing down, holds narrow balance, compresses and springs into a leftward turn, then cushions the dismount and recovers.

prompt: Rhythmic ribbon. You trace a ribbon spiral then gather it.
idea: Trace the ribbon low-right into a wider loop, flutter its raised arc toward the left, then gather it low-left and center.

prompt: Trapeze catch. You watch a swinging partner and meet the catch.
idea: Track the trapeze partner's right-to-left swing, dip beneath the approach, then reach tall for the catch and steady.

prompt: Dart throw. You sight a tiny target then release once.
idea: Sights the tiny dart target high, holds its alignment, draws back slightly, then gives one compact forward release and recovers.

prompt: Billiards break. You lower onto the cue line then strike.
idea: Lowers onto the billiards cue line, holds the aim, draws back, then breaks forward with one decisive pulse and recovers.

prompt: Snooker cushion read. You follow a bank angle before settling to aim.
idea: Checks the low right cue line and far-left bank point, compares the low left line and far-right rebound, then centers in a still aiming pose.

prompt: Air hockey save. You track a puck then block it at the edge.
idea: Track the low puck right and left in a quick sweep, extend farther left to block at the edge, stop sharply, then return centrally.

prompt: Foosball shot. You scan the lane and snap a compact strike.
idea: Check the low foosball lane right and left, coil the body right, then flick left through the shot and reset.

prompt: Squash corner retrieval. You turn low into a back corner then recover.
idea: Turns low toward the right back corner, coils the torso right, digs deeper, then reverses the body left and recovers squarely.

prompt: Racquetball ceiling shot. You look up and send the rebound high.
idea: Looks up toward the ceiling target, coils low with the torso right, then drives upward and turns left through the high shot before resetting.

prompt: Pickleball dink. You lean toward the net and soften a short return.
idea: Leans toward the net, makes a small backward preparation, then returns one gentle forward dink and settles without a large recoil.

prompt: Paddleboard stroke. You look ahead then hinge through a paddle pull.
idea: Looks ahead, turns the torso right, hinges through one paddle pull, then rises back into tall centered balance.

prompt: Sailing tack. You watch the wind and duck beneath the boom.
idea: Checks the wind high to the right, looks left, then ducks low beneath the boom while turning the body left and emerges centered.

prompt: Windsurf gust. You lean against a sudden pull and regain balance.
idea: Leans back-right against the gust, counters with a rightward body twist and left gaze, holds the load, then eases back through small balance corrections.

prompt: Kitesurf launch. You follow the kite overhead and brace under pull.
idea: Tracks the kite overhead from right to left, braces low, then leans backward with a right bank under the pull before recovering.

prompt: Scuba descent. You equalize then sink while watching the seabed.
idea: Equalize with a slow left-right head tilt, center, then descend gradually while watching the seabed below.

prompt: Snorkel surface. You lift from underwater viewing to check the horizon.
idea: Looks down underwater, lifts through the surface, scans the horizon right to left, then centers and settles.

prompt: Freedive turn. You reach a depth marker and reverse orientation.
idea: Reaches the depth marker with a low gaze, pauses, then rises through a leftward body turn and returns squarely.

prompt: Parachute landing. You check below then brace for contact.
idea: Checks the ground below, shifts back to brace, then cushions parachute contact in a deep compact landing and recovers.

prompt: Hang glider flare. You watch the landing zone and raise the nose.
idea: Watches the landing zone low and forward, gathers beneath it, then gradually raises the glider's nose into a long upward flare and settles.

prompt: Paragliding check. You scan the canopy then both landing approaches.
idea: Inspect the canopy high from right to left, then scan the two landing approaches in the same order and center.

prompt: Equestrian jump. You follow the horse over an obstacle.
idea: Follows the horse's approach in gentle bobs, folds forward before the obstacle, rises over it, then absorbs the landing and straightens.

prompt: Dressage halt. You move in a measured cadence then stop square.
idea: Moves in a measured dressage cadence, shortens the bounce, then stops squarely and holds the halt before relaxing.

prompt: Polo swing. You track the ball beside you then rotate through it.
idea: Tracks the polo ball low to the left, winds the torso left, then swings through to the right and follows the outgoing ball rightward before resetting.

prompt: Roller derby block. You brace sideways and absorb a shoulder bump.
idea: Braces with a leftward torso angle, leans right into contact, rebounds left, then damps the rocking and centers.

prompt: Parkour vault. You sight a barrier and pass over it.
idea: Sights the barrier, gathers in low approach bobs, compresses, then vaults tall with a leftward turn and lands softly.

prompt: Parkour wall run. You look up a wall then push away at the crest.
idea: Looks up the wall, compresses into the approach, drives upward with short running bobs, then pushes back in a right bank and recovers.

prompt: Obstacle crawl. You duck beneath a low bar and creep through.
idea: Ducks beneath the bar, creeps in compact low bobs while checking right then left, then returns center still crouched before rising clear.

prompt: Rope climb. You look to the next grip and pull upward twice.
idea: Look high for a rope grip, reset low, climb with two upward heaves, then steady at the new height.

prompt: Tug of war. You brace backward and pull in two heaves.
idea: Brace backward with a right tilt, make two rhythmic loaded heaves, then let the pull go and regain a stable center.

prompt: Wrestling sprawl. You drop away from a low grab and square again.
idea: Prepares upright, drops low away from the grab with a rightward torso turn, holds the sprawl, then squares and rises in control.

prompt: Judo bow. You bow before stepping into a ready stance.
idea: Centers respectfully, bows deliberately down, rises from the judo bow, then settles low into a ready stance.

prompt: Karate kata. You set a stance then deliver a measured turning strike.
idea: Sets a low kata stance, coils the torso right and holds, then snaps left into the strike and recovers deliberately.

prompt: Tai chi cloud hands. You mime a slow transfer through alternating torso arcs.
idea: Transfer through a right torso arc and level center, continue into a slow left-right flow, then settle centered.

prompt: Capoeira dodge. You dip under a sweeping kick then rise diagonally.
idea: Dips low into a left bank under the kick, crosses through center into a right bank, then opens upward with a left torso turn and recovers.

prompt: Ultimate catch. You follow a floating disc and meet it overhead.
idea: Tracks the floating disc from right toward high left, dips underneath, then rises into an overhead catch and steadies centrally.

prompt: Handball penalty. You pause at the mark then rotate into a shot.
idea: Aligns at the penalty mark, coils right and pauses still, then turns left through a compact handball shot and resets.

prompt: Netball pivot. You land with the ball and survey before passing.
idea: Absorbs the netball landing, stops the feet, scans right, then pivots the body left into a pass and returns squarely.

prompt: Sepak takraw watch. You track an overhead kick and follow the ball.
idea: Tracks the overhead kick from right to left, lifts through contact, then follows the ball's high leftward arc and returns center.

prompt: Soup tasting. You cool a spoonful before tasting.
idea: Lowers toward the hot spoon, draws back to cool it, gives gentle cooling breaths, then dips for a taste and recovers.

prompt: Dough kneading. You press and fold a stubborn ball of dough.
idea: Rises before kneading, presses the dough down, repeats the press-and-release rhythm, then eases upright as it softens.

prompt: Egg cracking. You tap an egg twice then inspect the split.
idea: Draws back above the egg, gives two short tapping beats, then inspects the split low from right to left and centers.

prompt: Pancake flipping. You lift the pan and catch a tumbling pancake.
idea: Dips to preload the pan, rises sharply with the pancake toss, tracks the tumbling crest, then cushions the catch downward and recovers.

prompt: Pepper grinding. You twist a mill over a plate.
idea: Lowers toward the plate, twists the pepper mill right then left, continues a steady turning rhythm, then centers to inspect the seasoning.

prompt: Salad tossing. You lift leaves and let them fall into the bowl.
idea: Looks into the salad bowl, lifts with the leaves, repeats the rising and falling toss rhythm, then returns to inspect the bowl.

prompt: Onion chopping. You make three deliberate cuts along a board.
idea: Lift above the onion, chop in a measured rhythm across the board from right to left, then withdraw from the final cut.

prompt: Bread slicing. You saw through a resistant crust.
idea: Lowers to the bread crust, saws right and left with short repeated strokes, then sinks through the cut and lifts to inspect.

prompt: Butter spreading. You sweep across toast then inspect an uncovered corner.
idea: Sweeps butter from low right to low left, checks a farther left edge, then returns to the uncovered right corner and finishes centrally.

prompt: Coffee pouring. You follow the stream into a cup then stop at the rim.
idea: Looks into the cup, follows the coffee stream gradually downward, stops at the rim, then lifts cleanly and settles.

prompt: Tea steeping. You watch a tea bag dip and wait for color.
idea: Lowers to the tea, follows two dipping nods, then holds a quiet downward watch for the color before easing back.

prompt: Whisking cream. You work a bowl then pause to check the peaks.
idea: Works the cream with a low rhythmic torso motion, stops to inspect, then lifts the whisk and gaze to check the peaks.

prompt: Rolling pastry. You push dough away and draw it back.
idea: Presses pastry away with a forward-down lean, lifts on the return, repeats the rolling rhythm, then relaxes to inspect the sheet.

prompt: Pizza stretching. You follow dough widening then rotating.
idea: Check the widening dough low right and left, rotate the torso beneath it in a right-left rhythm, then return centered.

prompt: Pizza tossing. You send dough overhead and catch it flat.
idea: Crouches with the pizza dough, tosses it high, follows its spin with a small torso rhythm, then cushions the flat catch and resets.

prompt: Pie crimping. You work around a pie rim with small presses.
idea: Works the pie rim with small crimping nods on the right, advances left for another set, then checks the completed seam centrally.

prompt: Cake frosting. You circle a cake then smooth the top.
idea: Circles the cake with a rightward torso turn and rhythmic rotation, turns left, then sweeps the low gaze right to left across the smooth top and resets.

prompt: Candle placement. You align a tiny candle vertically in icing.
idea: Lowers toward the candle with a left tilt to judge its angle, steadies for placement, then returns upright and checks the alignment.

prompt: Caramel watching. You lean over a pan and pull away from rising steam.
idea: Leans slowly down over the caramel, pauses to watch, then recoils up and back with a right tilt from the steam and recovers.

prompt: Popcorn lid. You hold a lid steady through a burst then inspect.
idea: Braces low over the popcorn lid, trembles through the burst, then releases the vibration and lifts cautiously to inspect.

prompt: Blender pulse. You brace for two noisy pulses then check the mixture.
idea: Braces over the blender, rides one brief vibration pulse, pauses, rides a second, then inspects the mixture quietly.

prompt: Mortar grinding. You press spices in a circular motion.
idea: Presses into the mortar low-right, grinds through rhythmic torso turns, follows the circle left, then lifts to inspect the spices.

prompt: Garlic crushing. You load pressure then break through a clove.
idea: Aligns over the garlic, lifts to load pressure, then snaps firmly down through the clove and releases into recovery.

prompt: Lemon squeezing. You press a lemon then give one final effort.
idea: Raises slightly above the lemon, compresses into a squeeze, recovers, then gives one stronger final press and relaxes.

prompt: Orange peeling. You follow a peel spiral downward.
idea: Follows the peel from the right across to the left, turns the torso left while lowering through the spiral, then returns center to inspect.

prompt: Apple coring. You align a corer then push straight through.
idea: Aligns the corer high and centered, steadies it, pushes straight downward through the apple, then releases and returns upright.

prompt: Potato peeling. You repeat short scraping passes along a potato.
idea: Makes short repeated peeling strokes with shallow nods, then turns left to inspect the potato and returns center.

prompt: Carrot grating. You run a carrot down a grater in two passes.
idea: Raise the carrot, grate downward through two measured passes, finish low, then lift away from the grater.

prompt: Cheese slicing. You watch a wire descend through soft cheese.
idea: Watches the cheese wire descend steadily, pauses at the cut, then turns left to inspect the slice and centers.

prompt: Jar opening. You brace and twist against a stuck lid then try again.
idea: Brace the jar and twist right to left against the lid, stop at resistance, then reset farther right and retry left before releasing.

prompt: Bottle uncorking. You pull against a cork then catch the sudden release.
idea: Leans backward with a right tilt against the cork, tightens the pull and freezes briefly, then recoils sharply upward at release and recovers.

prompt: Can opener. You trace the rim then lift the freed lid.
idea: Traces the can rim low-right, turns through a small cutting rhythm, follows the rim left, then lifts the freed lid cautiously and centers.

prompt: Sieve shaking. You shake flour over a bowl then tap the residue.
idea: Shakes the sieve side to side over the bowl, draws back for the residue, then gives one final downward tap and recovers.

prompt: Flour weighing. You add a little flour then lean close to the scale.
idea: Inspects the scale low, lifts to add a small amount, dips to pour, then leans close and freezes briefly at the reading.

prompt: Rice rinsing. You swirl a bowl then tip away cloudy water.
idea: Swirls the rice bowl with low torso rhythm, tips into a right roll to drain, then looks left to check the water and resets.

prompt: Rice fluffing. You lift grains lightly then inspect the surface.
idea: Looks down into the rice, lifts and releases the grains in light repeated nods, then inspects the fluffed surface and settles.

prompt: Pasta draining. You lift a heavy pot then tip it carefully.
idea: Brace beneath the pasta pot with a loaded tremble, rise and tip right into a controlled pour, then straighten and lower it.

prompt: Noodle slurping. You draw a long noodle upward and finish with a tiny nod.
idea: Lowers toward the noodle, draws it upward in a long steady lift, finishes with a tiny nod, then settles.

prompt: Spaghetti twirling. You follow pasta winding around a fork.
idea: Follows the fork low-right, twirls the pasta with a small torso rhythm, brings it left and upward to mouth height, then pauses and resets.

prompt: Sushi rolling. You fold a mat forward then check its seam.
idea: Leans into the sushi mat and presses forward-down, then checks the seam low from right to left and returns upright.

prompt: Dumpling sealing. You pinch a seam across a dumpling then examine it.
idea: Pinches the dumpling seam with small nodding beats on the right, moves left for the final pinches, then centers to examine the seal.

prompt: Spring roll. You fold the sides inward then roll forward.
idea: Check the spring-roll sides right and left, gather attention inward, then fold forward-down and release to inspect.

prompt: Skewer threading. You line up ingredients along a skewer.
idea: Tilts left to sight along the skewer, steadies the alignment, makes repeated short threading dips, then straightens to inspect.

prompt: Kebab turning. You rotate skewers and check their underside.
idea: Turns the skewer right, inspects its underside with a low right tilt, then rotates left and returns centrally to check the cooking.

prompt: Steak searing. You place a steak then draw away from the hot pan.
idea: Lowers the steak into the hot pan, then draws sharply up and back with a right tilt from the heat and recovers.

prompt: Steak resting. You inspect a cooked steak without disturbing it.
idea: Looks from above down beside the resting steak on the right, holds a quiet watch without disturbing it, then returns slowly to center.

prompt: Fish filleting. You trace a careful cut along an imaginary backbone.
idea: Lowers to the backbone, sights farther right, follows one uninterrupted cutting line to the left, then inspects the near-left end and centers.

prompt: Fish deboning. You spot a small bone then pull it free.
idea: Tilts left over the fish to spot a bone, steadies close, then lifts along a short extraction path and returns upright.

prompt: Oyster shucking. You brace a shell and twist until it yields.
idea: Brace low at the shell, coil right with a strained shiver, then twist left as it yields upward and recover.

prompt: Mussel sorting. You inspect a shell then place it in another pile.
idea: Inspect the mussel in left-right tilts, turn the torso right to place it in the discard pile, then return square.

prompt: Shrimp peeling. You remove a shell in sections then inspect the tail.
idea: Works through three small shell-removal dips, shifts from right to left, then checks the shrimp tail with a low right tilt and resets.

prompt: Squid scoring. You make crossing shallow cuts across a surface.
idea: Scores the squid along a low right-to-left diagonal, extends to the far left, then traces the opposing diagonal rightward and centers.

prompt: Mushroom brushing. You sweep dirt off a cap without pressing hard.
idea: Lowers toward the mushroom, brushes lightly from right through center to left, repeats small lateral strokes, then lifts to inspect.

prompt: Herb chopping. You gather leaves and cut them with rocking motions.
idea: Gathers herbs with low right and left looks, centers into a rocking chopping rhythm, then stops to inspect the pile.

prompt: Basil tearing. You separate a leaf and scatter the pieces.
idea: Turns the torso right then left to tear the basil, returns centrally, then scatters the pieces with light repeated downward dips.

prompt: Rosemary stripping. You pull leaves down a stem in one stroke.
idea: Sights upward along the rosemary stem, steadies, then follows one continuous downward stripping stroke and lifts to check the leaves.

prompt: Chili deseeding. You open a pepper and look into its cavity.
idea: Open the chili with a right-left torso twist, inspect its cavity in a low left tilt, then return upright centrally.

prompt: Avocado twist. You rotate the halves apart then examine the pit.
idea: Twist the avocado halves right and left, focus down on the pit, pause at the revealed center, then release the torso.

prompt: Melon scooping. You dig into a melon then lift a round portion.
idea: Looks into the melon low-right, digs deeper, then lifts the round scoop up and left and returns center.

prompt: Berry sorting. You separate crushed berries from a tray.
idea: Inspect berries low-right and transfer one far-left, return for a second sorting beat, then repeat the discard and settle.

prompt: Grape washing. You swirl a bunch under water then shake it dry.
idea: Swirls the grapes low with gentle torso rhythm, lifts them out of the water, shakes them lightly side to side, then settles centrally.

prompt: Banana splitting. You open the peel and separate its sections.
idea: Looks high at the banana, lowers as one peel section spreads right, returns through center and opens the other left, then settles.

prompt: Pineapple trimming. You cut away the top then follow the side.
idea: Sights the pineapple top high-left, draws back before a downward trimming cut, then follows the side in a long low inspection and centers.

prompt: Coconut tapping. You tap around a shell before it splits.
idea: Turns right around the coconut, taps in a short rhythm, rotates left for another set, then centers to inspect the split.

prompt: Nut cracking. You squeeze until the shell suddenly gives.
idea: Compress the nutshell with a fine strained tremble, pause at the limit, then recoil upward at the break and inspect below.

prompt: Sesame toasting. You swirl seeds in a pan and inspect the color.
idea: Swirls the sesame pan with a level torso rhythm, stops the motion, then lowers close to inspect the toasted color and resets.

prompt: Coffee bean smelling. You bring beans close and take a quiet sniff.
idea: Lowers toward the coffee beans, draws a quiet sniff with a slight lift, then stills to attend to the aroma before relaxing.

prompt: Tea leaf measuring. You tip a small scoop and check the amount.
idea: Inspects the measured leaves low, rolls right into a small scoop pour, then returns level and checks the amount.

prompt: Espresso tamping. You align a tamper and press evenly.
idea: Aligns the espresso tamper, rises centered, presses evenly straight down, then releases and checks the level puck.

prompt: Milk steaming. You lower a pitcher then lift it as foam develops.
idea: Watches the pitcher low-left, maintains a right tilt as the foam rises, then gradually lifts and straightens to finish steaming.

prompt: Latte art. You pour a small pattern then draw through its center.
idea: Tilts right over the cup, pours a gentle side-to-side latte pattern, then draws one forward line through its center and lifts cleanly.

prompt: Cocktail shaking. You shake above one shoulder then strain low.
idea: Raises the shaker over the right shoulder, shakes in a brisk torso rhythm, then lowers into a held rightward strain and centers.

prompt: Cocktail stirring. You circle slowly inside a tall glass.
idea: Looks into the glass low-right, stirs with a restrained torso rhythm, follows the circle left, then centers and lifts slightly.

prompt: Ice scooping. You dip into an ice bin and lift to a glass.
idea: Dips deeply into the ice bin, lifts left toward the glass, tips right to pour, then straightens and settles.

prompt: Juice pressing. You load a fruit press and lean into the final squeeze.
idea: Lifts to load the fruit press, steadies, then leans downward under sustained pressure and releases gradually.

prompt: Waffle opening. You lift a hot lid and inspect the waffle.
idea: Follows the hot waffle lid upward, then lowers in a left tilt to inspect beneath it before straightening.

prompt: Toast popping. You wait by the toaster and track the sudden rise.
idea: Waits low by the toaster, holds briefly still, snaps the gaze upward with the popping toast, then returns down to the slot and resets.

prompt: Oven peeking. You duck to look through an oven window.
idea: Sinks to the oven window, tilts left for a clearer angle, holds the close view, then straightens and rises.

prompt: Tray extraction. You brace for a hot tray and draw it out level.
idea: Braces low for the hot tray, extends forward to take it, then withdraws steadily without rolling and settles level.

prompt: Broiler check. You look beneath a hot upper element then withdraw.
idea: Raises a left-tilted gaze under the broiler, pauses to inspect, then lowers and retreats cautiously before centering.

prompt: Pressure valve. You watch a valve release and lean away from steam.
idea: Watches the valve high-left, recoils backward into a right tilt as steam releases, waits, then checks farther left and centers.

prompt: Lid condensation. You lift a lid and tip drips back into a pot.
idea: Lifts with the lid, lowers the gaze and rolls right to return condensation, checks the drips leftward, then straightens and centers.

prompt: Boil-over rescue. You notice foam rising and lift the pot away.
idea: Watches the foam low, follows it rising, dips to brace the pot, then lifts and turns it decisively left before recovering.

prompt: Burnt toast scrape. You scrape a crust then inspect the cleaned patch.
idea: Makes two shallow scraping passes over the burnt toast, then leans into a close left tilt to inspect the cleaned patch and resets.

prompt: Overmixed batter. You stop vigorous mixing and inspect its texture.
idea: Mixes the batter vigorously with low torso rhythm, stops sharply, then leans down-left for a slow texture check and resets.

prompt: Stuck cake release. You tilt a pan and tap twice before the cake drops.
idea: Tilts the pan right into inversion, holds it, taps twice, then drops the gaze into a low catch as the cake releases and recovers.

prompt: Broken yolk rescue. You notice a yolk break and separate the spill.
idea: Watches the yolk closely down, checks its break, then shifts left with a quick body catch and returns centrally to inspect the spill.

prompt: Spilled flour sweep. You gather flour from both edges into the center.
idea: Sweep flour inward from the right and then the left, make a small gathering sweep at center, then lower and reset.

prompt: Dropped spoon retrieval. You track a fallen spoon and bend to retrieve it.
idea: Lifts at the falling spoon, snaps the gaze downward after it, bends lower to retrieve it, then rises with the object and settles.

prompt: Recipe page turn. You finish reading a line then turn to the next page.
idea: Reads the line low from right to left, turns the torso left with the page, resets the gaze far right, then centers over the next passage.

prompt: Timer setting. You turn a dial precisely then wait for its start.
idea: Tilt left to read the timer, turn its setting right and left, then square up and wait still for the start.

prompt: Temperature probing. You insert a probe then lean in to read it.
idea: Draws back to align the temperature probe, places it forward-down, stops, then leans close with a level head to read it and recovers.

prompt: Kitchen scale tare. You place a bowl then pause for the scale to settle.
idea: Lifts the bowl, lowers it onto the scale, then holds a motionless close watch while the reading settles before recovering.

prompt: Measuring cup meniscus. You lower to eye level and inspect the liquid line.
idea: Sinks to liquid eye level without pitching, tilts left toward the meniscus, holds the line, then returns upright and rises.

prompt: Funnel pouring. You align a stream with a narrow opening.
idea: Centers the low gaze on the funnel opening, rolls right into a careful pour, holds alignment, then recovers upright.

prompt: Food plating. You place a main item then inspect the plate from both sides.
idea: Prepare the main item above the plate and place it down, inspect the dish right and left, then center and lift.

prompt: Sauce drizzle. You draw a thin line across a plate then stop cleanly.
idea: Sets the drizzle low-right, travels steadily from far right through center to far left, then lifts at the endpoint and returns centrally.

prompt: Garnish placement. You set one delicate leaf atop a dish.
idea: Raises the delicate garnish above the dish, aligns it, then makes a tiny controlled downward placement and withdraws gently.

prompt: Serving dome. You lift a cover to reveal a dish.
idea: Lifts the serving cover in a slow upward reveal, holds the crest, then dips toward the dish and returns invitingly upright.

prompt: Orchestra upbeat. You prepare a group for the first note.
idea: Rises backward into an orchestral upbeat, suspends the cue, then snaps forward-down for the first note and recovers into timekeeping.

prompt: Fermata release. You hold a sustained note then cut it off.
idea: Holds the fermata tall and briefly still, draws back a little for the release, then closes downward compactly and lets the motion settle.

prompt: Crescendo cue. You invite a phrase to grow before its peak.
idea: Begins the crescendo low, grows through widening beat motion and rising height, reaches one bright crest, then settles.

prompt: Decrescendo cue. You guide a phrase into silence.
idea: Guides a raised phrase with broad nodding beats, narrows the beat and lowers gently, then sinks into a quiet low ending.

prompt: Meter change. You switch from a broad three-beat feel to square accents.
idea: Sways broadly through a three-beat feel, halts at the meter change, then gives separate square vertical beats and settles.

prompt: Offbeat entrance. You wait through the main beat then cue between beats.
idea: Marks the main beat with a nod, waits through its space, draws back, then gives the delayed short offbeat cue and recovers.

prompt: Choir breath. You take a visible preparatory breath before singing.
idea: Rises into a visible choir breath with open ears, suspends it briefly, then eases forward into a gently pulsing sung phrase.

prompt: Choir cutoff. You end a long phrase together.
idea: Holds the choir phrase raised, pauses briefly still, gives a small backward preparation and downward cutoff, then rests.

prompt: Soloist handoff. You finish your phrase and direct attention to a soloist.
idea: Carries the phrase with measured forward beats, finishes it, then turns the gaze and body left toward the soloist and waits.

prompt: Page turn rest. You use a musical rest to check the next score page.
idea: Reads the score low-right during the rest, turns left to the next page, returns center and prepares back, then cues the next beat down.

prompt: Violin downbow. You lean into a long downward bow stroke.
idea: Raises into a high right-side downbow preparation, then draws diagonally down across the torso to the left and releases the phrase centrally.

prompt: Violin pizzicato. You pluck two separated notes and let them ring.
idea: Draw back for one light pizzicato pluck and let it ring, then reset for a second separated pluck and settle.

prompt: Cello phrase. You draw a slow resonant phrase across the strings.
idea: Settles low over the cello, draws a broad right-to-left torso phrase, lets it resonate, then returns through a gentle sway and centers.

prompt: Double bass pulse. You mark a walking bass line with grounded dips.
idea: Sets a grounded bass stance, marks a walking line with weighted repeated dips, then rises gently at the phrase ending.

prompt: Harp glissando. You follow a sweep from low strings to high strings.
idea: Begins at low right harp strings, sweeps through center to the high left register, lets the glissando bloom, then settles centrally.

prompt: Piano arpeggio. You follow notes climbing across a keyboard.
idea: Follows the arpeggio from far right through low intermediate notes to the far left, lifts at the peak, then resolves centrally.

prompt: Piano bass leap. You jump from a high register to a low accent.
idea: Looks to the high register left, draws back, then leaps across into a forceful low-right bass accent and recovers.

prompt: Piano pedal release. You hold a chord then let its resonance fade.
idea: Holds the piano chord tall and still, then slowly lowers as the pedal releases its resonance into a low quiet rest.

prompt: Organ swell. You build a sustained chord under a vaulted ceiling.
idea: Begins the organ chord low, builds through a slow rising pulse, then opens into a broad sustained extension and eases back.

prompt: Accordion bellows. You open and close an imaginary instrument with the phrase.
idea: Opens accordion bellows with broad right and left torso turns, continues the measured in-and-out rhythm, then gathers right and closes centrally.

prompt: Concertina squeeze. You compress a short phrase then reopen gently.
idea: Compresses the concertina with a leftward torso turn and dip, then opens right while rising and returns gently to center.

prompt: Trumpet attack. You prepare air and deliver a bright held note.
idea: Takes a backward trumpet breath, suspends it, releases forward into a bright note, then sustains high with a gentle phrase pulse and settles.

prompt: Trombone slide. You follow a slide extending and returning.
idea: Reach into the long trombone slide and withdraw, repeat the extension in a shorter rhythmic phrase, then settle level.

prompt: French horn entry. You prepare quietly and sustain a rounded phrase.
idea: Takes a small upward horn breath, eases into a rounded right-tilted phrase, sustains it gently, then centers.

prompt: Tuba pulse. You support a low heavy rhythmic line.
idea: Braces for the tuba line, carries its weight in slow deep nodding pulses, then rises to a modest phrase ending and rests.

prompt: Flute run. You trace a light phrase that rises then falls.
idea: Lifts the flute phrase high-right, ripples lightly through its run, arcs high-left, then descends to center with the melody.

prompt: Clarinet break. You cross from a low register into a high note.
idea: Sustains the clarinet phrase low with small beat motion, pauses at the register break, then lifts suddenly into the high note and settles.

prompt: Oboe sustain. You hold a narrow steady tone through a long phrase.
idea: Center into the narrow oboe tone, breathe steadily beneath the sustained phrase, then release the breath and return level.

prompt: Bassoon bounce. You mark a dry staccato bass figure.
idea: Sets the bassoon low, marks dry separated staccato nods, then releases the final note upward and settles.

prompt: Saxophone bend. You lean into a note and bend it downward.
idea: Leans high into the sax note with a right tilt, adds a gentle phrase pulse, then bends the pitch down as the roll centers and recovers.

prompt: Recorder articulation. You shape three light notes with distinct starts.
idea: Prepares lightly, articulates three recorder notes with distinct forward nodding starts, then lifts out of the phrase and settles.

prompt: Panpipe sweep. You move across a row of tubes.
idea: Steps the panpipe gaze from right through center to left, turns the torso left with the final tube, then returns level centrally.

prompt: Bagpipe march. You maintain a drone while marking the walking beat.
idea: Stands tall over the bagpipe drone, marks a steady marching pulse, then shortens the cadence into a measured halt.

prompt: Harmonica draw. You draw inward then push a phrase outward.
idea: Draws inward with a backward harmonica breath, then leans forward to push the phrase out with small rhythmic pulses before resetting.

prompt: Didgeridoo drone. You sustain low airflow with a circular-breathing pause.
idea: Settles low into the drone, sustains a small breathing pulse, briefly rises for circular breathing, then resumes the low tone and releases.

prompt: Kazoo entrance. You wait for a cue then join with a playful buzz.
idea: Listens left and briefly stills for the cue, centers with a backward breath, then joins with playful forward buzzing beats and settles.

prompt: Whistle trill. You raise your head for a thin sustained whistle.
idea: Raises the head for a thin whistle, holds poised, carries a tiny pitch trill, then lowers gently out of the note.

prompt: Ocarina phrase. You follow a rounded rise and fall in melody.
idea: Starts the ocarina melody low, opens upward through its rounded phrase, sways gently at the crest, then folds down and resolves.

prompt: Guitar strum. You wind back and sweep across the strings.
idea: Winds the guitar stroke right and back, sweeps left and downward across the strings, rebounds lightly, then settles with the resonance.

prompt: Guitar fingerpicking. You watch a delicate repeating pattern then finish one bass note.
idea: Watches the delicate fingerpicking low with tiny repeating beats, draws back at the last bass note, then gives one weighted dip and releases.

prompt: Bass guitar slide. You follow a note sliding up the neck.
idea: Follows the bass slide from low far-right upward along the neck, checks farther right again, then fixes the target near-right before resetting.

prompt: Ukulele upbeat. You make two light upward strums.
idea: Set low for two light ukulele upbeats, lift and reset in their rhythm, then soften the last strum into rest.

prompt: Banjo roll. You ride a rolling figure and stop on a final accent.
idea: Rides the banjo roll with a compact torso rhythm, gathers back at its end, then stops on one centered downward accent and recovers.

prompt: Mandolin chop. You deliver a short muted chord after a rest.
idea: Waits raised through the rest, draws back to prepare the chop, then closes a short muted mandolin chord with a crisp downward beat and settles.

prompt: Sitar meend. You bend a note slowly beyond its starting pitch.
idea: Leans left into the sitar note, rises while deepening the bend, adds a restrained pitch tremble, then releases through a rightward glance and centers.

prompt: Shamisen strike. You prepare a broad stroke and strike cleanly.
idea: Winds the shamisen stroke high with the torso right, holds the preparation, then strikes sharply low across to the left and releases centrally.

prompt: Koto flourish. You follow a low-to-high string sweep then damp it.
idea: Follows the koto flourish from low right to high left, suspends the top, then dampens with a centered downward nod and settles.

prompt: Erhu glide. You trace a sliding note while leaning into the phrase.
idea: Leans leftward in gaze with a right tilt into the erhu phrase, raises the pitch with a slow glide, then softens through center and releases.

prompt: Guzheng tremolo. You sustain a trembling high note then damp the strings.
idea: Raises the gaze left into a high guzheng note, sustains its trembling pulse, then damps the strings with an abrupt low quiet stop and recovers.

prompt: Singing bowl. You circle a rim then listen to the sustained tone.
idea: Circles the singing-bowl rim with restrained torso rhythm under a low gaze, centers as the tone rings, then holds utterly still before releasing.

prompt: Triangle ping. You strike once and let the note ring.
idea: Lifts the ears and leans back, flicks down for one triangle ping, then listens as the ringing fades.

prompt: Cymbal crash. You open wide before bringing the sound together.
idea: Open the torso right and left, draw back for the cymbal crash, then snap forward and recover square.

prompt: Gong strike. You draw back slowly then release one heavy stroke.
idea: Rises into a slow backward gong preparation, drops into one heavy strike, and listens low before easing upright.

prompt: Snare roll. You build fast detail then end on a single accent.
idea: Begins low, builds a quick snare tremble, lifts for the final accent, and lands in a softened downward finish.

prompt: Bass drum beat. You deliver two widely spaced heavy beats.
idea: Raise for the first heavy bass beat, let its rebound hang, then return through a spacious second beat and settle.

prompt: Timpani swell. You build alternating rolls into a final low accent.
idea: Looks right into a timpani roll, rolls across to the left with growing energy, then lifts and drops onto the centered final accent.

prompt: Marimba run. You follow mallets stepping across a low keyboard.
idea: Follow the marimba from low right through the middle to low left, marking the notes with short nodding beats, then lift centrally.

prompt: Xylophone grace note. You make a tiny pickup before a main note.
idea: Dips for a little xylophone pickup, rises into the main preparation, then strikes down and lets the head rebound.

prompt: Vibraphone sustain. You strike a chord and listen with the pedal held.
idea: Lifts before striking the vibraphone chord, then raises the listening gaze while the ears slowly relax with its sustain.

prompt: Steelpan melody. You follow a circular pattern around a drum.
idea: Looks low right, circles through a rightward body turn into the left side of the steelpan, and returns square after the melody.

prompt: Djembe call. You play a call then leave space for its response.
idea: Raises for a djembe call, delivers a short beat then a more spacious second beat, and lifts to listen for the answer.

prompt: Tabla phrase. You alternate low and high accents then stop together.
idea: Dip into the low tabla voice, rebound through alternating high and low accents, then bring both voices to a centered stop.

prompt: Bongo fill. You move from one small drum to another.
idea: Poises above the right bongo, dips into it, lifts across to the left drum, and resolves its second beat at center.

prompt: Conga slap. You prepare a broad downward slap and rebound.
idea: Lifts high for the conga slap, snaps down with perked ears, then rebounds gently and relaxes into the fading sound.

prompt: Tambourine shake. You shake a held rhythm then strike the rim.
idea: Shakes the tambourine sideways, gathers it at center, then lifts and drops onto one rim accent before easing upright.

prompt: Maraca pattern. You alternate shakes and end both together.
idea: Sets the maracas to the right, alternates their lateral shakes, then brings both into a centered low finish.

prompt: Castanet click. You make a short double click then hold the pose.
idea: Makes two close castanet nods, lifts with the ears open, and holds the finished shape as the clicks disappear.

prompt: Claves count. You tap a count-in with a gap before the final beat.
idea: Gives two measured claves counts, suspends the head above the final beat, then taps down and releases the count-in.

prompt: Woodblock cue. You give one dry cue to start a scene.
idea: Waits quietly, raises the head and ears for the woodblock cue, then closes the cue with a dry nod and an easy recovery.

prompt: Guiro scrape. You trace a long scrape then a short return.
idea: Traces a long downward guiro scrape, lifts for the short return, and makes a shallow finishing dip before relaxing.

prompt: Rainstick turn. You invert a tube and follow falling grains.
idea: Turns the rainstick from right to left while lifting, then follows the grains down and returns the torso to center.

prompt: Ocean drum. You tilt a drum so beads roll across it.
idea: Tilts left, follows the ocean beads to the right, then tilts right and carries their return to the left before leveling.

prompt: Wind chime. You brush the chimes then follow their fading motion.
idea: Brushes the chimes from right through center to left, follows their light swinging sound, then returns to raised attention.

prompt: Handbell ring. You lift a bell then flick and damp it.
idea: Lifts the handbell, flicks it forward-down, then draws into a smaller damping dip and settles upright.

prompt: Bell choir rest. You hold a bell aloft until the next entrance.
idea: Holds the bell aloft with lifted ears, waits through the rest, then gives one measured entrance dip and recovers.

prompt: Theremin pitch. You raise an invisible pitch then settle on one note.
idea: Raise the theremin pitch in two smooth stages, sustain its high note with a gentle vibrato, then relax the ears as it settles.

prompt: Synth filter sweep. You turn a control and follow the sound opening.
idea: Turns the synth control from right to left as the sound opens upward, sustains its brightness, then squares the body.

prompt: Turntable scratch. You rock a record back and forth then release it.
idea: Rocks the record from right to left and back through short scratches, releases into a leftward sweep, then returns square.

prompt: Record needle. You lower a needle carefully and wait for the groove.
idea: Lowers the needle in two careful stages, briefly stills at the groove, then lifts the ears to hear the record begin.

prompt: Tape splice. You align two tape ends and press the join.
idea: Checks the tape ends low right and low left, centers their join, then presses down and withdraws to inspect it.

prompt: Microphone test. You lean toward a microphone then back off to listen.
idea: Leans forward-down into the microphone, draws back to listen on the left, then returns to a relaxed centered stance.

prompt: Microphone feedback. You approach a microphone then pull away from a squeal.
idea: Approaches the microphone, recoils backward into a right tilt at the squeal, then looks left and settles at a safer distance.

prompt: Monitor adjustment. You check the sound then turn toward a floor monitor.
idea: Raises the listening gaze, turns toward the left floor monitor, studies it lower and closer to center, then lifts back upright.

prompt: Ear monitor seating. You tilt one side then test the fit upright.
idea: Tilts left to seat one ear monitor, tips right to check the other, then straightens and tests the fit with a small listening sway.

prompt: Instrument tuning. You listen then make one small adjustment and listen again.
idea: Listens high, lowers into a right-to-left tuning adjustment, then squares up and listens again with newly lifted ears.

prompt: String tightening. You turn a peg then check the pitch twice.
idea: Turn the tuning peg right and listen to its ringing pitch, adjust left, then check the second tone and release.

prompt: Broken string. You stop mid-phrase and inspect a loose string.
idea: Sways through the phrase, cuts the motion at the broken string, then looks low right with a left tilt before straightening.

prompt: Dropped pick. You notice a pick fall then retrieve it below.
idea: Lifts away as the pick slips, snaps the gaze down to the right, dips deeper to retrieve it, then rises back to center.

prompt: Wrong entrance recovery. You begin too early then stop and rejoin on cue.
idea: Starts forward too early, checks the entrance, pulls back to reset, then joins the cue with a fuller nod and recovery.

prompt: Lost score place. You scan a score and find the next bar.
idea: Searches the low score right, left, then back right, settles on the missing bar, and lifts ready to play.

prompt: Tempo pickup. You start slowly then move into the established beat.
idea: Begins with a spacious slow nod, gathers into the established quicker pulse, then lifts out of the pickup with relaxed ears.

prompt: Ritardando finish. You let a phrase slow into its final rest.
idea: Nods through the phrase, lengthens the next beat, then lets a final isolated dip come to rest as the ears soften.

prompt: Swing pickup. You lean behind the beat before landing a note.
idea: Leans backward with a right tilt behind the swing beat, waits into the pickup, then lands forward-down and eases square.

prompt: Syncopated stop. You move through a rhythm and freeze off the expected beat.
idea: Moves through a sideways pulse, interrupts it with an early compact stop, then lets the ears relax as balance returns.

prompt: Call and echo. You make a phrase then repeat it after listening.
idea: Nods a short call, turns left to hear its answer, then faces front and echoes the same small phrase before settling.

prompt: Round singing entry. You listen to another line before joining underneath.
idea: Listens to the other line on the left, lowers into its own quiet entrance, and carries a soft phrase pulse back toward center.

prompt: Beatboxing kick. You draw back before two percussive bass bursts.
idea: Draw back for two percussive beatbox kicks, pulse each forward-down in a compact rhythm, then release the bass tension.

prompt: Breath reset. You finish a long phrase and take a measured breath.
idea: Finish the phrase low, open upward for a measured breathing cycle, then relax the ears and settle the lifted posture.

prompt: Stage soundcheck. You look at a floor cable then face the microphone.
idea: Checks the cable low right, follows it closer below, then rises square to the microphone and leans into soundcheck.

prompt: Encore count-in. You return to position and cue a fresh opening.
idea: Returns from the left to a square stage stance, lifts for the encore count-in, then drops the opening downbeat and rebounds.

prompt: Nail starting. You position a nail and tap it gently.
idea: Aligns over the nail, lifts a little, taps twice with shallow nods, then raises the gaze to check the start.

prompt: Bent nail. You notice a nail bend and reset before trying again.
idea: Raises and strikes the nail, stops to inspect its bend with a left tilt, then straightens for a slower careful retry.

prompt: Screw driving. You align a screw and turn it until snug.
idea: Aligns low over the screw, starts turning right then left, repeats the snugging twist, and centers at the final resistance.

prompt: Stripped screw. You feel a driver slip and reposition it.
idea: Turn the driver right-left, dip at the slip and lift to reset, then make a steadier second turn and center.

prompt: Hand sawing. You draw a saw repeatedly through a board.
idea: Sets the saw high, works through broad forward-down strokes with raised returns, then lifts from the finished cut.

prompt: Hacksaw cut. You make short controlled strokes through a rod.
idea: Starts the hacksaw at low right, works short lateral passes across the rod, then stops back on the right to inspect the cut.

prompt: Chisel paring. You lean into a chisel and lift a thin shaving.
idea: Leans forward-down into the chisel, follows the thin shaving upward as it releases, and settles to inspect the pared surface.

prompt: Chisel mallet. You set a chisel before delivering two measured blows.
idea: Set the chisel low, raise the mallet and make two measured downward blows, then withdraw to inspect the cut.

prompt: Wood plane. You push a plane through a long shaving.
idea: Pushes the plane forward-down through a long shaving, lifts toward the left to inspect its curl, then returns centered.

prompt: Sandpaper pass. You smooth an edge and check it from the side.
idea: Sands the edge with low lateral passes, tips left to feel the result, looks along the rightward edge, then centers.

prompt: Drill pilot. You sight a drill bit and advance into the material.
idea: Sights the drill from above, advances steadily downward, carries a small loaded vibration, then lifts out of the pilot hole.

prompt: Drill breakthrough. You feel a drill pass through and pull it back.
idea: Presses the drill down, feels a sudden deeper breakthrough, then pulls up under control and lets the ears settle.

prompt: Countersinking. You widen a screw seat without going too deep.
idea: Applies a shallow countersinking press, lifts the pressure into a close left tilt, then straightens after checking the seat.
