prompt: Router edge. You follow a curved edge with steady pressure.
idea: Follows the router low right, turns the torso around the curve to the left, carries the gaze farther left, and exits square.

prompt: Circular saw. You track a straight cut then wait for the blade to stop.
idea: Tracks the circular saw forward and low, waits for the blade to coast down, then lifts away with relaxed ears.

prompt: Jigsaw corner. You slow at a tight curve then turn through it.
idea: Advances toward the jigsaw corner, pauses low to judge it, turns right through the bend, then resumes and squares up.

prompt: Bandsaw contour. You guide material around two bends.
idea: Guides the bandsaw around a low right bend, checks the center, then steers left through the second curve and lifts clear.

prompt: Lathe shaping. You watch a rotating blank and approach with a tool.
idea: Watches the lathe from the right with a small tracking rhythm, centers, then eases the tool forward-down into the turning blank.

prompt: Lathe inspection. You stop the rotation before examining the profile.
idea: Follows the lathe rotation, brings that rhythm to a stop, examines the low right and left profile, then tilts left and returns square.

prompt: Measuring tape. You extend a tape and read its far mark.
idea: Looks down at the near tape end, follows it farther right to read the mark, then raises the gaze back toward center.

prompt: Square checking. You check two perpendicular edges for alignment.
idea: Checks the square along a low right edge, crosses to the left edge and its farther corner, then lifts after comparing alignment.

prompt: Spirit level. You lower to a bubble and nudge until centered.
idea: Sinks to the spirit-level bubble, makes left and right corrections, then lets smaller leveling motions converge at center.

prompt: Plumb line. You follow a hanging line from top to bottom.
idea: Finds the top of the plumb line, traces it straight downward, holds the bottom in low focus, then eases upright.

prompt: Marking gauge. You score a parallel line along a board.
idea: Sets the gauge low right, scores farther right along the board, turns the torso to extend the line, then lifts away square.

prompt: Dividers transfer. You lift a measured spacing and transfer it between two marks.
idea: Compares the two low divider marks, lifts the fixed spacing, carries it left, then lowers onto the new mark and withdraws.

prompt: Center punch. You align over a mark then strike once.
idea: Centers low on the punch mark, raises briefly, strikes straight down, then rebounds to examine the indentation.

prompt: Metal filing. You push a file forward and lift on the return.
idea: Sets the file above the work, pushes forward-down through repeated passes with lifted returns, then clears the edge and relaxes.

prompt: Deburring. You feel along a cut edge and remove one snag.
idea: Feels along the edge from low right to left, stops over the burr, gives it a short downward scrape, and lifts to check.

prompt: Bench vise. You tighten jaws around a workpiece and test it.
idea: Turns the vise right and left through successive tightening strokes, returns right to snug it, then centers for a forward stability check.

prompt: Clamp pressure. You tighten a clamp gradually and check the seam.
idea: Starts the clamp on the right, looks down the seam, tightens across to the left, then centers low to assess its pressure.

prompt: Glue spreading. You cover a joint then align the pieces.
idea: Spreads glue from low right to left, returns to align the joint, then presses down slowly and eases off to inspect.

prompt: Glue squeezeout. You notice glue escaping and wipe the seam.
idea: Notices squeezeout below on the left, follows it farther along the seam, wipes back a little, then returns to inspect the joint.

prompt: Dowel fitting. You align a dowel then press it into a socket.
idea: Sights the dowel low with a left tilt, straightens its alignment, then presses into the socket and lifts from the seated fit.

prompt: Mortise test. You lower a tenon and check whether it seats.
idea: Lowers the tenon toward the mortise, pauses at the halfway resistance, then lifts it back out and reassesses with attentive ears.

prompt: Joint retry. You withdraw a crooked joint and realign it.
idea: Finds the joint crooked in a low right tilt, withdraws upward, squares the parts, then descends again into a straighter fit.

prompt: Wood bending. You lean around a curved form and hold the bend.
idea: Turns right and tilts left around the bending form, loads the curve across to the left with a right tilt, then holds before releasing square.

prompt: Veneer laying. You lower a thin sheet and smooth outward.
idea: Lowers the veneer level onto the panel, smooths out toward the right and then the left edge, and lifts from the centered sheet.

prompt: Edge banding. You press along a strip then trim the end.
idea: Presses the band from far right through the middle to the left end, lifts for the trim, then cuts downward and releases.

prompt: Staple setting. You position fabric and fire one staple.
idea: Aligns over the fabric, lightly unloads the stapler, fires one compact downward pulse, and lifts to inspect the staple.

prompt: Rivet setting. You brace a rivet and peen it with two strikes.
idea: Brace low over the rivet, rise for two distinct peening beats, then ease out of the second impact into inspection.

prompt: Pop rivet. You pull until the mandrel snaps.
idea: Build backward tension on the rivet and tremble under load, dip against it, then recoil upward as the mandrel snaps and settle.

prompt: Bolt threading. You start a bolt gently and test its engagement.
idea: Starts the bolt with a small rightward turn, looks down to test its bite, turns left gently, then centers over the engaged thread.

prompt: Torque wrench. You pull through resistance until the click.
idea: Set the wrench right and pull slowly left through resistance, shiver at the loaded limit, then catch the click and release centered.

prompt: Socket ratchet. You ratchet a fastener with clear resets.
idea: Ratcheting from right to left, repeats the torso stroke with clear resets, then makes a smaller last turn and returns square.

prompt: Wrench reposition. You run out of swing and reset the wrench.
idea: Turn the wrench right to left until its swing ends, lift and reset right, then work the second turn left in a controlled rocking motion.

prompt: Pliers extraction. You grip a pin and pull it straight out.
idea: Grip the pin low, draw upward with a strained tremble, release higher as it comes free, then return to inspect.

prompt: Wire stripping. You pinch insulation then pull the sheath away.
idea: Compresses the insulation low at center, turns right to draw off the sheath, follows its withdrawal farther right, then returns upright.

prompt: Wire twisting. You join two wires by rotating them together.
idea: Checks the wire ends right and left, brings them into a rightward twist, works repeated opposing turns, then squares the finished join.

prompt: Solder joint. You approach a tiny joint and wait for solder to flow.
idea: Approaches the tiny solder joint low, waits briefly as the solder flows, then withdraws slightly and watches the surface settle.

prompt: Solder bridge. You spot excess solder and lift it away.
idea: Spots the solder bridge with a low left tilt, checks it on the right, lifts diagonally away from the fault, and returns square.

prompt: Heat shrink. You watch tubing contract and turn it for even heating.
idea: Inspects the shrinking tube low on the right, rotates it left through gentle heating passes, then centers to check the contraction.

prompt: Cable crimp. You align a connector and compress it firmly.
idea: Sights the connector with a low left tilt, straightens, compresses firmly downward, then releases to inspect the crimp.

prompt: Cable routing. You follow a cable around an obstacle.
idea: Follows the cable low right, detours farther right around the obstacle, then turns back through center to the leftward path.

prompt: Cable tie. You pull a tie tight and clip its tail.
idea: Pulls the cable tie backward and upward, gathers for a small downward tail cut, then lifts from the secured loop.

prompt: Fuse replacement. You inspect a tiny fuse then seat a replacement.
idea: Examines the fuse in a low left tilt, lifts the replacement, straightens over the socket, then seats it downward and releases.

prompt: Circuit probe. You touch two test points in sequence.
idea: Touches the right test point low, lifts between contacts, probes the left point, then returns upright to read the result.

prompt: Battery polarity. You check both ends before inserting a cell.
idea: Checks the battery ends low right and left, centers the correct orientation, then lowers the cell precisely and lifts away.

prompt: Switch test. You toggle a switch and watch the result.
idea: Poises above the switch, toggles with a short forward nod, then raises the gaze to watch the result and relaxes the ears.

prompt: Connector seating. You push a plug until it clicks then test the fit.
idea: Pushes the connector forward under increasing pressure, catches its click, then withdraws slightly and tests the seating with small nods.

prompt: Stuck connector. You try a plug then withdraw and reverse it.
idea: Attempts the plug forward, withdraws at resistance, rolls right to reverse it, then straightens into a slower second insertion.

prompt: Thread cutting. You turn a tap forward then back to clear chips.
idea: Starts the tap on the right, turns forward to the left, briefly reverses to clear chips, then returns square above the thread.

prompt: Die threading. You start a die square and maintain a level turn.
idea: Correct the die with a left-right tilt, square it, then make a steady right-to-left threading turn and release upright.

prompt: Metal bending. You brace a strip and push it around a corner.
idea: Braces low toward the right, leans left against the strip, pushes around the corner into a leftward body turn, then unloads square.

prompt: Sheet shearing. You align a sheet and make one long cut.
idea: Aligns the sheet on the right, sweeps the long cut across to the left, dips at its end, then returns clear of the edge.

prompt: Tin snipping. You make three short cuts along an edge.
idea: Makes a short tin snip on the right, advances to a second on the left, then centers for the final cut and lifts away.

prompt: Pipe cutting. You rotate around a tube and tighten the cutter.
idea: Rotates the pipe cutter from right through center to left, repeats a smaller cutting turn, then compresses centrally and releases.

prompt: Pipe deburring. You inspect the rim then smooth its inner edge.
idea: Tilts left over the pipe rim, follows the inner edge from right to left with small smoothing motions, then straightens and lifts.

prompt: Pipe fitting. You line up a coupling and screw it home.
idea: Align the pipe coupling low, rotate through two controlled right-left advances, then center to check the seated fit.

prompt: Leak check. You trace a pipe and pause at a wet joint.
idea: Traces the pipe from far right across two low joints, stops at the wet left joint, then leans closer before withdrawing.

prompt: Valve opening. You turn a resistant valve then watch the outlet.
idea: Loads the resistant valve from the right, turns it through to the left with small effort pulses, then squares up and watches the outlet below.

prompt: Faucet washer. You look into a fitting and seat a small washer.
idea: Peers deep into the faucet fitting with a left tilt, aligns the washer squarely, then presses it down and rises to check.

prompt: Drain snake. You feed a cable then rotate through a blockage.
idea: Feeds the snake forward-low, stalls at the blockage, turns right then left through repeated freeing effort, and returns square.

prompt: Tile scoring. You draw a straight score across a tile.
idea: Scores the tile from the far right edge through the middle to far left, then lifts the gaze from the completed straight line.

prompt: Tile snapping. You align a scored tile and press until it breaks.
idea: Aligns over the scored tile, gathers upward against the coming press, pushes down until it snaps, then releases into a lifted inspection.

prompt: Grout floating. You sweep diagonally across tile joints.
idea: Sweeps grout diagonally from low right to far left, changes the angle, then draws back across to far right and centers.

prompt: Caulk bead. You follow a seam with a steady bead.
idea: Follows the caulk seam from far right through two middle positions to far left, stops the bead neatly, then lifts clear.

prompt: Paint rolling. You roll upward then back down a wall.
idea: Starts the roller low, tracks its upward stroke, brings it back down with measured pressure, then lifts from the wall.

prompt: Paint cutting-in. You trace a careful boundary near a corner.
idea: Looks high right with a left tilt, traces the paint boundary across to the left without dropping, then levels at center.

prompt: Paint drip. You notice a run and brush upward to catch it.
idea: Spots the drip high, follows its descent, reverses upward to catch it, then relaxes after the run is contained.

prompt: Wallpaper smoothing. You press from the center outward then check a bubble.
idea: Press the wallpaper center, smooth outward right and left in an even sweep, then return low for a close bubble inspection.

prompt: Wallpaper seam. You match a pattern before smoothing downward.
idea: Compare the wallpaper pattern right and left, center the matching seam, then smooth it with a long downward stroke.

prompt: Drywall patch. You press a patch flat then skim across it.
idea: Presses the drywall patch forward-down, skims from right to left with a light working rhythm, then lifts to inspect the flat surface.

prompt: Plaster trowel. You lift a trowel up a wall and feather away.
idea: Raises the trowel up the wall, tilts right to feather the edge, looks left along the finish, then returns level.

prompt: Brick laying. You lower a brick then check it level.
idea: Lowers the brick into place, checks level with left and right tilts, then lets tiny corrections settle square above it.

prompt: Mortar bedding. You spread mortar then press a brick into place.
idea: Spreads mortar low from right to left, rises to reset above the brick, then presses it down into its bed and eases off.

prompt: Roof shingle. You align an overlapping edge and fix it down.
idea: Sights the shingle overlap low right, follows its farther edge, then lifts at center for one fixing beat and recovery.

prompt: Gutter clearing. You scoop debris then inspect the channel.
idea: Scoops deeply into the gutter, lifts the debris to the left, then checks the cleared channel from right to left and centers.

prompt: Ladder check. You inspect the feet then look up the rungs.
idea: Check the ladder feet low right and left, center between them, then lift along the rungs to a high attentive view.

prompt: Stud finding. You scan a wall and stop over a hidden support.
idea: Scans the wall from right through center to left, stops over the stud, then raises slightly for a confirming nod and returns centered.

prompt: Anchor setting. You push a wall anchor flush and test it.
idea: Leans into the wall anchor, presses it flush, withdraws for a slight backward inspection, then tests its firmness with a small nod.

prompt: Door hinge. You swing a door to inspect its hinge travel.
idea: Fixes on the low hinge to the left, swings the door right then left, repeats its travel, and returns square to inspect.

prompt: Drawer slide. You pull a drawer out and push it back to test travel.
idea: Pulls the drawer backward and up, tests its sliding travel with a measured in-and-out rhythm, then closes forward-down and releases.

prompt: Shelf leveling. You compare both ends then correct the lower side.
idea: Tilts left to check the right shelf end, tips right to compare the left, then makes smaller leveling corrections before settling square.

prompt: Floorboard gap. You inspect a gap then press the board toward its neighbor.
idea: Studies the floor gap low right with a left tilt, braces into a leftward body push, then straightens to inspect the narrowed seam.

prompt: Window glazing. You follow a frame edge and press putty into its corner.
idea: Traces the glazing from high right to low left, aligns the corner at center, then presses the putty in and lifts away.

prompt: Weatherstrip fitting. You follow a door seal and press one loose section.
idea: Looks up the weatherstrip, follows it down to the loose section, then compresses that spot forward and eases back to check.

prompt: Tool cleanup. You wipe a blade and return it to its rack.
idea: Wipes the blade in low strokes from right toward left, lifts it to the rack on the left, then returns upright after placing it.

prompt: Workbench inspection. You check a finished assembly from three angles.
idea: Inspects the assembly low right with a left tilt, crosses low left with a right tilt, then levels and rises for a centered overview.

prompt: Floor sweeping. You gather scattered crumbs into one pile.
idea: Sweeps crumbs inward from far right, crosses to gather the left side, then makes small finishing sweeps into the central pile.

prompt: Dustpan loading. You push a crumb pile over the dustpan lip.
idea: Pushes the crumb pile forward-low, lifts slightly over the dustpan lip, then completes the loading with a small dip and releases.

prompt: Vacuum corner. You clean along a wall then reach into a corner.
idea: Vacuums along the wall from low right to left, turns the body into the corner, reaches deeper, then draws back square.

prompt: Vacuum snag. You feel a cable catch and back away before retrying.
idea: Advances low until the vacuum catches, pauses, backs away, then redirects right for a slower retry and returns clear.

prompt: Mop wringing. You twist a wet mop and watch water drain.
idea: Twists the mop right then left through repeated wringing strokes, centers low, and watches the last water drain before lifting.

prompt: Mop figure eight. You sweep a wet floor in connected arcs.
idea: Carries the mop low through a rightward arc, crosses into the left arc, then repeats the connected sweep and finishes at center.

prompt: Bucket lift. You brace beneath a full bucket then raise it steadily.
idea: Crouches beneath the full bucket, builds a steady upward lift, makes tiny balancing corrections at height, then settles the load.

prompt: Bucket tipping. You pour water out without splashing.
idea: Holds the bucket high, rolls right into a slow pour, follows the water low left, then rights the bucket and returns center.

prompt: Window squeegee. You draw water down glass then wipe the edge.
idea: Starts high on the window, draws the squeegee downward, wipes its edge toward the right, then returns to a level view.

prompt: Mirror polishing. You buff a small patch then check the reflection.
idea: Buffs the mirror in small circling sways, slows the polish, then leans close and level to check the reflection.

prompt: High shelf dusting. You reach above your head then look for missed dust.
idea: Reaches high to dust the shelf, works short strokes overhead, then checks the upper right and left corners before lowering.

prompt: Blind cleaning. You follow slats across a window.
idea: Cleans one blind slat from right to left, steps down for the next right-to-left pass, then centers below the cleaned rows.

prompt: Curtain drawing. You pull curtains apart and look through.
idea: Draws the right curtain outward, opens the left with a broad opposing turn, then squares up into a raised view through the window.

prompt: Curtain snag. You pull a curtain then stop at a stuck ring.
idea: Pulls the curtain right until it snags, checks the stop, then looks higher right toward the ring and returns to inspect its track.

prompt: Sheet shaking. You lift a sheet and snap it flat.
idea: Gathers the sheet low, rises into a broad high crest, snaps it downward flat, then rebounds softly as the fabric settles.

prompt: Bed smoothing. You press wrinkles toward the edges.
idea: Presses the bed center low, smooths wrinkles out to the right, returns across center toward the left, then checks the middle again.

prompt: Pillow fluffing. You compress a pillow then let it spring back.
idea: Lifts over the pillow, compresses it twice in springing downward pulses, then follows its final rebound and relaxes.

prompt: Duvet corner. You find a hidden corner then pull it into place.
idea: Search the duvet low right and left, return to the hidden right corner, then draw it diagonally upward and settle centered.

prompt: Mattress turning. You brace and rotate a bulky mattress.
idea: Braces low on the right, raises the bulky mattress into a loaded leftward turn, steadies it with small balancing motions, then lowers square.

prompt: Laundry sorting. You inspect fabric then place it in a selected pile.
idea: Inspects the fabric low with a left tilt, checks it from a right tilt, then turns toward the right pile and releases it before centering.

prompt: Shirt folding. You fold both sides inward then fold the bottom up.
idea: Folds the right shirt side inward, brings in the left side, then centers low and lifts the bottom fold into a neat finish.

prompt: Towel folding. You match two corners before pressing the fold.
idea: Match the towel corners in a low right-left sweep, center the fold, press downward, then release to inspect the edges.

prompt: Sock matching. You compare two socks and bring the pair together.
idea: Compares the socks low right and left with a second quick matching glance, then brings the pair together in a close centered look.

prompt: Sock turning. You pull an inside-out sock through itself.
idea: Compresses the sock inward low, works a small tugging rhythm through the inversion, then pulls it upward and lets it hang straight.

prompt: Laundry hanging. You lift a garment and secure it overhead.
idea: Gathers the laundry low, lifts it overhead, makes small securing motions at the line, then eases down after the placement.

prompt: Clothespin drop. You follow a fallen clip then recover it.
idea: Works high until the clip falls, snaps the gaze low to the right, dips to recover it, then rises back toward the line.

prompt: Washing dial. You read a dial and rotate it to a setting.
idea: Reads the washer dial with a low left tilt, turns from right through center to the left setting, then squares up to check it.

prompt: Washer imbalance. You watch a drum wobble then wait for it to stop.
idea: Tracks the washer wobble low with a sideways rocking rhythm, stops as the drum stills, then lifts to reassess with softened ears.

prompt: Lint screen. You pull out a filter and inspect its mesh.
idea: Extracts the lint screen low, lifts it into a close left tilt, makes a small inspection sway, then straightens and lowers it.

prompt: Ironing crease. You follow a straight crease with steady pressure.
idea: Presses along the crease from low right to left with steady forward pressure, reaches the line end, then lifts away square.

prompt: Ironing collar. You work around a collar curve.
idea: Follows the collar low right through a body turn, reverses around its curve toward the left, then lifts from the centered neckline.

prompt: Steam burst. You press steam then draw back from the cloud.
idea: Leans forward-low to press steam, recoils backward and up with a right tilt through the cloud, then levels and settles.

prompt: Hanger threading. You angle a hanger through a narrow collar.
idea: Angles the hanger low with a left tilt, turns right into the collar, tips right to pass through, then straightens inside and releases.

prompt: Closet rail. You scan hangers then lift one free.
idea: Scans the closet rail from right through center to left, finds a hanger, lifts it free with perked ears, then returns centered.

prompt: Shoe brushing. You brush a shoe then inspect the toe.
idea: Brushes the shoe with low lateral strokes, stops at its left toe with a right tilt, then levels to judge the cleaned surface.

prompt: Shoe polishing. You buff a toe to a shine and check it sideways.
idea: Buffs the toe with small low circling sways, tips left, then looks along its rightward reflection before returning square.

prompt: Shoelace knot. You cross laces and pull the knot tight.
idea: Cross the laces low right and left, twist the knot in an opposing rhythm, then pull backward-up to tighten and relax.

prompt: Boot removal. You pull against a tight boot and catch the release.
idea: Strains backward against the tight boot with small repeated tugs, dips against the resistance, then catches the upward release and settles.

prompt: Coat zipper. You start a zipper then pull it toward your chin.
idea: Finds the zipper low and close, starts it with a small tug, then tracks it straight upward toward the chin and relaxes.

prompt: Stuck zipper. You stop a snagged zipper and ease it back.
idea: Pulls the zipper upward until it snags, checks the motion, lowers to free it, then retries upward slowly and settles.

prompt: Button fastening. You align a small button and push it through.
idea: Sights the button low with a left tilt, straightens its alignment, makes a tiny forward press, then withdraws to check the fastening.

prompt: Belt threading. You feed a strap through a loop and pull it through.
idea: Feeds the belt forward-low into the loop, turns right to draw it through, follows the strap farther right, then returns square.

prompt: Lint rolling. You pass over fabric and inspect a missed patch.
idea: Rolls across the fabric from right to left, returns to a missed patch on the right, gives it short cleaning passes, then lifts center.

prompt: Umbrella opening. You raise an umbrella and watch the canopy spread.
idea: Gather the umbrella low and lift it sharply open, inspect the canopy right then left overhead, then lower to a comfortable stance.

prompt: Umbrella closing. You draw the canopy inward and shake off drops.
idea: Looks up at the open canopy, draws it inward and down, shakes off droplets laterally, then returns centered with relaxed ears.

prompt: Umbrella inversion. You feel the canopy flip and turn it back into the wind.
idea: Leans into the umbrella before its inversion, recoils high with a right tilt, then turns right and decisively left into the wind before leveling.

prompt: Doormat shaking. You lift a mat and give two separate shakes.
idea: Lift the doormat, shake it downward once and reset, then give a second separate shake before lowering it.

prompt: Rug unrolling. You follow a rolled rug opening across the floor.
idea: Finds the near rug roll low, follows its opening forward across the floor, then lifts toward the far edge and settles upright.

prompt: Rug corner. You press down a curled corner then check it.
idea: Inspects the curled rug corner low right with a left tilt, squares over it, presses downward, then lifts to see whether it stays flat.

prompt: Trash bag tying. You gather a bag top and pull a knot closed.
idea: Gather the bag top from low right and left, bring the knot centrally together, then tighten backward-up and relax the pull.

prompt: Trash lid. You lift a lid then lean to inspect inside.
idea: Follows the trash lid upward, pauses above the opening, leans into a deep low inspection, then withdraws upright.

prompt: Bin liner. You open a liner and settle it around a rim.
idea: Opens the liner with broad right and left turns, lowers it centrally around the rim, makes small seating dips, then lifts away.

prompt: Recycling flatten. You press a box until its seams fold.
idea: Rises over the box, presses its seams downward with sustained weight, then eases up from the flattened cardboard.

prompt: Cardboard tearing. You pull a seam apart in two attempts.
idea: Pull the cardboard seam right to left and stall, reset right with a loaded tremble, then tear farther left and relax square.

prompt: Bottle rinse. You tip a bottle swirl it and pour out.
idea: Tips the bottle right, swirls the rinse with a compact body rhythm, then tips left to drain and rights it again.

prompt: Dish stacking. You align a plate with a stack and lower it gently.
idea: Holds the plate level above the stack, lowers carefully, briefly stills at contact, then lifts away with relaxed ears.

prompt: Dish scrubbing. You work a stubborn spot then inspect it.
idea: Leans low into a stubborn dish spot, scrubs with a firm short rhythm, then tips left for a close inspection and levels.

prompt: Glass washing. You rotate a glass and inspect the rim.
idea: Rotates the glass right to left through washing strokes, lifts toward its rim with a left tilt, then returns square after inspection.

prompt: Dish drying. You wipe around a plate then inspect its edge.
idea: Wipes around the plate from right to left through torso turns, lifts to check its left edge, then centers the dry plate.

prompt: Dishwasher loading. You look into a lower rack and set a plate upright.
idea: Looks deeply into the lower rack, raises the plate slightly into upright alignment, lowers it into its slot, then withdraws.

prompt: Dishwasher rack. You pull a rack outward then push it home.
idea: Finds the rack forward-low, draws it outward with a backward rise, pushes it home again, then lifts from the closed position.

prompt: Sink plug. You press a stopper down then watch water collect.
idea: Aligns above the sink plug, presses it down, withdraws a little to watch the water collect, then relaxes the listening ears.

prompt: Soap pumping. You press a pump twice before washing.
idea: Raises above the soap pump, gives two separated downward presses, then settles low into a gentle washing rhythm.

prompt: Tap temperature. You test water then make a small adjustment.
idea: Test the water low and retreat, adjust the tap through a small right-left turn, then approach again to check the temperature.

prompt: Towel wringing. You twist wet cloth in opposing directions.
idea: Wringing the towel low, twists right then left through repeated counterturns, releases the squeeze, and rises centered.

prompt: Toilet brush. You scrub below a rim then withdraw.
idea: Dips below the rim, scrubs with low circling motions, then slows and lifts the brush clear into a centered rest.

prompt: Tile wiping. You clean a streak and check under reflected light.
idea: Wipes the tile streak from low right to left, makes short finishing strokes, then raises into a left tilt to inspect the reflected light.

prompt: Grout brushing. You scrub one narrow line then follow its length.
idea: Scrubs the grout with quick low nodding strokes, then follows the clean line steadily from right to left and lifts center.

prompt: Bath plug chain. You follow a chain downward then pull the plug free.
idea: Finds the chain high, follows it down to the bath plug, loads a slight downward brace, then pulls upward free and settles.

prompt: Shower head. You look up and tilt the spray direction.
idea: Looks up at the shower head, tilts left then right to adjust its spray, checks the angle with a small sway, then levels.

prompt: Shower curtain. You slide a curtain then inspect the lower edge.
idea: Slides the curtain through a broad right-to-left turn, looks farther left, then follows its lower edge down before returning square.

prompt: Toothpaste cap. You unscrew a small cap and inspect the opening.
idea: Unscrews the toothpaste cap with small right-to-left turns, repeats the loosening motion, then centers close over the opening.

prompt: Toothbrush rinse. You dip a brush under a stream and shake it dry.
idea: Dips the toothbrush forward under the stream, lifts it clear, shakes off water in restrained side motions, and returns level.

prompt: Hair combing. You follow a comb from crown to ends.
idea: Finds the comb at the crown, follows one long downward stroke to the hair ends, then lifts lightly and lets the ears soften.

prompt: Hair parting. You inspect a center line then each side.
idea: Examines the raised center part, tilts left and levels, checks the right side with a matching tilt, then returns upright.

prompt: Shaving mirror. You tilt your chin and inspect a cheek line.
idea: Raises the chin, turns right to expose the cheek line, tips left for a closer shaving check, then relaxes back to center.

prompt: Face washing. You lean toward water then lift to dry.
idea: Leans deeply toward the water, washes with a small low rhythm, then rises to dry and rests centered with softened ears.

prompt: Eyeglass cleaning. You wipe a lens then hold it to the light.
idea: Wipes the lens low from right to left with small cleaning strokes, then lifts it into a high left tilt to inspect against the light.

prompt: Contact lens case. You inspect two tiny wells then close the case.
idea: Inspect the two case wells low right and left, center above the lid, then dip to close it and withdraw.

prompt: Nail clipping. You sight an edge and make a precise clip.
idea: Aligns the nail edge low with a left tilt, stills briefly, lifts just enough to prepare the clip, then dips precisely and straightens.

prompt: Bandage wrapping. You follow a wrap around an imaginary wrist.
idea: Follows the bandage low around the right side of the wrist, circles across to the left, then centers over the fastening and releases.

prompt: Thermometer reading. You bring a display to eye level and read it.
idea: Raises the thermometer display from low to eye level, reads it steadily with attentive ears, then lowers slightly into a relaxed stance.

prompt: Pill organizer. You check a compartment then move to the next day.
idea: Checks one organizer compartment low right, pauses to read it, shifts left to the next day, then lifts at center.

prompt: Watering can. You tip water into a planter and stop before overflow.
idea: Looks down into the planter, tips right to pour, rights the can before overflow, then withdraws and relaxes the ears.

prompt: Plant misting. You aim at leaves above and below.
idea: Mists the upper right leaves with small pumping beats, follows the plant down to the left leaves, then gives another light mist and centers.

prompt: Leaf wiping. You support a leaf and wipe along its length.
idea: Supports the leaf in a low left tilt, wipes from its right end to the left tip, then straightens and releases the leaf.

prompt: Pot rotating. You turn a plant toward a window and inspect its profile.
idea: Turns the pot from right to left beneath a raised gaze, looks farther left toward the window to inspect its profile, then squares up.

prompt: Repotting. You lift a plant free and lower it into a larger pot.
idea: Gathers the plant low, eases it upward from the old pot, carries it high briefly, then lowers gently into the larger pot.

prompt: Soil tamping. You press loose soil around a stem.
idea: Tamps the soil with small low presses on the right, repeats them on the left, then finishes around the center and lifts.

prompt: Seed planting. You make a shallow hole place a seed and cover it.
idea: Makes a shallow planting dip, lifts to place the seed, then returns for a softer covering press and eases upright.

prompt: Seedling thinning. You inspect a crowded patch and remove one sprout.
idea: Scan the crowded seedlings low right and left, choose one back on the right, then lift it diagonally free and center.

prompt: Deadheading. You spot a spent flower and pinch it away.
idea: Spots the spent flower high left, looks farther left to align the pinch, makes a tiny dip, then withdraws to center.

prompt: Pruning cut. You inspect a branch before making one clean cut.
idea: Inspects the branch high right with a left tilt, lifts against the coming cut, snaps downward cleanly, then straightens and centers.

prompt: Compost turning. You lift heavy material and turn it over.
idea: Crouch into the compost, heave upward with a loaded tremble, turn left to tip the material down, then recover square.

prompt: Garden hose coil. You gather a hose into a loop and lay it down.
idea: Gathers the hose low right, raises it through a rightward turn into a loop, carries the loop left, then lowers it centered.

prompt: Hose kink. You follow a hose to a kink and shake it free.
idea: Follows the hose low from right to left, loads a rightward counterturn, shakes the kink free toward the left, then centers to check flow.

prompt: Sprinkler adjustment. You duck near a sprinkler and change its sweep.
idea: Ducks low with a left tilt to inspect the sprinkler, adjusts it from right to left, then straightens and retreats upward.

prompt: Window latch. You align a latch and close it firmly.
idea: Checks the latch to the left, centers its alignment, presses forward firmly, then withdraws to inspect the closed catch.

prompt: Door chain. You look down at a chain and slide it into place.
idea: Looks low left at the door chain, follows it farther left to its slot, then slides it toward center and lifts after it seats.

prompt: Key turning. You seat a key and turn until the lock releases.
idea: Seats the key low, starts its rightward setup, turns left until the lock releases, then relaxes upward at center.

prompt: Key stuck. You stop a resisting key then ease it back and try again.
idea: Turn the key right-left until it resists, check the pressure, ease back right, then retry a smaller centered turn and release.

prompt: Curtain call. You step into an imaginary spotlight and bow.
idea: Steps from the left into the spotlight, rises square to receive the audience, bows deeply, then returns upright with lifted ears.

prompt: Stage entrance. You peek from the wings before taking center.
idea: Peeks from the right wing, turns the body toward the entrance, arrives centered and tall, then relaxes into the stage position.

prompt: Stage exit. You finish a pose then turn toward the wings.
idea: Holds the tall finishing pose, folds slightly into a rightward exit turn, looks farther right toward the wing, then eases out of the pose.

prompt: Mime wall. You find an invisible wall and trace its edge.
idea: Finds the mime wall in a forward stop, traces its upper boundary toward the left, follows that edge downward, then withdraws center.

prompt: Mime box. You discover the corners of an invisible enclosure.
idea: Checks the invisible box high right, low left, high left, then low right before returning to its center with questioning ears.

prompt: Mime rope. You pull yourself along an invisible rope.
idea: Reaches forward for the invisible rope, pulls backward under load through repeated hauling strokes, then releases into an upright stance.

prompt: Mime stairs. You climb an imaginary staircase one level at a time.
idea: Start low on the imaginary stairs, climb through three rising levels with stepping bobs, then balance at the crest and look ahead.

prompt: Mime elevator. You rise smoothly inside an imaginary lift.
idea: Stands level in the imaginary lift, rises smoothly without tipping the head, pauses at the upper floor, then settles slightly.

prompt: Mime wind. You lean into a gust and fight to stay upright.
idea: Braces forward into the gust, is pushed backward into a right tilt, trembles against the wind, then drives forward and recovers level.

prompt: Mime umbrella. You struggle with an imaginary umbrella in wind.
idea: Looks beneath the umbrella high, catches a rightward yank, looks left to check the canopy, then pulls right and returns beneath its center.

prompt: Mime heavy case. You try to lift a suitcase that will not move.
idea: Braces low over the immovable case, rises only a little, sinks to reset, then makes a second trembling attempt and gives up the load.

prompt: Mime balloon. You follow a balloon pulling you upward.
idea: Finds the balloon on the left, follows its pull higher and nearer center, stretches toward the high point, then steadies beneath it.

prompt: Mime mirror. You repeat a partner's slow head path.
idea: Mirrors a slow left tilt through center into a right tilt, follows the return left, then settles square with softened ears.

prompt: Mime door. You open an invisible door and look through.
idea: Pivots the invisible door from right to left, leans through for a farther left peek, then withdraws and closes the body toward center.

prompt: Mime ladder. You look up and climb in separate pulls.
idea: Looks up the imaginary ladder, gathers low for one climb, rises, gathers again, then completes a second pull and steadies high.

prompt: Mime shrinking room. You watch the ceiling lower and compress beneath it.
idea: Watches the ceiling overhead, lowers beneath its approach, compresses into a deeper crouch, then holds within the shrinking space.

prompt: Marionette lift. You rise as if suspended from a string.
idea: Folds low like a slack marionette, rises vertically under the string, then opens the bowed head and steadies in a lifted pose.

prompt: Marionette slack. You lose string tension and fold in stages.
idea: Stands tall on the puppet string, loses height first, lets the head fold afterward, then settles into a small fading sway.

prompt: Paper puppet. You turn flatly between two profile poses.
idea: Turns flatly into a right profile, arrests the shape, reverses into a left profile, then returns square after a second crisp stop.

prompt: Shadow silhouette. You form a tall side profile and freeze.
idea: Turns into a tall right-facing silhouette, raises the chin into its outline, freezes the shadow, then softly returns square.

prompt: Mask reveal. You lower an imaginary mask and face the audience.
idea: Holds the mask low with a left tilt, lowers it aside, then straightens into a raised audience-facing reveal and rests open.

prompt: Mask change. You turn away then return with a new posture.
idea: Turns away to the right and hides the face, changes height behind the mask, then turns left into the reveal and squares up.

prompt: Quick costume. You duck behind a screen and reappear taller.
idea: Ducks low behind the screen to the right, rises into a taller leftward reappearance, then centers the new costume for display.

prompt: Trapdoor arrival. You rise from below stage level into view.
idea: Waits below the trapdoor, emerges straight upward with attentive ears, reaches full view, then steadies in the arrival pose.

prompt: Trapdoor disappearance. You sink out of view while keeping your gaze forward.
idea: Faces forward at stage level, sinks through two lower trapdoor levels without tipping the head, then holds out of view.

prompt: Spotlight search. You follow a moving light until it lands on you.
idea: Follows the spotlight from far right through near right to the left, catches its final leftward drift, then rises still at center as it lands.

prompt: Stage freeze. You stop a broad movement at a sudden cue.
idea: Sways broadly across the stage, catches the cue off-center to the left with a right tilt, freezes the pose, then releases square.

prompt: Slow-motion fall. You mime losing balance without an abrupt drop.
idea: Rises into a tall left tilt, slowly loses balance into a rightward body turn and sinking height, then uncurls to a low square recovery.

prompt: Comic double take. You look past a prop then return to inspect it.
idea: Glances right past the prop, crosses through center to overshoot left, snaps back right in recognition, then peeks low and returns center.

prompt: Prop too heavy. You lift a light-looking prop and discover its weight.
idea: Starts lifting the light-looking prop, stalls under unexpected weight, compresses lower, then makes a trembling loaded second attempt and settles.

prompt: Prop too light. You overprepare for a prop that rises easily.
idea: Crouches deeply for the supposedly heavy prop, overshoots upward when it lifts easily, makes small balance corrections, then settles the unexpected lightness.

prompt: Slippery floor mime. You lose traction and regain balance.
idea: Slips into a left tilt, overcorrects right then left with widening rolls, makes smaller balance catches, and settles low at center.

prompt: Invisible chair. You lower into a seat that is not there.
idea: Lowers toward the invisible chair, drops farther as the seat fails to appear, catches the fall with an upward rebound, then regains upright balance.

prompt: Chair balancing. You hold an imaginary chair balanced overhead.
idea: Looks high at the balanced chair, corrects a left tilt and then a right one, lets tiny corrections fade, and stills under the load.

prompt: Plate spinning. You watch a plate wobble and restore its spin.
idea: Tracks the plate wobble overhead from a left tilt into a right tilt, tightens the restoring rhythm, then holds its centered spin.

prompt: Juggling cascade. You follow a three-object pattern overhead.
idea: Follows the juggling cascade high right and left, keeps the alternating overhead rhythm, then brings the final catch toward center.

prompt: Juggling dropped ball. You miss one catch and track the fallen object.
idea: Tracks the juggling balls high right and left, keeps one more overhead beat, then breaks down sharply after the missed catch and inspects below.

prompt: Juggling recovery. You retrieve a dropped prop and restart the pattern.
idea: Retrieves the dropped juggling prop low right, rises into a high leftward toss, resumes the alternating pattern, then settles its last catch at center.

prompt: Diabolo toss. You send a spool upward then catch it on the string.
idea: Loads the diabolo low, sends it upward into a high watch, follows its descent into a cushioned catch, then eases level.

prompt: Yo-yo return. You watch a yo-yo drop sleep and climb back.
idea: Follows the yo-yo down, waits while it sleeps, tracks its climb up the same line, then relaxes after the return.

prompt: Yo-yo tangle. You notice a failed return and inspect the string.
idea: Waits low for the failed yo-yo return, tilts left to inspect the tangle, looks closer right along the string, then straightens.

prompt: Hula hoop mime. You keep a hoop moving then let it settle.
idea: Keeps the imaginary hoop circling with broad torso pulses, reduces the swing as it settles, then returns centered and low.

prompt: Spinning top. You launch a top and follow its wobble.
idea: Loads the top low on the right, twists left to launch it, follows its wobble with small side motions, then centers over the stable spin.

prompt: Baton catch. You watch a rotating baton and catch at eye level.
idea: Tracks the rotating baton high from right to left, follows its descent to eye level, catches it precisely, then softens the pose.

prompt: Ribbon snag. You free a ribbon caught around its own stick before resuming a low loop.
idea: Stops low at the crossed ribbon, inspects it with a left tilt and rightward glance, lifts aside left to free it, then resumes a smooth low loop.

prompt: Flag flourish. You sweep a flag overhead and lower it to the side.
idea: Sweeps the flag overhead from right to left, follows it farther left, then lowers to the side and returns square after the flourish.

prompt: Fan opening. You reveal an imaginary fan and look over its rim.
idea: Holds the fan closed low on the right, opens it toward the left, then lifts into a left tilt to look over its rim and returns square.

prompt: Parasol twirl. You watch a parasol rotate overhead.
idea: Watches the parasol high as it rotates right to left, follows its repeating turn, then settles into a left tilt before centering.

prompt: Magic coin vanish. You show a coin then look at the empty spot.
idea: Displays the coin low, lifts briefly to conceal its vanish, then returns to the empty spot and holds the reveal before easing upright.

prompt: Magic coin production. You inspect an empty space then reveal a coin.
idea: Search the empty space low right and left, gather the reveal centrally, then rise with perked ears to present the coin.

prompt: Magic card spread. You follow a fan of cards from one end to the other.
idea: Follows the spreading cards from far right through two middle positions to far left, then lifts the fan at center for presentation.

prompt: Magic levitation. You watch a prop rise without touching it.
idea: Watches the prop low without touching it, follows its slow levitation upward, then holds the high view with lifted ears before easing down.

prompt: Magic failed trick. You attempt a reveal pause then try a new approach.
idea: Raises a failed reveal, pauses, lowers to the right for a new approach, then turns left into a second presentation and returns square.

prompt: Tap shuffle. You mark a shuffle then a firm finishing beat.
idea: Marks the tap shuffle with light vertical beats, rises against the final accent, then lands a grounded dip and releases.

prompt: Tap break. You dance through a phrase then stop cleanly.
idea: Dances a turning tap phrase into small bouncing steps, lifts for the break, then stops low and releases the pose.

prompt: Waltz turn. You sway through a three-part turning phrase.
idea: Leans left into a rightward waltz turn, rises through center, flows into a leftward turn with a right lean, then resolves square.

prompt: Tango corte. You advance then freeze in a dramatic side angle.
idea: Advances toward the left, counterturns right into a dramatic left lean, suspends the tango corte, then unfolds square.

prompt: Tango head flick. You hold a poised frame then change the sightline sharply.
idea: Holds a tall rightward tango frame, looks left to prepare the head flick, snaps right, then lets the poised frame soften toward center.

prompt: Salsa cross-body. You open a path then turn back into the rhythm.
idea: Opens the salsa path to the right, looks farther right, returns through a central pulse, then turns left and closes into rhythm.

prompt: Samba bounce. You rise and settle through a rolling phrase.
idea: Sits low into the samba, rebounds through connected vertical pulses, rolls the phrase sideways, then returns level and grounded.

prompt: Rumba settle. You transfer weight slowly and pause into one hip-like lean.
idea: Transfers weight from right through center toward the left, settles into a low right lean, then lets the rumba pause unfold square.

prompt: Cha-cha lock. You mark two small beats before a held turn.
idea: Marks two compact cha-cha beats, pivots left into the lock, holds its lifted shape, then returns square.

prompt: Jive kick. You lean back before a sharp forward accent.
idea: Leans backward with a right tilt for the jive kick, pulses once into the pickup, snaps forward, then rebounds into a relaxed finish.

prompt: Lindy swingout. You open away then return through a sweeping arc.
idea: Open away with torso right and gaze left, look right into the stretch, then sweep left with a swinging return and reunite centrally.

prompt: Foxtrot glide. You travel smoothly through a level turn.
idea: Glides level from a rightward body turn through centered gaze to the left, carries a gentle traveling sway, then closes square.

prompt: Quickstep halt. You bounce through a phrase then arrive square.
idea: Bounces through the quickstep phrase, turns left on the final approach, then arrives tall and square before softening the stance.

prompt: Polka turn. You bounce into a half-turn and settle.
idea: Bounces into the polka on the right, carries the pulse through a leftward half-turn, then brings the dance square and settles.

prompt: Mazurka accent. You rise before emphasizing a late beat.
idea: Rises into the mazurka preparation, lets the late beat hang, then drops its downward accent and rebounds gently.

prompt: Ballet plié. You lower evenly then lengthen upward.
idea: Lowers evenly into the plié, suspends its deepest point, then lengthens upward and steadies tall with open ears.

prompt: Ballet relevé. You rise onto an imagined narrow support and balance.
idea: Rises onto the narrow support, corrects a left lean and then a right one, lets fine balance pulses settle, then lowers slightly.

prompt: Ballet arabesque. You extend into a long lifted diagonal.
idea: Extends forward into the arabesque, lengthens upward with a right tilt, steadies the long diagonal, then returns level.

prompt: Ballet pirouette. You spot a point through a turning phrase.
idea: Finds the pirouette spot left, turns right beneath it, counterturns the gaze left, then finishes the leftward body rotation and snaps to center.

prompt: Ballet port de bras. You follow an imagined overhead arm arc.
idea: Follows the imagined arms from low right through a high central arc, lowers the gaze to the left, then returns gracefully to center.

prompt: Ballet bourrée. You glide with fine sustained motion then stop.
idea: Lengthens tall for the bourrée, glides on fine vertical pulses, lets the steps diminish, then settles into a quiet centered finish.

prompt: Contemporary contraction. You fold inward then release upward.
idea: Folds deeply inward, lets the contraction gather, then releases upward into an open high posture and softens upright.

prompt: Contemporary spiral. You unwind from a low twisted pose.
idea: Coils low with torso right and gaze left, unwinds upward toward the left, carries a small residual sway, then returns square.

prompt: Contemporary fall recovery. You sink off balance then roll back upright.
idea: Sinks off balance into a left roll, passes low through center, rises into the opposite right roll, then settles its recovered balance.

prompt: Jazz isolation. You move the head while keeping the torso square.
idea: Keep the torso square while moving the gaze right-left, isolate a left-right tilt, then center the head.

prompt: Jazz hit. You prepare broadly and land a sharp accent.
idea: Prepares high on the right with a right tilt, snaps into a low centered jazz hit, suspends the accent, then releases the torso square.

prompt: Jazz ripple. You send motion from height through pitch to body.
idea: Send a jazz ripple upward through height, fold the head, roll the torso right-left, then release the wave centrally.

prompt: Hip-hop bounce. You sit into a beat and rebound with grounded weight.
idea: Sits low into the hip-hop beat, rebounds with grounded vertical pulses, gives the phrase a smaller final bounce, then settles.

prompt: Hip-hop pop. You build tension then release a single sharp hit.
idea: Builds a backward loaded posture, releases one sharp forward hip-hop hit, locks it briefly, then eases out of the tension.

prompt: Hip-hop wave. You send a smooth curve across the upper body.
idea: Starts the wave in a left tilt on the right, rises through center, carries the curve left into a right tilt, then levels the finish.

prompt: Locking point. You turn toward a target and freeze on it.
idea: Turns from the right into a leftward locking point, fixes the gaze higher and farther left, freezes the target, then returns square.

prompt: Popping chest hit. You mime a chest pop with height and pitch.
idea: Draws back and up for the chest pop, snaps forward into the hit, locks its compact shape, then lets the frame relax.

prompt: Robot dance isolation. You perform deliberate separated dance angles.
idea: Isolates a rightward head angle, stills it, changes the torso left, stills again, then returns head and body separately to center.

prompt: Breakdance freeze. You rotate into a low held balance.
idea: Turns left to wind into the breakdance balance, rotates right and drops into a left-leaning freeze, then rises square from the hold.

prompt: Breakdance windup. You coil for a floor move then open sideways.
idea: Coils low with torso right and gaze left, opens across the body toward the left with a right lean, rises, then squares up.

prompt: Moonwalk illusion. You lean forward while drifting backward in posture.
idea: Leans forward into the moonwalk illusion, withdraws the body right while the gaze stays left, carries small sliding pulses, then squares the finish.

prompt: Vogue frame. You pose through three sharply framed angles.
idea: Frames the gaze right with a left tilt, pauses, switches left and tilts right into the second frame, then poses briefly before centering.

prompt: Waacking flourish. You follow a rapid overhead flourish and pose.
idea: Follows the flourish high right then high left, turns the body left into a right-tilted pose, freezes the accent, then releases square.

prompt: Krump stomp. You gather low and deliver a forceful downward accent.
idea: Gathers low for the krump accent, rises into a forceful preload, falls into the braced downward stomp, then recovers with controlled weight.

prompt: Flamenco brace. You rise proudly then mark a grounded accent.
idea: Rises proudly into the flamenco brace, suspends the tall preparation, marks one grounded downward accent, then returns to poised height.

prompt: Flamenco turn. You spot forward during a tight torso turn.
idea: Turns the flamenco frame right while spotting left, carries the torso left beneath the gaze, then centers the head before closing the body.

prompt: Kathak spin. You maintain a spot while turning and arriving square.
idea: Finds the kathak spot left, turns right through the first phase, passes the body center into the leftward finish, then brings the gaze and torso square.

prompt: Bharatanatyam glance. You shift gaze precisely before changing the head angle.
idea: Places a precise rightward glance before a left tilt, switches the gaze left before tilting right, then returns both angles to center.

prompt: Odissi curve. You form a soft opposing head and torso curve.
idea: Turns the body right beneath a right-leaning head, flows through the opposite leftward turn and left tilt, then releases the curved pose square.

prompt: Irish step finish. You keep a tall upper body and mark a final landing.
idea: Keeps the upper body tall over subtle Irish-step bounces, rises into the final preparation, lands a compact dip, then regains poise.

prompt: Haka accent. You brace low and deliver a forceful forward phrase.
idea: Braces low to the right, transfers the broad haka stance left, gathers back, then surges forward and holds the phrase before centering.

prompt: Seated dance. You carry rhythm through head and torso only.
idea: Carries the seated rhythm through torso sways, turns left into small nods, then levels the head and closes the body at center.

prompt: Needle threading. You align a thread with a tiny needle eye.
idea: Tilts left over the needle eye, squares the thread, advances low into the opening, then holds the alignment before withdrawing.

prompt: Thread missed. You miss the needle eye then adjust and retry.
idea: Misses the needle eye on a low approach, withdraws, tips left to realign, then straightens into a gentler retry and lifts away.

prompt: Running stitch. You follow three evenly spaced stitches.
idea: Makes a running stitch low right, moves to the left for the next dip, then centers for the third evenly spaced stitch and lifts.

prompt: Backstitch. You move back one stitch before advancing.
idea: Looks low along the seam, retreats one stitch to the right, advances beyond it to the left, then centers to tighten and release.

prompt: Cross stitch. You complete two opposing diagonal threads.
idea: Draws one cross-stitch diagonal from low right to raised left, resets farther right, completes the opposing diagonal toward far left, then centers.

prompt: French knot. You wrap thread then tighten a tiny raised knot.
idea: Wraps the French-knot thread in low right-to-left turns, repeats a small winding motion, then rises to tighten the tiny knot and centers.

prompt: Button sewing. You pass through opposite holes then tighten.
idea: Passes between the button holes low right and left in repeated stitches, then centers and draws back-up to tighten the thread.

prompt: Seam ripping. You lift a stitch and carefully cut it free.
idea: Finds the seam stitch with a low left tilt, lifts it slightly, makes a small downward cut, then straightens to inspect the release.

prompt: Hem folding. You follow an edge and turn it inward.
idea: Follows the hem from low right to left, turns the edge inward at center, presses its fold, then lifts to check the line.

prompt: Pleat pressing. You align folds and press along their tops.
idea: Compares the pleats low right and left, centers their tops, presses along the fold with small working dips, then lifts.

prompt: Pattern pinning. You check a paper edge and secure one corner.
idea: Check the pattern edge low right and left, find its far-left corner, then lift for the pin and dip precisely before centering.

prompt: Fabric cutting. You trace a curve before cutting along it.
idea: Traces the cutting curve low right to left, resets the torso right, then follows the cut through a leftward arc with small scissor pulses and centers.

prompt: Bias tape. You follow a curved seam with a narrow strip.
idea: Follows the bias strip low right around a rightward body curve, sweeps left along the seam, then centers close on the join and lifts.

prompt: Gathering thread. You pull a seam into small folds.
idea: Focuses forward-low on the gathering seam, draws back through small pulling pulses, then inspects the new folds below and releases.

prompt: Elastic threading. You feed elastic through a hidden channel.
idea: Feeds the elastic low through short advances, pauses at resistance, shifts right to guide it, then resumes toward center and lifts away.

prompt: Bobbin winding. You watch thread collect then stop at the rim.
idea: Watches the bobbin winding with a low lateral rhythm, narrows the tracking as it reaches the rim, then stills at center and lifts.

prompt: Bobbin insertion. You lower a bobbin and check that it seats.
idea: Raises the bobbin over its seat, lowers it carefully, checks the final fit with a left tilt, then straightens away.

prompt: Presser foot. You lower a sewing foot then lean close to inspect.
idea: Lowers the presser foot, leans closer into a low inspection, waits on its alignment, then withdraws with relaxed ears.

prompt: Machine seam. You follow fabric feeding steadily through a needle.
idea: Follows the fabric low into the needle, carries its fine sewing pulse, advances to the seam end, then stops and lifts.

prompt: Thread break. You notice a loose thread and stop sewing.
idea: Sews with a low working pulse, halts at the broken thread, follows the loose strand upward, then settles into inspection.

prompt: Knitting cast-on. You form a first loop and inspect its tension.
idea: Forms the first knitting loop with a low right-to-left turn, gives it a small tensioning tug, then centers into a backward check.

prompt: Knit stitch. You dip through a loop and draw a new loop out.
idea: Dips forward through the knit loop, gathers the yarn, draws the new loop upward, then relaxes at working height.

prompt: Purl stitch. You bring yarn forward before drawing it back through.
idea: Brings the yarn forward, folds down through the purl loop, then withdraws level with the new loop and softens the ears.

prompt: Dropped stitch. You follow a fallen loop and lift it back.
idea: Follows the dropped stitch down, catches it low, then lifts the loop back through two small upward stages and settles.

prompt: Cable knitting. You cross two groups of stitches and continue.
idea: Checks the stitch groups low right and left, crosses them with opposing body turns, then centers into a small continuing stitch rhythm.

prompt: Knitting bind-off. You pass a loop over then release the finished edge.
idea: Lifts the bind-off loop across toward the left, releases the finished edge into a lower left view, then centers to admire the line.

prompt: Crochet chain. You repeat two small hook-and-pull motions.
idea: Hook the crochet chain low with a left tilt, pull it upward, repeat the hook-and-pull rhythm, then settle centrally.

prompt: Crochet round. You follow stitches around a circular edge.
idea: Follows the crochet round low from right through a body turn to left, carries small stitch dips around the rim, then centers at the join.

prompt: Crochet undo. You pull back several stitches then inspect the remaining loop.
idea: Draws backward to undo the crochet with several small pulls, then lowers to the remaining loop and briefly stills before lifting.

prompt: Weaving shuttle. You send a shuttle across and pack the row.
idea: Sends the shuttle from right to left, lifts at center for the packing beat, presses the row down, then eases upright.

prompt: Warp tension. You compare threads then pull one taut.
idea: Compares the warp threads low right and left with repeated glances, centers on one, then lifts it taut and steadies the tension.

prompt: Loom treadle. You prepare the shed then pass a shuttle.
idea: Lifts slightly above the loom treadle cue, gives a low beat to open the shed, then follows the shuttle broadly from right to left and centers.

prompt: Basket weaving. You feed a strip around the rim.
idea: Feeds the basket strip low right around a rightward body curve, carries it left with small weaving dips, then closes the join centrally.

prompt: Basket handle. You bend a strip overhead and seat both ends.
idea: Bends the basket handle high from right to left, lowers to seat its right end and then its left end, then returns to inspect the arch.

prompt: Macrame knot. You cross cords then pull the knot upward.
idea: Crosses the macrame cords through right and left turns, draws the knot together centrally, then pulls upward with a small tightening rhythm and releases.

prompt: Tassel trimming. You align hanging ends and cut them level.
idea: Scans down the hanging tassel ends, aligns a level rightward starting point, cuts across to the left, then returns to inspect the trimmed edge.

prompt: Braiding cord. You alternate outer strands over the center.
idea: Brings the right outer braid strand inward, crosses the left strand, repeats the alternating work, then finishes the next right strand at center.

prompt: Lace bobbins. You exchange two bobbins and tighten the crossing.
idea: Exchanges the lace bobbins from right to left and back, repeats a small crossing rhythm, then centers low to tighten the lace and releases.

prompt: Felting needle. You make two careful downward pokes.
idea: Raise the felting needle, make two careful downward pokes in a measured rhythm, then lift away and settle.

prompt: Wet felting. You roll fibers then inspect how they bind.
idea: Rolls the wet fibers with a low torso rhythm, slows the pressure, then tips left for a close binding check and straightens.

prompt: Spinning yarn. You draw fiber outward and watch the twist.
idea: Draws the fiber low right, follows it farther right as it rises into yarn, watches the twist with small tracking pulses, then centers.

prompt: Spindle drop. You watch a suspended spindle descend and wind it back.
idea: Tracks the spindle from high to low, turns right to gather the yarn, winds it back upward toward the left, then returns square.

prompt: Quilting layers. You align corners then press the stack together.
idea: Align the quilt corners low right and left, center the stack and press the layers together, then lift to inspect.

prompt: Patchwork match. You compare two patterned edges before joining.
idea: Compare patterned edges right and left, revisit the right once more, then center close over the matching seam and relax.

prompt: Applique placement. You lower a fabric shape and smooth its edge.
idea: Lowers the applique onto the fabric, smooths its outline from right to left with light working pulses, then lifts from center.

prompt: Embroidery hoop. You tighten a hoop and inspect the fabric plane.
idea: Tightens the embroidery hoop through right-to-left turns, stops the twist, scans the low fabric plane right and left, then returns square.

prompt: Leather punching. You align a hole mark and deliver one sharp press.
idea: Aligns low over the leather mark, rises against the coming punch, gives one sharp downward press, then rebounds to inspect the hole.

prompt: Leather burnishing. You rub an edge until it smooths.
idea: Burnishes the leather edge with low lateral strokes, tips right to inspect the finish, looks left along the edge, then centers.

prompt: Leather lacing. You pass a cord through a hole and draw it tight.
idea: Feeds the lace through the hole low, turns right to draw it out, pulls farther right and upward until taut, then returns square.

prompt: Snap fitting. You align two snap halves and press them together.
idea: Compare both snap halves right and left, center above them and lift to prepare, then snap down and release.

prompt: Bead threading. You feed a bead onto a cord and slide it down.
idea: Focuses close on the bead and cord, lifts the threaded bead, follows its slide downward, then raises the gaze from the finished placement.

prompt: Bead sorting. You compare sizes then place one bead aside.
idea: Compare the beads low-right with a left tilt and low-left with a right tilt, gently weigh their shapes, then place one right and return square.

prompt: Wire wrapping. You circle a bead and tighten the wire tail.
idea: Wraps the wire around the bead from right to left with small winding turns, then draws backward-up to tighten the tail and centers.

prompt: Jewelry clasp. You align two tiny ends and close the clasp.
idea: Check the tiny clasp ends low right and left, bring them together centrally, pause at the fastening, then withdraw.

prompt: Ring sizing. You slide a ring down a gauge and read the mark.
idea: Follows the ring gradually down the sizing gauge, turns slightly left to read its mark, then lifts back toward center.

prompt: Stone setting. You lower a gem into a seat and inspect its tilt.
idea: Lowers the gem precisely into its seat, checks a left tilt and then a right tilt, makes tiny balancing adjustments, then levels.

prompt: Clay centering. You steady a spinning lump until its wobble stops.
idea: Tracks the spinning clay low through its broad wobble, reduces the lateral motion as it centers, then rests over the stable lump and lifts.

prompt: Clay opening. You press into centered clay then widen the hollow.
idea: Presses down into the centered clay, opens the hollow toward the right and left, then follows a small smoothing rhythm before lifting center.

prompt: Pot pulling. You draw a vessel wall upward from its base.
idea: Finds the pot wall at its low base, draws it upward in two steady stages, follows the turning rim with tiny adjustments, then releases.

prompt: Pot collaring. You narrow a tall clay neck gently.
idea: Rises beside the tall clay neck, compresses gently inward and lower, maintains a small centering rhythm, then withdraws from the narrowed form.

prompt: Clay trimming. You follow the foot ring of an inverted pot.
idea: Tracks the inverted pot low right and left through a trimming rhythm, tips left to inspect its underside, then returns square.

prompt: Clay slab. You roll a slab flat and inspect its thickness.
idea: Presses the clay slab forward-down through rolling passes, withdraws toward a low right view to check thickness, then centers.

prompt: Coil building. You place a clay coil around a growing rim.
idea: Places the coil low right, carries it around the body arc to the left while rising slightly, checks both seam ends, then centers the join.

prompt: Clay joining. You score two surfaces then press them together.
idea: Scores the right clay surface with short strokes, checks and scores the left, then joins them in a firm central press and lifts away.

prompt: Glaze dipping. You lower a pot into glaze then lift it to drain.
idea: Dips the pot deeply into glaze, lifts it clear, tips right to drain, then rights it and lowers into a relaxed inspection.

prompt: Glaze brush. You coat an edge then check the coverage.
idea: Brushes glaze along the edge from right to left with small finishing strokes, then raises into a left tilt to check coverage and centers.

prompt: Kiln peeking. You inspect a kiln opening and draw back.
idea: Peers forward into the kiln with a left tilt, withdraws high from the heat into a right tilt, then levels at a comfortable distance.

prompt: Pottery crack. You find a crack and follow its path.
idea: Finds the pottery crack low, tips left to inspect its start, traces its descending line toward the right, then levels at center.

prompt: Sculpting profile. You compare a sculpture from front and side.
idea: Views the sculpture from the right profile, rotates through the left profile, then lowers to a detail and returns for a centered overview.

prompt: Stone chipping. You raise a tool and remove one small chip.
idea: Raises the chipping tool into a tall backward windup, lands one compact low impact, then rebounds to examine the removed chip.

prompt: Wax carving. You pare a tiny curl then inspect the cut.
idea: Leans low through a tiny wax-paring stroke, follows the curl upward to the left, then returns to inspect the cut at center.

prompt: Paper folding. You align two corners and crease the fold.
idea: Align the paper corners right and left, center the fold and crease it firmly downward, then release upright.

prompt: Origami squash. You open a pocket and flatten it symmetrically.
idea: Lift the origami pocket open, spread it symmetrically with a right-left check, then squash the fold low at center and ease off.

prompt: Origami reverse fold. You turn a point inward and re-form its crease.
idea: Turns the origami point inward from right to left under a low gaze, re-forms its crease centrally, then lifts to inspect the reverse fold.

prompt: Origami unfolding. You open a model to inspect an earlier crease.
idea: Starts low over the closed model, opens it broadly from right to left while rising, then centers high to inspect the old crease.

prompt: Paper cutting. You follow a curved outline with small cuts.
idea: Follows the paper outline low right around a rightward body turn, makes small cutting beats, then carries the curve left and returns square.

prompt: Paper tearing. You pull a sheet apart along a scored line.
idea: Loads the paper seam right to left, resets the pull right, then tears left with an upward release and settles square.

prompt: Bookbinding stitch. You pass through a spine hole and tighten thread.
idea: Passes the binding thread through the spine hole low, draws it diagonally backward-up to the right, tensions it with a small tug, then centers.

prompt: Book pressing. You close a cover square and apply pressure.
idea: Check the book cover right and left, close it square and apply slow downward pressure, then release the pressed book.

prompt: Page gilding. You brush a book edge then inspect its sheen.
idea: Brushes the page edge from right to left with fine strokes, then lifts into a left tilt to catch the gilded sheen and returns level.

prompt: Print inking. You roll ink across a plate then check coverage.
idea: Rolls ink forward-down across the plate in steady passes, withdraws to inspect low right and left, then centers above the coverage.

prompt: Block printing. You lower a carved block and press evenly.
idea: Raises the carved block above the paper, lowers it square, sustains even printing pressure, then lifts cleanly from the impression.

prompt: Print peeling. You lift paper slowly to reveal an image.
idea: Finds the paper edge low, peels it steadily upward, pauses over the revealed print, then relaxes into a centered viewing pose.

prompt: Screen printing. You pull a squeegee across a screen.
idea: Sets the squeegee low right under pressure, pulls it across the screen to the left, lifts cleanly at the edge, then returns center.

prompt: Etching inspection. You tilt a plate to see fine lines.
idea: Inspects the etching low, rocks the plate through left and right reflective angles, narrows the rocking to find fine lines, then levels.

prompt: Calligraphy stroke. You begin high and draw one flowing stroke.
idea: Poises high for the calligraphy stroke, flows downward into a leftward gaze and right tilt, completes the low curve, then levels at center.

prompt: Calligraphy dot. You load a brush then set one precise dot.
idea: Loads the brush high, lowers it toward the paper, sets one precise low dot, then lifts lightly from the mark.

prompt: Watercolor wash. You sweep a wet brush then watch pigment spread.
idea: Sweeps the watercolor wash from low right to left, returns close to center, watches the pigment spread, then eases upright.

prompt: Drybrush texture. You skim a surface lightly then inspect the marks.
idea: Skims drybrush texture from right through center to left in light strokes, then lifts into a left tilt to inspect the marks and levels.

prompt: Palette mixing. You circle two colors together then compare the mixture.
idea: Mixes the palette colors in low circling sways, compares the right color with the left, then centers to inspect the resulting mixture.

prompt: Easel stepping-back. You finish a stroke and inspect the whole canvas.
idea: Finish the brushstroke forward-low, draw back into a raised overview, survey the canvas right and left, then rest centered.

prompt: Charcoal shading. You sweep a broad shadow then soften its edge.
idea: Sweeps the charcoal shadow right to left, returns right with a softer touch, feathers the edge with small strokes, then finishes in a gentle central dip.

prompt: Eraser lifting. You lift a highlight with one careful dab.
idea: Focuses low on the highlight, unloads slightly above the paper, makes one careful eraser dab, then lifts to inspect the brightened spot.

prompt: Pencil sharpening. You turn a pencil then inspect its point.
idea: Turns the pencil right and left through sharpening strokes, returns right for the last turn, then inspects the point in a low left tilt and centers.

prompt: Drafting curve. You follow a ruler edge then lift at the endpoint.
idea: Traces the drafting curve low from far right through the two middle points to far left, then lifts cleanly from the endpoint and centers.

prompt: Mosaic placing. You align a small tile within a gap.
idea: Check the mosaic gap from low right and left, align its center, seat the tile with a small dip, then lift away.

prompt: Mosaic grouting. You press grout across gaps then wipe the surface.
idea: Presses grout forward-down into the mosaic gaps, wipes broadly from right to left with small finishing strokes, then lifts at center.

prompt: Collage layering. You lower a paper shape over another and check overlap.
idea: Lower the collage shape onto its layer, inspect the overlap right and left, then press it gently at center and lift.

prompt: Rubber stamp. You align an inked rubber stamp and press it onto paper.
idea: Aligns the stamp in a low left tilt, centers and raises it, presses straight down, then lifts to inspect the printed mark.

prompt: Seal wax. You watch wax pool then lower a seal.
idea: Watches the wax pool low, raises the seal briefly, lowers it into a slow press, then lifts gently after the impression forms.

prompt: Gift bow. You loop ribbon then pull both sides into shape.
idea: Loops the ribbon through low right-to-left turns, shapes the bow with a small alternating pull, then centers and rises to tighten the loops.

prompt: Chess opening. You inspect the center then advance a piece.
idea: Survey the chess center low right and left, align the selected piece, advance it forward-down, then withdraw to review.

prompt: Chess capture. You follow an opposing piece then replace it.
idea: Finds the opposing piece low left, lifts it off the board, returns for the precise replacement dip, then looks back toward center.

prompt: Chess castling. You move attention between king and rook before settling both.
idea: Checks king and rook low right and left, pauses at center, returns right for the second placement, then centers over the castled position.

prompt: Chess promotion. You follow a pawn to the far rank and present its replacement.
