idea: Tracks the pawn from the near rank toward the far side, gathers the replacement low, then rises into a deliberate promotion reveal and settles.

prompt: Chess clock. You finish a move then tap the clock beside the board.
idea: Places the chess piece centrally, lifts against the clock tap, gives a short leftward downward accent, then returns to the board.

prompt: Go stone. You survey intersections and place one stone.
idea: Survey Go intersections low right and left, narrow to a central point, place the stone with a measured dip, then lift to assess.

prompt: Go capture. You inspect a surrounded group and lift it off.
idea: Circles the surrounded Go group low from right around to left, stops over its center, then lifts the captured stones away and squares up.

prompt: Checkers jump. You follow a piece hopping over two opponents.
idea: Follow the checker through two clear upward hops and landings, then lift the gaze from the completed double jump.

prompt: Backgammon roll. You roll dice then follow their landing.
idea: Wind low-right and toss the dice up-left, follow their landing right and left, then center to read the result.

prompt: Domino chain. You place a tile at the end of a growing line.
idea: Follows the domino line from far right through near right to the left end, places the tile with a short dip, then returns center.

prompt: Domino topple. You watch a chain fall across the table.
idea: Tracks the falling dominoes from right through the middle to left, follows their final little pulses, then stops and returns center.

prompt: Mahjong draw. You draw a tile inspect it and return to the rack.
idea: Retrieves the mahjong tile low right, lifts it into a left tilt for inspection, then straightens and lowers it into the central rack.

prompt: Mahjong discard. You scan a hand and place one tile forward.
idea: Scan the mahjong hand low right and left, choose a central tile, then advance it into the discard and withdraw.

prompt: Scrabble placement. You line up a word across the board.
idea: Place the word from right through center to left, punctuating its placement with small regular dips, then center over the completed row.

prompt: Word tile swap. You remove one tile and compare its replacement.
idea: Inspects the unwanted word tile low right, lifts it aside toward the left, checks its replacement, then returns to the central row.

prompt: Jigsaw corner. You find a corner piece and test its fit.
idea: Search right and left for the corner piece, tilt left to align it, then straighten into a careful seating press and lift.

prompt: Jigsaw mismatch. You try a piece then rotate it and retry.
idea: Try the piece downward and lift at the mismatch, rotate it right-left, then square up for a slower second fit.

prompt: Jigsaw last piece. You align the final gap and seat the piece.
idea: Studies the last jigsaw gap closely, raises the piece to align it, seats it gently, then lingers over the completed picture with relaxed ears.

prompt: Rubik layer. You inspect three faces and turn one layer.
idea: Check the cube's right and left faces, lower to the third, turn one layer right-left, then square up to verify.

prompt: Rubik algorithm. You follow a short sequence then verify the top face.
idea: Works the cube algorithm through alternating right and left turns, repeats its turning rhythm, then raises into a left tilt to verify the top face.

prompt: Tangram fitting. You rotate a triangle into a narrow gap.
idea: Inspect the tangram gap in a low left tilt, rotate the triangle right-left, then straighten and seat it centrally.

prompt: Sliding puzzle. You track a tile entering the empty square.
idea: Looks across the sliding puzzle from low right to left, follows the chosen tile into the central empty square, then pauses and lifts.

prompt: Sokoban push. You line up a box then push it onto a target.
idea: Aligns low behind the Sokoban box, leans into a steady forward push, stops over the target, then withdraws square.

prompt: Maze tracing. You follow a corridor then turn at a junction.
idea: Traces the maze corridor forward-low, pauses at the junction, turns onto the rightward route, then follows it inward toward center.

prompt: Maze dead end. You reach a dead end and backtrack to another branch.
idea: Reaches the maze dead end low, stops, draws backward along the corridor, turns right onto another branch, then returns centered.

prompt: Memory cards. You turn two cards and compare them.
idea: Turns the first memory card low right, lifts between reveals, turns the second low left, then centers to compare their faces.

prompt: Memory mismatch. You turn two unlike cards back down.
idea: Compare the mismatched cards right and left, return to each for a face-down dip, then center over the closed pair.

prompt: Card dealing. You place cards in three distinct positions.
idea: Deals a card to the right, moves left for the next placement, then returns center for the third distinct dip and lifts away.

prompt: Card shuffling. You riffle two stacks and square the deck.
idea: Checks the two card stacks low right and left, turns them inward, ripples a quick riffle, then squares the deck with a central press.

prompt: Card fan. You open a hand of cards and inspect its span.
idea: Opens the card fan low, surveys it from far right through the middle to far left, then returns to a centered view of the hand.

prompt: Card cut. You lift one stack and replace it beside the other.
idea: Lifts the cut stack from low center, carries it left, lowers it beside the other stack, then returns to inspect the squared deck.

prompt: Poker chip. You slide a small stack into the middle.
idea: Checks the chip stack low right, centers behind it, pushes it forward into the middle, then draws back to watch.

prompt: Chip stacking. You align a chip above a tower and lower it.
idea: Aligns a chip above the tower, lowers it carefully, tips left to check the stack, then levels after the placement.

prompt: Chip spill. You follow a stack collapsing and gather it.
idea: Watch the chip stack high and follow its collapse, gather loose chips inward from both sides, then center the rebuilt pile.

prompt: Dice tower. You drop dice at the top and watch the exit.
idea: Looks high to drop the dice into the tower, waits for their descent, snaps the gaze down to the exit, then settles to read the result.

prompt: Dice cocked. You inspect a tilted die and reroll it.
idea: Inspects the cocked die with a low left tilt then a right tilt, lifts to reroll, releases it downward, then levels to read it.

prompt: Board spinner. You flick a spinner and follow its slowing pointer.
idea: Loads the spinner from the right, flicks left, follows its quick pointer oscillations as they slow, then centers over the stopped result.

prompt: Bingo mark. You find a called square and mark it.
idea: Scan the bingo grid low right and left, locate the called square, make one compact marking dip, then lift.

prompt: Bingo line check. You verify a completed row from end to end.
idea: Verifies the bingo row from far right through both middle sections to far left, then returns center and rests over the completed line.

prompt: Ludo move. You count spaces along a winding track.
idea: Counts the Ludo spaces low from right to left, turns along the elbow toward farther left, then stops at the destination and centers.

prompt: Race token. You follow a token crossing the finish line.
idea: Follows the race token low from right across the track to left, rises as it crosses the finish, then returns to a relaxed center.

prompt: Marbles aim. You lower to the line and sight a target marble.
idea: Lowers level to the marble line, leans into the sightline, stills the aim briefly, then eases away from the target.

prompt: Marbles flick. You prepare a small flick and follow the result.
idea: Aims low, draws back a little against the flick, sends a short forward beat, then tracks the marble left and back toward center.

prompt: Jacks scoop. You watch a ball rise then look down to collect.
idea: Watches the jacks ball rise, switches quickly down to collect below, then lifts toward its return and settles after the catch.

prompt: Knucklebones catch. You follow tossed pieces and catch them level.
idea: Loads the knucklebones low, follows their toss high, levels for the catch, briefly stills its arrival, then relaxes.

prompt: Pickup sticks. You inspect a crossing and lift one stick free.
idea: Studies the pickup-stick crossing low with a left tilt, straightens on the chosen stick, lifts it slowly without turning, then settles clear.

prompt: Jenga test. You probe a block and stop when the tower shifts.
idea: Probes the Jenga block forward-low, freezes when the tower shifts, withdraws carefully, then lifts to reassess with attentive ears.

prompt: Jenga removal. You ease a loose block out and look up at the tower.
idea: Finds the loose Jenga block low right, eases it farther right and out through a body turn, then looks up the tower and returns square.

prompt: Jenga placement. You raise a block and place it on top.
idea: Retrieves the Jenga block low, raises it to the tower top, lowers it a little into its placement, then holds high to check stability.

prompt: Tower collapse. You follow a toppling structure down to the table.
idea: Watches the tower high, follows its rightward tilt, descends with the collapse, then stops low and gradually lifts from the fallen pieces.

prompt: Connect four. You drop a disc and follow it down the column.
idea: Drops the disc high on the left, follows it straight down the column, then lifts from its resting place and centers.

prompt: Battleship grid. You scan coordinates then mark one location.
idea: Scan the coordinates right and left, lower to the chosen Battleship row, mark its central location, then lift.

prompt: Reversi flip. You turn a row of captured discs.
idea: Flips a captured disc low right, advances left for the second flip, then centers for the third downward beat and withdraws.

prompt: Mancala sowing. You follow seeds dropping into successive pits.
idea: Sows seeds into a right pit with small dropping dips, moves left for the next pit, then reaches farther left to finish and centers.

prompt: Mancala collection. You gather a pit and carry seeds to the store.
idea: Gathers the mancala seeds low right, lifts and carries them across to the left store, lowers at its far edge, then returns center.

prompt: Crokinole shot. You sight a disc toward the center hole.
idea: Sights the crokinole disc low toward the center hole, draws back slightly, releases a compact forward flick, then lifts to track the shot.

prompt: Carrom rebound. You check a cushion angle before flicking.
idea: Checks the carrom line low right and the cushion far left, centers the intended rebound, then prepares and flicks forward before recovering.

prompt: Shuffleboard push. You send a puck along a long table.
idea: Leans low behind the shuffleboard puck, sends it forward in a long push, then raises the gaze to watch its distant glide and settles.

prompt: Ring toss. You sight a peg and follow a thrown ring.
idea: Sights the ring peg high, draws back with a right tilt, follows the throw upward to the left, then levels after its descending arc.

prompt: Horseshoe toss. You swing low then release toward a stake.
idea: Swings the horseshoe low to the right, coils the torso back, then releases upward across to the left and follows its landing before centering.

prompt: Beanbag toss. You gather a soft underhand throw and follow its landing.
idea: Gathers the beanbag low, lifts into a soft underhand release toward the left, then follows it down to the target and centers.

prompt: Cup stacking. You build a small pyramid then check its peak.
idea: Builds the cup pyramid with low placements right and left, centers for the upper cup, then lifts to inspect the peak.

prompt: Cup unstacking. You take the top cup and collapse the rows inward.
idea: Lifts the top cup high, collapses the right and left rows inward below, then centers the nested stack and relaxes.

prompt: Speed puzzle. You move quickly until one piece jams.
idea: Works the speed puzzle low right and left in quick repeated moves, halts at the jam, then tips left for a close inspection and centers.

prompt: Balance toy. You counter a wobble on a small platform.
idea: Counters the toy's left wobble with a right correction, returns through a smaller left catch, then damps the oscillation into centered balance.

prompt: Ball maze. You tilt a board to guide a ball around a bend.
idea: Tilts the ball maze left, follows the ball low right through a rightward body turn, tilts right around the bend, then levels at the leftward exit.

prompt: Labyrinth drop. You watch a ball fall through a hole and reset.
idea: Track the labyrinth ball low right and left, drop the gaze as it falls through the hole, then rise to the right start and center.

prompt: Magnetic fishing. You lower a line onto a moving target.
idea: Lowers the magnetic line from high to low, follows the moving target with small lateral sweeps, then centers over the catch and lifts slightly.

prompt: Fishing game lift. You catch a target and lift it clear.
idea: Fixes on the caught fishing target low, waits for the magnetic grip, lifts it steadily clear, then steadies the dangling prize.

prompt: Claw machine. You align over a prize then descend and lift.
idea: Compare the claw's right and left alignment, center above the prize, descend deeply, then lift the grab and steady.

prompt: Pinball flipper. You track a ball downfield and react at the bottom.
idea: Tracks the pinball from high downfield to the flipper, snaps upward at its return, then follows the rebound into a relaxed raised watch.

prompt: Pinball tilt. You stop an overlarge nudge and wait.
idea: Sways with the pinball nudge, overleans right, arrests the motion square, then waits through the tilt before relaxing.

prompt: Arcade steering. You follow a curve then straighten at the exit.
idea: Looks into the left arcade curve, banks right, brings the body left beneath the sightline, then straightens at the exit and releases the turn.

prompt: Arcade brake. You notice an obstacle and brace to stop.
idea: Travels forward-low toward the arcade obstacle, recoils backward with a right tilt to brake, then levels and settles after the stop.

prompt: Platform game jump. You judge a gap then track a leap and landing.
idea: Checks the platform gap low, crouches for the jump, tracks a high leap, then cushions the landing downward and rises level.

prompt: Platform missed jump. You follow a failed leap then prepare a retry.
idea: Crouches for the platform leap, follows it upward, drops too far at the miss, then resets into another poised crouch.

prompt: Rhythm game hold. You hit one note and sustain it until release.
idea: Raises for the rhythm-game note, strikes downward, sustains the hold still, then lifts gradually at the release and settles.

prompt: Rhythm game alternation. You follow notes crossing from side to side.
idea: Follows rhythm notes right then left through separate beats, carries the alternating pulse, returns right for the last note, then centers.

prompt: Racing apex. You look through a corner and lean into the exit.
idea: Looks far left through the racing apex, banks right into the turn, brings the body left beneath the gaze, then straightens toward the exit.

prompt: Flight simulator. You pull up over a ridge then level out.
idea: Flies forward-low toward the ridge, pulls strongly upward over it, makes small leveling corrections, then settles into level flight.

prompt: Submarine periscope. You scan above the horizon then lower the scope.
idea: Raise the periscope level, sweep right then left above the horizon, center, then lower straight out of view.

prompt: Escape-room dial. You read a clue and turn a numbered wheel.
idea: Reads the clue low right and left, turns the escape-room dial through opposing body motions, then stops at the number and centers.

prompt: Combination lock. You turn past a number then reverse to the next.
idea: Turns the combination lock right to its stop, reverses left to the next number, returns right for the last setting, then releases square.

prompt: Puzzle box seam. You inspect a hidden seam and slide a panel.
idea: Inspects the puzzle seam low with a left tilt and rightward gaze, levels while sliding the panel farther right, then centers close and lifts.

prompt: Puzzle box opening. You lift a released lid and look inside.
idea: Finds the released lid low, follows it upward, leans down into the open puzzle box, then withdraws to inspect its contents.

prompt: Treasure map. You trace a route and stop at a marked crossing.
idea: Traces the map from low right toward a leftward branch, turns inward along the route, then stops centrally at the marked crossing and lifts.

prompt: Scavenger shelf. You search a shelf then inspect beneath one object.
idea: Searches the shelf level from right to left, finds an object, dips beneath it with a left tilt, then returns square from the clue check.

prompt: Scavenger high clue. You spot a clue above a doorway.
idea: Search low right and left, spot the high-right clue and lift sharply to it, then hold the sightline before centering.

prompt: Stacking stones. You set a stone and check its balance from both sides.
idea: Sets the stone downward, checks its balance with left and right tilts, makes tiny settling corrections, then levels above the stack.

prompt: Sandcastle mold. You press a bucket then lift it vertically.
idea: Presses the sandcastle bucket deeply into the sand, sustains the packing load, then lifts it straight up and pauses over the revealed form.

prompt: Sandcastle repair. You inspect a crumbled wall and press it back.
idea: Inspect the crumbled wall low right and left, tilt left to judge damage, then press carefully at center and lift away.

prompt: Paper airplane launch. You draw back and send a folded plane forward.
idea: Draws the paper plane backward-high with torso right and gaze left, sends it forward, follows it farther left, then returns square.

prompt: Paper plane stall. You watch a plane climb stop and dive.
idea: Follows the paper plane climbing high, stills at its stall, tracks the steep dive downward, then lifts from its landing.

prompt: Kite string feed. You watch a kite rise and let out more line.
idea: Watches the kite rising high right, lets out line with small feeding pulses, dips to check the spool, then returns to its high centered flight.

prompt: Kite dive recovery. You follow a diving kite and pull it upward.
idea: Follows the kite high left into a steep dive, pulls it back upward with a firm recovery, then steadies its raised flight and centers.

prompt: Remote car slalom. You follow a tiny car weaving between cones.
idea: Tracks the remote car low right before the torso follows, switches gaze left ahead of the body, then follows another rightward weave and centers.

prompt: Remote boat turn. You watch a boat carve a broad arc.
idea: Watches the boat level from the right, turns the torso through its broad arc, follows it left, then returns square after the curve.

prompt: Model train coupling. You watch two cars meet and check the join.
idea: Watches the train cars approach from low right and left, centers on their meeting point, then leans close to check the coupling and withdraws.

prompt: Model train derailment. You follow a wheel leaving the track then inspect it.
idea: Tracks the train wheel low right to left, stops as it leaves the rail, tips left into a close examination, then centers.

prompt: Slot car restart. You replace a car in its groove and follow it away.
idea: Seats the slot car low right, follows it farther right as it starts, tracks its long run across to the left, then returns centered.

prompt: Microscope focus. You bring a specimen into focus and recheck after overshooting.
idea: Lower toward the microscope, turn the focus right-left past sharpness, withdraw slightly, then retry lower and settle centered.

prompt: Microscope slide. You scan across a slide then stop over one feature.
idea: Scan the slide low right-left, return to the right-hand feature, then center close and maintain the viewing pose.

prompt: Telescope sight. You find a distant point then settle at the eyepiece.
idea: Search the telescope field high right-left, center the distant point, lean into the eyepiece with a left tilt, then level the view.

prompt: Binocular focus. You scan a distant ridge and pause to adjust.
idea: Scans the ridge right to left, lowers to adjust the binoculars through opposing turns, then repeats a broader level scan and settles square.

prompt: Spectroscope. You align a narrow slit and hold the viewing angle.
idea: Aligns the spectroscope low with a left tilt, corrects right, then straightens and advances into a sustained viewing angle.

prompt: Magnifying glass. You raise a lens over a tiny mark and adjust its distance.
idea: Brings the magnifier close to the mark, withdraws to adjust distance, returns a smaller amount, then holds the sharpened low view.

prompt: Petri dish. You rotate a dish while comparing separate colonies.
idea: Lowers to the petri dish, rotates it right to left while comparing colonies, makes a smaller inspection turn, then centers and releases the body.

prompt: Pipette aspiration. You lower a tip and draw liquid before lifting it clear.
idea: Lowers the pipette tip into the liquid, pauses for aspiration, lifts clear in two careful stages, then steadies the filled tip.

prompt: Pipette dispensing. You move a filled tip over a well and release one drop.
idea: Carries the filled pipette high on the left, centers over the well, lowers carefully, releases one drop with a tiny dip, then lifts clear.

prompt: Pipette bubble. You notice an air bubble and reset the draw.
idea: Stills low at the pipette bubble, withdraws, inspects the tip in a left tilt, then straightens for a slower aspiration retry and lifts.

prompt: Burette reading. You lower to eye level and inspect the meniscus.
idea: Sinks level beside the burette scale, corrects a left tilt and then a right one, makes a final small leveling sway, then reads the meniscus.

prompt: Titration endpoint. You add one final drop and watch the color settle.
idea: Poises above the titration, adds the final drop with a small dip, watches the color settle low, then lifts for a clearer endpoint view.

prompt: Test tube swirl. You mix a tube gently and inspect the liquid.
idea: Swirls the test tube with a gentle low body rhythm, lifts into a left tilt to inspect the liquid, then levels and returns square.

prompt: Test tube rack. You place a tube upright in a narrow socket.
idea: Centers the tube high above the rack, lowers into the socket, checks the seat with opposing tilts, then levels above it.

prompt: Centrifuge balance. You compare opposing tubes before closing the lid.
idea: Compares the opposing centrifuge tubes low right and left with a second checking pass, then centers to lower the lid and withdraws.

prompt: Centrifuge stop. You wait for a rotor to stop before looking inside.
idea: Follows the slowing rotor low, stops tracking as it stills, waits, then leans inside with a left tilt and returns centered.

prompt: Vortex mixer. You hold a tube through a burst and inspect the mixture.
idea: Holds the tube low through a fast vortex burst, arrests the vibration, then raises it into a left-tilted inspection and levels.

prompt: Magnetic stirrer. You watch a vortex form then center your gaze on it.
idea: Watches the magnetic stirrer circle low from right to left, narrows its tracking toward the vortex center, then holds and withdraws.

prompt: Balance pan. You place a sample and wait for the reading to stabilize.
idea: Lowers the sample onto the balance pan, waits for the display to stabilize, approaches for a second low reading, then withdraws.

prompt: Analytical balance. You close a draft shield then read the display.
idea: Closes the draft shield through a right-to-left turn, centers low on the analytical display, briefly stills to read it, then releases the body.

prompt: Calibration weight. You lower a reference weight and compare the reading.
idea: Lowers the reference weight, pauses on the scale reading, lifts slightly to compare, then returns low for confirmation and eases upright.

prompt: Graduated cylinder. You pour toward a mark then stop at eye level.
idea: Tips right to pour toward the cylinder mark, levels and sinks to the meniscus, corrects a slight left tilt, then stills the reading.

prompt: Volumetric flask. You mix by inversion then inspect the fill line.
idea: Inverts the flask through a low right-to-left turn, repeats the mixing pitch rhythm, then raises it to a level fill-line inspection and centers.

prompt: Separating funnel. You watch layers settle before opening the lower valve.
idea: Watches the funnel layers settle along a vertical view, lowers to the valve, turns it right to left, then checks the bottom at center.

prompt: Filtration funnel. You follow liquid through a funnel into a receiving flask.
idea: Follow liquid from the high funnel down to the receiving flask, pause at the flow, then compare the vessels right and left and center.

prompt: Filter clog. You notice flow slowing and inspect the filter surface.
idea: Follows the slowing flow downward, pauses at the clog, lifts to the filter surface with a left tilt, then straightens after inspecting it.

prompt: Vacuum seal. You press a chamber lid and watch a gauge respond.
idea: Presses the vacuum chamber lid down, rises toward the gauge on the left, watches its response, then returns centered.

prompt: Desiccator opening. You release a lid slowly and inspect the sample below.
idea: Releases the desiccator lid slowly upward, turns it aside to the right, looks farther right, then lowers into the chamber and centers.

prompt: Hotplate warning. You approach a heated vessel and draw back from heat.
idea: Approaches the heated vessel forward-low, draws back high with a right tilt from the heat, then levels into a more distant watch.

prompt: Thermocouple probe. You position a probe and wait for a stable reading.
idea: Positions the thermocouple precisely low, briefly stills for the reading, rises toward the display on the left, then returns centered.

prompt: Thermal camera. You scan a surface and stop on a warm patch.
idea: Scans the thermal surface level right through center to left, narrows onto the warm patch nearer left, then lowers for inspection and centers.

prompt: Multimeter range. You check a dial and then a pair of probes.
idea: Read the dial low in a left tilt, turn the setting right-left, compare both probe tips, then straighten square.

prompt: Oscilloscope trace. You watch a waveform settle after an adjustment.
idea: Watches the waveform level, lowers into a right-to-left control adjustment, then returns to the screen and lets its tracking rhythm settle.

prompt: Signal generator. You turn a control and follow the resulting display.
idea: Turns the signal control from right through center to left under a low gaze, then raises to the changed display and squares the body.

prompt: Optical bench. You sight along a beam path and align a mirror.
idea: Sinks level along the optical path, tips left to align the mirror, makes tiny angular corrections, then straightens into the fixed beam sightline.

prompt: Laser alignment. You follow a spot toward a marked target.
idea: Tracks the laser spot right through center to left, stops short of the target, advances slightly into a right tilt, then centers after alignment.

prompt: Prism spectrum. You follow separated colors across a projected band.
idea: Follows the spectrum from high right through the central colors to low left, pauses at the far band, then returns level at center.

prompt: Polarizer turn. You rotate a filter and watch the light fade.
idea: Turns the polarizer from right to left beneath a level gaze, slows as the light fades, then holds the darkened view and returns square.

prompt: Diffraction pattern. You compare a central bright point with side bands.
idea: Studies the central diffraction point, compares the right and left bands, checks a small side-to-side difference, then returns to the bright center.

prompt: Lens focusing. You move a lens until an image sharpens.
idea: Approaches the lens focus, withdraws after overshooting, returns a shorter distance, then holds the sharpened image in view.

prompt: Pendulum timing. You follow a swinging bob and mark its return.
idea: Follows the pendulum right through center and left, carries its steady swing, then marks a return at the center crossing and releases.

prompt: Spring extension. You watch a weight stretch a spring downward.
idea: Watches the weight high, follows the spring stretching downward in stages, tracks its small settling bounce, then holds the low endpoint.

prompt: Resonance test. You observe a vibration grow then stop the drive.
idea: Observes a level vibration beginning small, watches resonance grow, stops the drive into stillness, then lowers to inspect the settled system.

prompt: Balance beam scale. You compare two pans and follow the beam leveling.
idea: Compares the beam-scale pans low right and left, follows the beam through opposing tilts, then lets a smaller oscillation settle level at center.

prompt: Pulley experiment. You follow one weight rising as another falls.
idea: Checks the right pulley weight low and the left weight high, follows their exchanged heights, then centers between the opposing loads.

prompt: Inclined plane. You release a small cart and follow it downhill.
idea: Watches the cart poised high right, releases it down the incline toward the left, follows its arrival low, then lifts back center.

prompt: Friction test. You push until an object slips then follow its motion.
idea: Leans forward against friction, pauses under the load, follows the sudden slip into a leftward turn, then tracks farther left and releases square.

prompt: Density float. You lower an object and watch where it settles.
idea: Lowers the object into the liquid, follows its slight buoyant rise, watches small settling bobs, then holds at the floating level.

prompt: Capillary rise. You watch a thin liquid column climb.
idea: Watches the capillary column low, rises through two quiet stages as it climbs, then holds the final elevated level with attentive ears.

prompt: Surface tension. You place a tiny object on water without breaking the surface.
idea: Lowers the tiny object slowly toward the water, pauses just above the surface, settles the last small distance, then withdraws gently.

prompt: Soap film. You raise a loop and inspect the stretched film.
idea: Raises the soap-film loop from low, checks its reflected colors in left and right tilts, then lets a small angle correction settle level.

prompt: Bubble wand. You follow a bubble leaving a loop and drifting upward.
idea: Leans toward the bubble wand, follows the bubble rising to the left, tracks its gentle drift nearer center, then eases upright.

prompt: Electroscope. You watch leaves separate after a charge.
idea: Studies the electroscope low, follows the charged leaves opening right and left, tracks their small settling movement, then centers.

prompt: Magnet attraction. You bring two objects close and react to their sudden meeting.
idea: Brings the magnets gradually close, lifts slightly against their pull, snaps low as they meet, then freezes briefly and releases.

prompt: Degaussing pass. You sweep a tool across a metal part and withdraw it gradually.
idea: Sweeps the degaussing tool level right through center to left, withdraws upward in stages, then dips into a left-tilted inspection and centers.

prompt: Compass settling. You turn a compass and wait for the needle to align.
idea: Turns the compass right then left, watches the needle swing low, narrows the tracking as it settles, then returns square.

prompt: Geiger scan. You move a detector across samples and stop at one.
idea: Sweep the detector over samples low right and left, center on the selected region, then lean closer for a sustained reading and withdraw.

prompt: Cloud chamber. You watch a thin track form and follow its curve.
idea: Waits low for the cloud-chamber track, follows its curve right through a torso turn to the left, then centers at its fading endpoint.

prompt: Crystal growth. You inspect a crystal from several angles.
idea: Lowers to the crystal, tilts left then right to compare its faces, rocks through a smaller reflection check, then rises for an overview.

prompt: Rock cleavage. You turn a mineral to inspect a flat face.
idea: Turns the mineral low from right to left, tips left into its cleavage reflection, then levels the head and returns the body square.

prompt: Streak plate. You drag a mineral across a plate and inspect the line.
idea: Aligns the mineral low right, draws it across the plate from far right to left, then returns nearer the central streak for a close check.

prompt: Mohs scratch. You try a surface then inspect whether it marked.
idea: Attempts a low forward scratch, stops at resistance, withdraws into a left tilt to inspect the mark, then straightens.

prompt: Sediment layers. You trace strata from bottom to top.
idea: Starts at the bottom sediment layer, rises through two distinct strata, then holds the upper band before relaxing the ears.

prompt: Soil sieve. You shake a soil sample then inspect the retained grains.
idea: Shakes the soil sample in a low sideways rhythm, stops over the retained grains, then dips close with a left tilt and levels.

prompt: Core sample. You follow a long core and pause at a color change.
idea: Scans the core from far right through the middle to the left, stops at its color change, then leans closer and returns centered.

prompt: Fossil brush. You brush dust away and lean closer to a revealed edge.
idea: Brushes fossil dust from right to left with short strokes, centers over the revealed edge, then leans closer in a left tilt and straightens.

prompt: Fossil plaster. You wrap a fragile find and inspect its covered edge.
idea: Follows the plaster wrap around the find with low turning motion, checks its seam from right and left, then lifts clear at center.

prompt: Survey level. You sight a distant staff then check the instrument.
idea: Sights the distant staff level, dips to check the survey instrument, returns to the same sightline, then sustains the reading with relaxed ears.

prompt: Theodolite turn. You rotate toward a second marker and sight it.
idea: Turns the theodolite from right through center toward the left marker, sights farther left level, pauses on the bearing, then returns square.

prompt: GPS fix. You hold a receiver clear and wait for a position.
idea: Raises the receiver clear, waits for a GPS fix, lowers to inspect the screen, then raises again and steadies the presentation.

prompt: Weather vane. You follow a vane turning into the wind.
idea: Follows the raised weather vane from right through center to left, tracks its small wind-driven corrections, then centers as it aligns.

prompt: Anemometer. You watch cups spin then read a nearby gauge.
idea: Tracks the anemometer cups high with a circling torso rhythm, lets the gaze settle, then lowers to read the nearby gauge.

prompt: Rain gauge. You lower to read accumulated water.
idea: Lowers level to the rain-gauge line, tips slightly left for the meniscus, corrects the view, then holds its reading and rises.

prompt: Barometer tap. You tap a dial gently then watch its needle.
idea: Looks level at the barometer on the left, lifts slightly for a gentle tap, nods once, then returns to watch the needle and centers.

prompt: Thermometer column. You follow a liquid column to its top.
idea: Follows the thermometer column from low to its top, pauses on the level, checks just below it, then eases into a relaxed reading pose.

prompt: Seismograph. You follow a trace then inspect a sudden spike.
idea: Follows the seismograph trace from right through center to left, lifts sharply at the spike, then returns low to inspect the line and centers.

prompt: Water sample. You lower a bottle below the surface then cap it.
idea: Lowers the sample bottle below the surface, pauses to fill it, lifts clear, then closes the cap with right-to-left turns and squares up.

prompt: Swab collection. You touch a small area then withdraw carefully.
idea: Advances the swab low onto the small target, maintains a brief contact, collects with tiny strokes, then retreats carefully along the same line.

prompt: Agar streak. You trace separate passes across a dish.
idea: Streaks the agar from low right to left, lifts to reset right, draws a second separated pass left, then clears the dish at center.

prompt: Culture inspection. You hold a dish to light and look across its underside.
idea: Raises the culture dish toward the light, tilts left to inspect its underside, makes small reflective adjustments, then levels while lowering.

prompt: Incubator check. You open a door and look across shelves.
idea: Opens the incubator toward the right, looks farther right at a high shelf, turns left to inspect the lower shelf, then returns square.

prompt: Freezer sample. You search a cold rack and lift one tube.
idea: Search the freezer rack low right-left, lift the chosen tube clear, then turn left to withdraw and return square.

prompt: Cryovial cap. You check a label then twist a cap closed.
idea: Reads the cryovial label low right and left, twists the cap through opposing turns, gives a smaller snugging turn, then centers to confirm closure.

prompt: Sample label. You align a label and smooth it around a tube.
idea: Aligns the sample label low, smooths it around the tube from right to left, gives its seam small finishing presses, then stills and releases.

prompt: Barcode sample. You present a label to a reader and wait for recognition.
idea: Presents the barcode from the right, aligns it centrally, checks a leftward angle, then centers for recognition and lowers the sample.

prompt: Lab notebook. You compare a result with a written row.
idea: Reads the result level, lowers toward the notebook on the right, compares the display again, then returns to the written row and settles center.

prompt: Stopwatch trial. You wait for an event then mark its start and finish.
idea: Waits high for the timed event, dips to mark its start, rises through the interval, dips to mark the finish, then returns to watch.

prompt: Replicate measurement. You measure once reset and verify a second reading.
idea: Takes the first measurement close and low, rises to reset, pauses, then returns to the same point for a confirming reading and withdraws.

prompt: Failed calibration. You notice a mismatch reset then repeat slowly.
idea: Notices the calibration mismatch level, lowers into a right-to-left reset, then rises for a longer careful verification and squares up.

prompt: Unstable reading. You hold still while a display settles then recheck.
idea: Maintains a low focus through the unstable display, waits for settling, approaches a little for a second read, then holds that view before withdrawing.

prompt: Air bubble removal. You tap a tube and inspect the top.
idea: Raises slightly above the tube, taps twice with gentle nods, then follows the freed bubble upward and rests at the top.

prompt: Meniscus overshoot. You notice a fill pass the mark and withdraw.
idea: Watches the fill low, follows it just past the meniscus mark, briefly stills at the overshoot, then withdraws upward to stop pouring.

prompt: Balance overload. You remove a load and wait for the scale to recover.
idea: Lowers to remove the overload, raises it aside to the left, returns to a fixed low display view, then waits for the balance to recover.

prompt: Probe slipped. You lose contact and reposition before reading again.
idea: Approaches the probe contact low, drops as it slips, checks the motion, then lifts to realign and returns slowly for another reading.

prompt: Lens fogging. You pull back from a hazy eyepiece and wait.
idea: Withdraws upward from the foggy eyepiece, turns left while waiting for it to clear, then returns cautiously to a close central view.

prompt: Focus retry. You overshoot a sharp image then reverse the adjustment.
idea: Turn focus right-left past sharpness, pause and reverse a smaller amount right, then center low on the recovered image.

prompt: Tripod settling. You check a wobbling instrument and let it settle.
idea: Follows the tripod wobble through left and right corrections, lets the smaller rocking fade, then lowers into a still instrument check.

prompt: Specimen handoff. You raise a labeled sample and hold it for inspection.
idea: Read the specimen label low right and left, raise the sample centrally, then make a small confirming dip and hold it steady.

prompt: Lab shutdown. You check an instrument then lower its cover.
idea: Inspects the instrument level before shutdown, raises slightly to take the cover, lowers it into place, then eases away from the closed unit.

prompt: Tent pole. You feed a flexible pole through a sleeve.
idea: Feeds the tent pole along the sleeve from low right to left with small advances, then follows the forming arch upward and centers.

prompt: Tent raising. You lift a tent frame and hold its peak.
idea: Compresses beneath the tent frame, raises it tall, checks the upper right and left sides, then steadies the peak before relaxing center.

prompt: Tent peg. You sight a peg and drive it into firm ground.
idea: Sights the peg low, raises for a first firm downbeat, resets above it, strikes again, then lifts to check its depth.

prompt: Peg resistance. You meet a rock then relocate a tent peg.
idea: Raises above the peg, strikes down against rock, checks the right position, relocates left, then lifts and makes a slower retry before centering.

prompt: Guyline tension. You pull a line taut then check the tent wall.
idea: Pulls the guyline backward and up, tightens it with small loaded tugs, then looks forward at the tensioned wall and settles.

prompt: Tent zip. You follow an arched zipper around an opening.
idea: Follows the tent zipper from low right around the far-right side, climbs over the arch, descends the left edge, then returns centered below.

prompt: Sleeping bag roll. You compress a sleeping bag and roll it tightly.
idea: Compresses the sleeping bag low, rolls it through compact right-to-left body turns, repeats the packing pressure, then releases square.

prompt: Groundsheet spread. You open a sheet and inspect its corners.
idea: Opens the groundsheet broadly right to left, centers above it, checks both low corners, then returns to inspect the spread.

prompt: Camp stove. You check a burner then draw back after ignition.
idea: Dips close to check the camp burner, pauses at ignition, draws backward-up with a right tilt, then levels at a safe viewing distance.

prompt: Firewood split. You raise an imaginary axe and strike through a log.
idea: Raises the axe high and back, suspends the windup, snaps through the log forward-down, then rebounds into a controlled recovery.

prompt: Kindling stack. You place small sticks into a raised crossing structure.
idea: Places kindling low right and left in crossing layers, raises the next piece at center, then looks high over the finished small structure.

prompt: Fire tending. You lean toward a small flame and retreat from heat.
idea: Leans low toward the flame, recoils high with a right tilt from its heat, then levels and watches the fire from farther back.

prompt: Ember blowing. You lower toward embers and give two careful breaths.
idea: Raise for a careful breath, lean toward the embers through two slow breathing pulses, then withdraw from the second exhale.

prompt: Campfire smoke. You turn aside from drifting smoke then check the fire.
idea: Watches the fire low, lifts into a right tilt as smoke drifts near, turns left to clear it, then cautiously returns to the flame.

prompt: Water filter. You pump water then inspect the receiving bottle.
idea: Pumps the water filter with grounded nods, slows the last stroke, then looks low left to inspect the receiving bottle and centers.

prompt: Stream crossing. You inspect stepping stones before committing across.
idea: Checks the stream stones low right and left, returns to the right takeoff point, rises across the gap, then cushions the landing and centers.

prompt: Log crossing. You look along a narrow log and balance across.
idea: Looks ahead along the narrow log, corrects left then right, continues with smaller balancing sways, then arrives level.

prompt: Loose scree. You feel unstable footing and lower your center.
idea: Feels the scree shift and lowers into a right tilt, catches the unstable footing with small balance corrections, then straightens and rises.

prompt: Steep scramble. You look for a high grip and pull upward.
idea: Finds a high grip on the right, crouches below it, pulls upward through effort pulses, then rises fully and centers.

prompt: Low branch. You spot an overhanging branch and duck beneath it.
idea: Spots the branch overhead, checks its clearance, ducks compactly beneath it, then rises after passing with attentive ears.

prompt: Trail marker. You scan a fork and inspect a painted marker.
idea: Scan the trail fork right-left, spot the painted marker high-right, then pause on it and return centered.

prompt: Map orientation. You compare a map to the landscape.
idea: Compares the low map on the right with the high landscape on the left, checks again, then turns the body right to left into alignment and centers.

prompt: Compass bearing. You read a compass then align with its direction.
idea: Reads the compass low, starts the rightward turn, centers the gaze while rotating left to the bearing, then raises ahead and squares the finish.

prompt: Binocular ridge. You scan a skyline and pause at a notch.
idea: Scans the ridge high right then left, narrows onto a farther-left notch, makes a small sighting correction, then returns center.

prompt: Trail switchback. You look around a bend then turn uphill.
idea: Looks around the rightward switchback, brings the torso after the gaze, then turns left uphill and looks farther along the rising trail before centering.

prompt: Backpack lift. You hoist a loaded pack and settle beneath it.
idea: Braces low beneath the backpack, hoists it forcefully upward, lowers a little under its weight, then steadies with small balance shifts and settles.

prompt: Pack strap. You tighten a strap then check the balance.
idea: Draws the pack strap backward while looking low, checks balance with left and right tilts, then makes smaller corrections and levels.

prompt: Boot mud. You pull free from sticky mud then regain balance.
idea: Loads low against the muddy boot, pulls sharply upward as it releases into a right lean, then catches balance with small sways and levels.

prompt: Rock hopping. You make two separate short leaps across gaps.
idea: Crouch at the first gap, leap and land, then gather for a second hopping arc and settle softly.

prompt: Creek depth. You lean over water and judge the bottom.
idea: Leans down over the creek, tips left to judge the bottom, makes a small viewing correction, then withdraws to level.

prompt: Canteen fill. You lower a bottle into a stream then lift it level.
idea: Dips the canteen deeply into the stream, raises it level, holds the filled bottle steady, then turns left to withdraw and returns center.

prompt: Water spill. You notice a tilted bottle and level it quickly.
idea: Finds the bottle tipping low to the right, quickly levels it against the spill, then checks below and eases upright.

prompt: Fishing cast. You draw a rod back and send the line forward.
idea: Draws the rod backward with torso right and gaze left, casts forward through a leftward turn, then watches the line farther left and centers.

prompt: Fishing float. You watch a bobber dip then rise.
idea: Watches the fishing float low, follows its little dips and rises, lets the bobbing diminish, then steadies the gaze over it.

prompt: Fishing strike. You notice a float vanish and lift the rod.
idea: Watches the float low, follows its sudden disappearance deeper, lifts the rod sharply, then holds the line high before easing the pose.

prompt: Fishing snag. You pull against a snag then ease off and retry.
idea: Pull backward against the snag with a strained tremble, ease the line low, then turn right to left through a renewed tug and center.

prompt: Reel winding. You retrieve line steadily and check its approach.
idea: Retrieves the line with a steady low reeling rhythm, slows the final winding, then leans forward to inspect its approach and releases.

prompt: Hook threading. You thread line through a small hook eye.
idea: Inspects the hook eye close in a left tilt, squares the line, advances into the opening, then withdraws slowly after threading.

prompt: Float adjustment. You slide a float along a line and check the distance.
idea: Follows the float up the line from low to high, stops at the new position, checks a little below the setting, then relaxes center.

prompt: Landing net. You dip a net and lift its contents gently.
idea: Dips the landing net deeply, raises it level with gentle control, steadies its contents with tiny balance shifts, then looks down to inspect.

prompt: Anchor lowering. You follow an anchor down and brace when the line tightens.
idea: Follows the anchor down, braces backward with a right tilt as the line tightens, absorbs small loaded pulses, then levels the stance.

prompt: Anchor hauling. You pull a heavy anchor up in two efforts.
idea: Reset low over the anchor line, haul through two loaded upward heaves, then steady the recovered weight.

prompt: Boat mooring. You align with a cleat and pull a line snug.
idea: Aligns low right with the mooring cleat, turns the body into the line, pulls backward-up to snug it, then centers and releases the load.

prompt: Dock step. You judge a moving gap before stepping across.
idea: Judges the dock gap low through its bobbing motion, chooses the moment to rise across, then cushions the step and steadies.

prompt: Gangplank balance. You cross a swaying gangplank and stop square.
idea: Crosses the gangplank looking ahead, corrects left then right, carries smaller alternating balance shifts, then stops square.

prompt: Sail hoisting. You follow a sail climbing the mast.
idea: Follows the sail upward through two pull-and-pause stages, gives a final small hoisting rhythm, then holds the raised sail in view.

prompt: Sail reefing. You lower part of a sail and secure it.
idea: Watch the sail high and follow it down for reefing, work the low fastening in a right-left turn, then center and release the torso.

prompt: Cleat hitch. You circle a line around a cleat and pull it tight.
idea: Circles the cleat low from right to left with a smaller wrapping turn, then draws backward-up to tighten the hitch and returns square.

prompt: Rope coiling. You gather rope into even loops.
idea: Gathers the rope low right, raises a loop toward the left, repeats the rounded lift and gathering rhythm, then lowers the coil centrally.

prompt: Rope knot. You cross ends then pull them apart.
idea: Cross the rope ends low right-left, gather them centrally, then draw them apart under tension and return square.

prompt: Knot jam. You test a knot loosen it and pull again.
idea: Tests the jammed knot with a backward pull, lowers into a close left tilt, loosens it with small working motions, then straightens for another pull and releases.

prompt: Carabiner gate. You open a gate seat a loop and check closure.
idea: Inspects the carabiner gate close in a left tilt, centers the seated loop, then gives a small confirming nod and lifts away.

prompt: Harness buckle. You thread a strap and double back.
idea: Feeds the harness strap low forward, reverses it through a right-to-left turn for the double-back, then centers to inspect the buckle.

prompt: Helmet fit. You tilt each side then settle the helmet square.
idea: Tests the helmet in left and right tilts, lowers slightly into the fit, then makes smaller settling motions and squares the head.

prompt: Belay lockoff. You arrest an imagined rope feed and hold tension while looking up.
idea: Arrest the rope feed low, brace backward with a right tilt and loaded tremble, then look overhead while maintaining the lock.

prompt: Rappel edge. You look below then lean back over an imagined edge.
idea: Inspects the rappel drop below, leans back into a right-tilted brace over the edge, steadies with small corrections, then levels under tension.

prompt: Rappel descent. You lower in stages while checking the wall.
idea: Descends in level height stages, tips forward between drops to check the wall, then settles at the lower position and levels.

prompt: Snow probe. You push a probe into snow and read its depth.
idea: Align the snow probe, press down through resistance with a small loaded tremble, then look up its shaft to read depth and relax.

prompt: Snow shovel. You scoop heavy snow and throw it aside.
idea: Scoop snow deeply, rise with a trembling heavy load, then toss left and follow it farther left before centering.

prompt: Ice axe plant. You look at a slope and set an axe firmly.
idea: Sights the slope low, raises the ice axe, snaps it firmly downward, braces on the planted tool, then eases upright.

prompt: Crampon check. You look down to inspect both foot positions.
idea: Sinks to inspect the crampons, checks the right and left footing, makes a small second balance check, then rises at center.

prompt: Snowshoe lift. You pull free of deep snow and set down level.
idea: Loads low against the trapped snowshoe, pulls upward through a brief release, then lowers carefully onto level snow and steadies.

prompt: Avalanche scan. You survey an open slope and its upper ridge.
idea: Survey the low slope right and left, raise the gaze to the ridge and repeat the high sweep, then center attentively.

prompt: Rain shelter. You look up at rain then duck beneath cover.
idea: Looks up at the rain, pauses, ducks low while turning right beneath shelter, then centers the gaze and rises within cover.

prompt: Poncho pull. You draw a poncho over your head and clear the opening.
idea: Ducks into the poncho, rises while tipping left and then right to clear the opening, then settles the fabric with a small shake and levels.

prompt: Sunshade setup. You raise a shade and inspect its tension.
idea: Opens the sunshade from right to left while raising it, checks both upper corners, then steadies the stretched canopy and squares up.

prompt: Beach umbrella anchor. You twist a pole into sand then inspect it upright.
idea: Twists the umbrella pole low right and left through repeated turns, then centers and follows its upright length overhead before settling.

prompt: Beach shell. You inspect a shell from its opening and underside.
idea: Examines the shell opening low with a left tilt, turns to a right tilt for its underside, checks the right edge, then levels and rises.

prompt: Tide pool. You lean over a pool and follow a small ripple.
idea: Leans close over the tide pool, follows a gentle ripple side to side, narrows the tracking, then withdraws upright.

prompt: Driftwood lift. You test a log before dragging it aside.
idea: Tests the driftwood low under load, pauses at its weight, rises into a leftward drag, then looks farther left and returns square.

prompt: Sand digging. You scoop low and toss sand aside twice.
idea: Scoop sand low and toss left, return through another scooping beat and toss right, then settle over the cleared spot.

prompt: Sand sifting. You shake a sieve and inspect what remains.
idea: Sifts sand with a low lateral shaking rhythm, centers the sieve, leans closer with a left tilt to inspect what remains, then levels.

prompt: Path raking. You draw debris toward you then inspect the cleared strip.
idea: Reaches forward-low with the rake, draws debris back through repeated strokes, then inspects the cleared strip right and left before centering.

prompt: Leaf gathering. You sweep leaves inward from both sides.
idea: Sweeps leaves inward from far right with a rightward body turn, reaches far left for the opposite gather, then compresses the pile at center and lifts.

prompt: Grass edging. You trace a narrow boundary and stop at a corner.
idea: Edges the grass along a low right-to-left line, turns the body left at the corner, follows the farther edge, then returns square.

prompt: Hedge shaping. You check a hedge profile then trim its high edge.
idea: Check the hedge profile right-left, center and rise to the high edge, then clip downward once and lift clear.

prompt: Branch lopping. You brace below a branch and cut through it.
idea: Sights the branch high, draws backward in a right tilt, snaps down through the cut, follows the falling branch, then levels.

prompt: Branch dragging. You pull a long branch around an obstacle.
idea: Loads the long branch to the right, pulls backward-up, checks farther right at the obstacle, then turns left around it and releases square.

prompt: Stump levering. You push a lever down and watch a root rise.
idea: Lean into the stump lever, press low with a strained pulse, then follow the freed root upward and ease level.

prompt: Post hole. You look into a narrow hole and lift soil out.
idea: Peers deeply into the post hole, raises the soil slowly under load, turns left to place it aside, then looks farther left and returns square.

prompt: Fence post. You hold a post upright and check both sides.
idea: Follows the fence post upward, checks its verticality with left and right tilts, lets small corrections settle, then levels under the upright load.

prompt: Fence wire. You pull a wire taut then inspect its line.
idea: Pulls the fence wire taut backward and high, then follows its level line from right through center to left and releases square.

prompt: Gate sag. You open a gate and inspect its dragging corner.
idea: Swings the gate from right to left, looks farther left toward the dragging corner, lowers close with a left tilt, then returns square.

prompt: Wheelbarrow lift. You brace and lift handles then balance the load.
idea: Crouches to lift the wheelbarrow handles, rises beneath the load, catches a right tilt, then uses smaller balance shifts and levels.

prompt: Wheelbarrow tipping. You stop and tip a load forward.
idea: Settles the wheelbarrow to a stop, folds forward deeply to tip the load, waits for it to clear, then rises into a relaxed stance.

prompt: Garden fork. You drive into soil and lever a clod upward.
idea: Raises the garden fork, drives it down into the soil, levers backward under load to lift the clod, then releases upright.

prompt: Hoe stroke. You draw a blade through soil and reset.
idea: Reaches the hoe forward-low, draws the blade back, resets forward for a second pass, then finishes its pull and settles.

prompt: Transplant hole. You compare a root ball with a hole before lowering it.
idea: Compare the root ball and hole low right-left, center the plant, lower it gently into place, then lift clear.

prompt: Tree staking. You align a support beside a trunk and check verticality.
idea: Compares the support and trunk positions low right and left, centers between them, follows both upward, then checks their shared vertical line.

prompt: Fruit picking. You spot a ripe fruit and twist it free.
idea: Spot the fruit high-left and hold its position, twist it right-left to free the stem, then lower the picked fruit centrally.

prompt: Orchard ladder. You check a ladder then look up into the canopy.
idea: Check the orchard ladder feet right and left, lift into the canopy and scan overhead in the same order, then center.

prompt: Root harvest. You pull a root against soil resistance.
idea: Braces low over the root, pulls upward through resistant little tugs, then rises tall at the release and settles with the harvest.

prompt: Vine untangling. You trace a vine loop and free it from a support.
idea: Traces the vine low right around its support to the left, lifts the loop farther left to free it, then returns to inspect the released strand.

prompt: Seed scattering. You cast seeds outward and follow their spread.
idea: Gathers seeds low to the right, opens through a raised leftward casting sweep, follows their spread farther left, then returns square.

prompt: Mulch spreading. You tip a load and smooth it around a plant.
idea: Tips the mulch low in a right roll, smooths around the plant from right through a body arc to left, then centers and levels the load.

prompt: Irrigation emitter. You inspect a dripper and watch a drop form.
idea: Lowers close to the irrigation emitter, stills while a drop forms, follows its small descent, then lifts from the dripper.

prompt: Grafting alignment. You match two cut surfaces and press them together.
idea: Inspects the graft cuts low right with a left tilt and low left with a right tilt, squares them centrally, then compresses gently and releases.

prompt: Tree tap. You inspect a spout and follow sap into a vessel.
idea: Inspects the tree spout level on the left, follows sap down toward the receiving vessel, pauses low, then returns to center.

prompt: Harvest basket. You lower produce into a basket and inspect the load.
idea: Lowers produce gently into the basket, checks the load on the right and left, makes small balancing adjustments, then lifts centered.

prompt: Trail cleanup. You spot litter lift it and place it aside.
idea: Search the trail low right-left, lift the litter, turn left to place it aside, then lower and return square.

prompt: Campsite final check. You scan ground overhead and the exit before leaving.
idea: Checks the campsite ground right and left, surveys overhead from right to left, then turns the body toward the exit and returns square.

prompt: Rearview check. You check a mirror before changing lanes.
idea: Raises slightly toward the rearview mirror, turns left to check traffic, then returns straight ahead and settles the ears.

prompt: Blind spot. You look over your shoulder before turning.
idea: Looks far left over the shoulder, eases the glance inward, centers before turning the body left, then returns to a forward stance.

prompt: Parallel parking. You check behind then turn into a narrow space.
idea: Checks rearward low to the left, turns into the parking space, looks right for clearance, counterturns right to align, then squares up.

prompt: Parking clearance. You compare both sides of a tight bay.
idea: Lowers to compare the parking clearances right and left, repeats a smaller checking sweep, then centers in the narrow bay.

prompt: Reverse trailer. You watch a trailer angle and countersteer.
idea: Looks rearward left at the trailer, countersteers left while the gaze shifts right, turns the body right to straighten, then checks farther right and centers.

prompt: Hill start. You brace at a stop then ease forward uphill.
idea: Braces low at the hill stop, holds the load, rises into a controlled forward start, then lets small balancing motion settle level.

prompt: Emergency braking. You notice an obstacle and brace against a sudden stop.
idea: Leans forward toward the obstacle, pitches farther down at braking, recoils backward through the stop, then returns to a stable upright stance.

prompt: Speed bump. You prepare for a bump and absorb its crest.
idea: Preloads low before the speed bump, rises over its crest, absorbs the descent, then damps the remaining bounce and levels.

prompt: Pothole. You feel one side drop and correct the tilt.
idea: Travels level, drops sharply into a right roll at the pothole, counters left, then lets smaller balance corrections return upright.

prompt: Roundabout. You scan entry traffic then turn through the circle.
idea: Check roundabout traffic right-left, turn right into entry, pass through center into the leftward circle, then find the exit and square up.

prompt: Rail crossing. You check both directions then cross carefully.
idea: Check both rail directions in a wide right-left sweep, pause centrally, then advance carefully beyond the crossing and settle.

prompt: Tunnel entry. You lower your gaze under an approaching overhead edge.
idea: Watches the tunnel edge high, folds the gaze slightly beneath it, pauses through the entrance, then returns level inside.

prompt: Tunnel exit. You look toward a bright opening and raise your head.
idea: Looks forward-low toward the tunnel opening, rises into the bright exit, steadies with a small adjustment, then relaxes level.

prompt: Windshield wiper. You follow one wiping arc then look through again.
idea: Follows one windshield-wiper arc from far right through a raised middle to far left, then returns to a fixed forward view.

prompt: Defogging check. You inspect a fogged window and wait for clarity.
idea: Leans close to inspect the fogged glass, withdraws to wait, then returns to a level view as clarity improves and settles.

prompt: Dashboard warning. You glance down at a light then back to the road.
idea: Glances down at the dashboard warning, returns to the road, makes a second brief low check, then resumes a forward watch.

prompt: Fuel nozzle. You seat a nozzle then wait for filling to stop.
idea: Seats the fuel nozzle low-forward, waits through filling, rises at the cutoff, then withdraws from the filled tank.

prompt: Fuel cap. You turn a cap and inspect its seal.
idea: Turns the fuel cap right and left through repeated tightening strokes, tips left to inspect the seal, then levels and squares the body.

prompt: Charging plug. You align a connector and push until seated.
idea: Aligns the charging plug in a low left tilt, straightens, presses it forward into its seat, then holds the fit and withdraws slightly.

prompt: Charging latch. You release a connector then withdraw it carefully.
idea: Looks low at the charging latch, dips to release it, briefly stills at the click, then draws the connector backward-up and settles.

prompt: Tire pressure. You lower to a valve and inspect a gauge.
idea: Lowers toward the tire valve, turns low right to position the gauge, raises slightly to read it, then returns centered.

prompt: Wheel nut. You brace then turn a resistant fastener.
idea: Braces in a low rightward coil over the wheel nut, stalls under resistance, turns left with a loaded release, then steadies and centers.

prompt: Jack lift. You watch a vehicle rise and check the support.
idea: Follows the jack lifting the vehicle in stages, tracks its small upward working pulses, then lowers to inspect the support and withdraws.

prompt: Hood opening. You lift a hood and look beneath it.
idea: Follows the hood through its rising arc, holds beneath the open panel, then leans forward-low to inspect the engine and eases back.

prompt: Oil dipstick. You withdraw a rod and inspect its marked end.
idea: Finds the dipstick low, withdraws it upward, tips left to inspect the marked end with small viewing corrections, then levels.

prompt: Coolant level. You look through a translucent reservoir at eye level.
idea: Sinks level beside the coolant reservoir, tilts left to find the fluid line, looks slightly left, then stills the reading before returning center.

prompt: Jump cable. You compare terminals before making a connection.
idea: Compare the battery terminals low right-left, return to the right connection, press forward carefully, then withdraw to center.

prompt: Windscreen wash. You inspect a dirty patch and wipe it clear.
idea: Inspects the dirty windscreen patch to the right, wipes across to the left with short cleaning passes, then centers close to check clarity.

prompt: Roof rack. You look up and test a load above you.
idea: Looks high at the roof load, leans to test it, applies a small checking rhythm, then holds to watch for movement and relaxes.

prompt: Cargo strap. You tighten a strap and inspect the load edge.
idea: Draws backward against the cargo strap with small tightening tugs, then looks low left along the load edge and returns centered.

prompt: Tailgate lowering. You watch a gate swing down and stop level.
idea: Follows the tailgate swinging from high to low, levels at its open position, then watches the stop and relaxes.

prompt: Tailgate closing. You raise a heavy gate and give a final firm push.
idea: Crouch beneath the tailgate, lift with a loaded tremble, then draw back for a firm final push and release after closure.

prompt: Sliding van door. You pull a door sideways and wait for the latch.
idea: Pulls the van door along a right-to-left body turn, looks farther left as the latch arrives, then centers low to check closure and releases square.

prompt: Bus curb. You look down at a curb before descending.
idea: Looks down close at the bus curb, pauses to judge the drop, sinks carefully over it, then levels after descending.

prompt: Bus acceleration. You brace as a vehicle pulls away.
idea: Drifts backward with a right tilt as the bus accelerates, leans forward to recover, then dampens small balance shifts and levels.

prompt: Bus corner. You lean with a turn and regain upright posture.
idea: Leans right with the bus corner, turns the body left through the bend, counters into a left tilt, then lets smaller rocking settle square.

prompt: Train departure. You follow a platform sliding past.
idea: Follows the departing platform from right through center to left, tracks a last passing feature, then returns to a forward gaze.

prompt: Train coupling. You brace for a small longitudinal jolt.
idea: Brace low for coupling and draw back, snap forward at the jolt, then rebound in a short damped pitch and settle.

prompt: Train curve. You look along a bending track and follow the bend.
idea: Looks right along the bending track, leads the torso into its broad arc, passes center toward the left, then looks through the exit and squares up.

prompt: Train signal. You spot an overhead signal then check the track.
idea: Spots the train signal overhead, briefly fixes on its aspect, lowers straight ahead to check the track, then settles level.

prompt: Platform gap. You inspect a narrow gap and step across.
idea: Inspects the platform gap low, pauses to judge it, rises across with a small lift, cushions the landing, then steadies upright.

prompt: Escalator entry. You watch moving steps then commit to one.
idea: Watches the escalator steps in a low tracking rhythm, commits upward onto one, then steadies at riding height and levels.

prompt: Escalator exit. You watch a step flatten and move forward.
idea: Watches the escalator step flatten below, levels the gaze, makes a small forward release onto the landing, then returns upright.

prompt: Moving walkway. You adjust to a moving surface beneath you.
idea: Leans back with a right tilt as the walkway takes the feet, centers over a lower base, absorbs small balance shifts, then settles.

prompt: Elevator leveling. You feel a lift stop and absorb the motion.
idea: Stands tall and level in the lift, sinks slightly as it stops, absorbs a small settling bounce, then rises to neutral.

prompt: Elevator door. You watch doors part then look through the opening.
idea: Watch the elevator doors part right-left, center on the opening, then lean forward to look through and settle.

prompt: Revolving door. You enter a compartment and turn with it.
idea: Leans into the revolving compartment, rotates from right through center to left, finds the leftward exit, then centers and clears the turn.

prompt: Turnstile. You lean through a rotating barrier then straighten.
idea: Lean forward-low through the turnstile, rotate with its right-left motion, rise clear, then square the body.

prompt: Bicycle mount. You check balance then rise into a riding posture.
idea: Checks balance low before mounting, tips left into the bicycle, rises to riding height, then settles forward with small balance corrections.

prompt: Bicycle dismount. You slow and lower while keeping the gaze ahead.
idea: Slows with the gaze ahead, lowers out of the riding posture, turns aside right, checks farther right, then returns square after dismounting.

prompt: Bicycle chain. You look down at a slipped chain and inspect both ends.
idea: Dip to the slipped chain, compare its right and left ends, return to the right link, then lift centrally.

prompt: Bicycle pump. You press a pump twice then read a gauge.
idea: Raise over the pump, press through two full rhythmic strokes, then lift slightly to inspect the pressure gauge.

prompt: Bicycle bell. You give a small cue and return attention forward.
idea: Poises for the bicycle bell, gives one small downward cue, returns attention ahead, then relaxes the ears while watching the route.

prompt: Bicycle shoulder check. You look behind while maintaining a forward lean.
idea: Maintains a forward riding lean, looks far left over the shoulder, eases the glance inward, then returns ahead without losing the lean.

prompt: Scooter kick. You lean into a push then glide.
idea: Leans low into the scooter push, rises into the glide, absorbs a small balancing sway, then steadies the level ride.

prompt: Scooter curb. You spot a curb and lift over it.
idea: Spots the curb low, compresses beneath the scooter, rises quickly over the edge, then cushions the landing and levels.

prompt: Motorcycle stand. You shift weight off a stand and center.
idea: Leans left off the motorcycle stand, rises through center, catches a small right tilt, then damps the balance and levels.

prompt: Motorcycle visor. You look through a visor then lift your chin to clear it.
idea: Looks low-forward through the visor, lifts the chin to clear its edge, checks the newly open view, then centers the head.

prompt: Motorcycle gust. You counter a side push while keeping forward alignment.
idea: Takes the gust in a right roll while facing forward, counters left, then reduces the corrective rocking until upright again.

prompt: Motorcycle hairpin. You look into a tight turn before rotating through it.
idea: Looks right into the hairpin, turns the body beneath the gaze, counterlooks left for the exit, then rotates left and follows the open road before centering.

prompt: Forklift approach. You sight a pallet low and align square.
idea: Check the pallet openings low right-left, center the forklift alignment, then advance steadily and settle at the approach.

prompt: Forklift lift. You raise a load then tilt it back.
idea: Raises the forklift load with the head level, tilts it backward, makes a small stability correction, then holds the lifted load.

prompt: Forklift lower. You set a load down and withdraw.
idea: Lowers the forklift load steadily, pauses at contact, withdraws slightly upward, then releases the ears into a level stance.

prompt: Pallet jack. You brace low and pull a load clear.
idea: Braces forward-low on the pallet jack, pulls the load backward, turns right to clear it, looks farther right, then squares up.

prompt: Crane pickup. You watch a hook descend and lift a load.
idea: Watches the crane hook descend from high to low, pauses at the attachment, follows the loaded rise, then steadies the suspended view.

prompt: Crane swing. You follow a suspended load across a wide arc.
idea: Tracks the suspended load high right, rotates through a wide body arc toward the left, then centers above its destination and steadies the sway.

prompt: Crane placement. You lower a swinging load and wait for it to settle.
idea: Follows the crane load downward, watches its lateral swinging diminish, then fixes on the low landing point and lifts after it settles.

prompt: Excavator scoop. You curl a bucket through soil and lift it.
idea: Press the bucket into soil, curl through a right-left turn, raise the loaded scoop, then return square.

prompt: Excavator dump. You swing a loaded bucket and tip it out.
idea: Swings the loaded bucket high from right to left, follows it farther left, tips low with a right roll to dump, then rights it and centers.

prompt: Bulldozer push. You lean into a heavy forward push and stop.
idea: Leans low into the bulldozer push, sustains heavy forward effort with small loaded pulses, then stops the pressure and rises.

prompt: Road roller. You move with steady weight over a surface.
idea: Settles into the road roller's low level weight, carries fine traveling vibration over the surface, then gradually rises as the pass ends.

prompt: Tractor furrow. You follow a straight row and check alignment behind.
idea: Follows the tractor furrow low ahead, checks alignment rearward to the left, then returns to the row with a small traveling pulse and settles.

prompt: Harvester edge. You track the boundary between cut and uncut crop.
idea: Tracks the crop boundary low right and farther right, checks ahead, sweeps through the left boundary, then centers on the next row.

prompt: Combine unloading. You watch grain pour into an adjacent trailer.
idea: Watches the grain outlet high left, follows the stream farther left and downward into the trailer, then steadies at the receiving level and centers.

prompt: Snowplow turn. You follow a blade then turn through a snowbank.
idea: Watches the snowplow blade low, rises under the snowbank load while turning left, looks farther through the turn, then returns square.

prompt: Street sweeper. You trace a curb and look around a parked obstacle.
idea: Follows the curb low right, looks farther right around the parked obstacle, turns outward and back through center, then rejoins the line from the left.

prompt: Garbage lift. You follow a bin rising and tipping overhead.
idea: Follows the bin rising overhead, tips right as it empties, watches it descend, then levels and settles after the lift returns.

prompt: Tow winch. You watch a cable tighten and pull a load forward.
idea: Watches the tow cable low, rises as tension builds, follows the load pulling forward through small effort pulses, then settles.

prompt: Tow hook. You inspect a hook seating beneath a vehicle.
idea: Sinks deeply beneath the vehicle, tilts left to see the tow hook, checks its rightward seat close, then levels and withdraws.

prompt: Boat launch. You follow a trailer descending into water.
idea: Looks rearward low toward the left trailer, follows it deeper into the water, pauses at launch depth, then returns centered.

prompt: Boat retrieval. You sight a bow onto a trailer and pull it up.
idea: Checks bow alignment low right and left, centers it over the trailer, then follows a steady upward haul with small working pulses and settles.

prompt: Outboard start. You brace and mime pulling a starter cord.
idea: Braces forward-low at the outboard starter, yanks backward-up, then returns to a controlled reset and listens for the engine.

prompt: Outboard stall. You try a pull wait then try again.
idea: Prepare low and yank the starter backward, reset through the stalled wait, then repeat the pulling beat and ease upright.

prompt: Boat wake. You ride over a wake and absorb the trough.
idea: Preloads low for the boat wake, rises over the crest, drops into the trough, then lets smaller rocking settle level.

prompt: Boat docking. You compare distance to the dock and turn into alignment.
idea: Checks the dock low left and farther left, turns right to adjust the approach, centers the sightline, then turns left into alignment and stops square.

prompt: Ferry ramp. You watch a ramp lower then look across it.
idea: Watches the ferry ramp high, follows its descent to level, then leans forward to inspect the crossing and eases upright.

prompt: Kayak entry. You lower into a narrow seat and regain balance.
