idea: Lowers level into the kayak, corrects left and right rolls, lets smaller balance shifts settle, then faces ahead in the seat.

prompt: Canoe portage. You lift a canoe overhead and balance beneath it.
idea: Crouches deeply beneath the canoe, lifts it overhead, catches left then right balance, then steadies the load with small corrections and levels.

prompt: Sailboat boom. You notice a boom swinging and duck under it.
idea: Spots the boom high right, follows its swing left, ducks quickly beneath it, then rises centered after it passes.

prompt: Aircraft takeoff. You follow a runway then rotate upward.
idea: Follows the runway low ahead, carries a fine rolling pulse, rotates steadily upward into the climb, then holds the raised flight path.

prompt: Aircraft landing. You follow a descending approach and flare.
idea: Follows the high approach downward, gently raises the nose for the flare, settles onto the runway, then damps the last small bounce.

prompt: Aircraft turbulence. You absorb two uneven jolts and level out.
idea: Drops into a right roll at the first air jolt, recovers level, takes a smaller leftward jolt, then lets the remaining sway fade.

prompt: Aircraft banking. You look into a turn and bank smoothly.
idea: Looks high left into the aircraft turn, banks right with the body turning left, then levels the head toward the exit and closes the turn.

prompt: Cockpit scan. You check horizon instruments and side view.
idea: Checks the raised horizon, lowers toward instruments on the right, returns level, looks through the left window, then centers again.

prompt: Helicopter hover. You correct small drift while maintaining height.
idea: Maintains hover height while correcting left and right drift, reduces the balancing rolls, then steadies level at center.

prompt: Helicopter descent. You lower level toward a landing spot.
idea: Holds a slightly downward landing gaze, descends level in two stages, absorbs a small settling motion, then rests at the landing height.

prompt: Balloon burner. You look up at a canopy and brace for a burner burst.
idea: Looks up into the balloon canopy, braces through a short burner pulse, then quiets into the high watch and lowers slightly.

prompt: Balloon landing. You watch terrain approach then brace for a bump.
idea: Watch the terrain approach below and descend, compress at the landing bump, then rebound softly and steady upright.

prompt: Cable car tower. You look up as a support passes overhead.
idea: Looks high right as the cable-car support arrives, tracks it overhead to the left, follows it farther behind, then returns centered.

prompt: Ski lift unloading. You watch the platform approach and rise at the exit.
idea: Watches the ski-lift platform approach low, pauses at the exit timing, rises out of the seat, then steadies the landing posture and centers.

prompt: Airport belt. You follow a bag arriving and lift it off.
idea: Follows the arriving bag low right to left, lifts it off the belt, turns left to carry it aside, then lowers and returns square.

prompt: Envelope seal. You align a flap press it and check a lifted corner.
idea: Check the envelope flap right-left and press centrally, lift into a left tilt at the loose corner, then repress and straighten.

prompt: Envelope stuffing. You slide a folded sheet into a narrow envelope.
idea: Feed the folded sheet low, withdraw at resistance and check alignment right-left, then advance again and lift from the seated page.

prompt: Postage stamp. You align an adhesive postage stamp and smooth its edges.
idea: Aligns the stamp in a low left tilt, centers and presses, checks its right and left edges, then smooths with little dips and lifts.

prompt: Letter opening. You follow a sealed edge and lift the flap.
idea: Follows the sealed edge from far right through the middle to far left, pauses at resistance, resets low, then lifts the opened flap at center.

prompt: Paper stack. You square a loose stack and check both edges.
idea: Checks the paper-stack edges right and left, taps them inward through opposing turns, repeats the squaring rhythm, then centers the neat stack.

prompt: Paper stapling. You align pages staple them and inspect the join.
idea: Check the page edges right-left, raise above the staple point and press down, then inspect the join with opposing tilts and level.

prompt: Staple jam. You stop a jammed stapler clear it and retry.
idea: Stop the failed press, rise into a left inspection tilt, rock the jam right-left, then realign for a second press and release.

prompt: Staple removal. You lift a staple without tearing the page.
idea: Dips close to the staple, lifts it a little, pauses to inspect the page in a left tilt, then completes the careful lift and levels.

prompt: Hole punching. You align a paper edge and punch then check the holes.
idea: Align the paper edges right-left, center and raise for a firm punch, then inspect both holes and return centrally.

prompt: Binder rings. You open rings insert pages and close them evenly.
idea: Checks both binder rings, opens them through right-to-left turns, raises and lowers the pages, then verifies closure with a small alternating look and centers.

prompt: Paper clip. You slide a clip over a stack and correct a snag.
idea: Begin the clip insertion and withdraw from the snag, tilt left to realign and retry, then check both edges and center.

prompt: Binder clip. You compress a clip and seat it on a thick stack.
idea: Prepare the binder clip high, compress and seat it low, then rise to inspect its right and left edges and center.

prompt: Rubber band bundle. You stretch a band around a bundle then release gently.
idea: Stretch the band right-left, lower it around the bundle with opposing wrapping turns, then relax centrally and check the top.

prompt: Paper cutter. You align a sheet and lower a blade slowly.
idea: Check the cutter's right and left edges, center and raise the blade, lower it slowly, then compare the cut ends and lift.

prompt: Cutter misalignment. You notice an uneven edge reset the sheet and recut.
idea: Find the uneven cut right-left, tilt left and withdraw, compare a wider alignment sweep, then recut slowly and lift.

prompt: Tape dispenser. You pull a strip and tear it against the cutter.
idea: Pulls the tape backward and up, tears it with a sharp downward dip, checks the strip to the left, then lays it down centrally and releases.

prompt: Tape end. You search for a tape edge then peel it free.
idea: Searches the tape roll with a low circling rhythm, tilts left then right, finds the edge on the right, and peels it slowly upward before centering.

prompt: Tape wrinkle. You notice a folded section peel it back and smooth again.
idea: Notices the tape wrinkle low right, stops centrally, peels back diagonally right, then lowers and smooths across to the left before centering.

prompt: Box folding. You raise cardboard sides and tuck the final flap.
idea: Check the box sides low right-left, raise them through opposing turns, then center for a firm flap tuck and release.

prompt: Box bottom. You fold alternating flaps and press them flat.
idea: Folds the box flaps from right to left across a widening low span, presses the bottom centrally, then checks underneath with opposing tilts and levels.

prompt: Box lid. You lower a lid and work around a resistant corner.
idea: Lower the lid until it catches, lift one side rightward, compare the corners with a gentle sweep, then straighten for a second descent.

prompt: Box overfill. You try a lid remove an obstruction and try again.
idea: Tries the overfilled lid downward, pauses at the obstruction, lifts it aside to the left, then returns for a gentler central closure and withdraws.

prompt: Packing paper. You crumple paper and settle it around an object.
idea: Crumples packing paper through low right-to-left turns, repeats the compression rhythm, spreads it around both sides, then presses centrally and lifts.

prompt: Bubble wrap. You wrap an object and tuck a loose edge.
idea: Wraps the object low from right around to left, notices the loose edge in a left tilt, returns right to tuck it inward, then straightens and centers.

prompt: Fragile parcel. You lower an item into padding and inspect clearance.
idea: Lower the fragile item slowly into padding, compare the right and left clearance, then withdraw slightly and settle over it.

prompt: Shipping label. You align a label and smooth it across a box.
idea: Aligns the shipping label in a low left tilt, centers for the first press, smooths from right to left with small strokes, then returns to check it.

prompt: Label skew. You notice a crooked label lift it and realign.
idea: Finds the skewed label in a low left tilt, lifts it, turns right then left to realign, lowers it square, then checks both edges and centers.

prompt: Barcode scan. You turn a package until its barcode faces a reader.
idea: Turns the package right past an unreadable angle, pauses, reverses left toward the reader, then holds it square after recognition.

prompt: Scale package. You place a parcel and wait before reading its weight.
idea: Places the parcel low on the scale, waits for the reading, leans closer, lifts slightly, then returns for a confirming check and releases.

prompt: Parcel strap. You pull a strap tight and test the buckle.
idea: Pull the parcel strap back under load, inspect the buckle in a left tilt, then make a controlled second tug and relax.

prompt: Stretch film. You circle a load then secure the film tail.
idea: Circles the film around the load from right through center to left, checks both edges in a second winding rhythm, then presses the tail centrally and releases.

prompt: Pallet wrap. You work from a low layer to a higher layer.
idea: Wrap the pallet's low layer right-left, rise for the second circuit, carry it left in the wrapping rhythm, then center at the seam.

prompt: Packing slip. You compare a paper list with a box interior.
idea: Compare the right-hand packing list with the deeper left box, repeat the side-to-side check, then center after verifying the contents.

prompt: Box count. You inspect separate boxes then recheck one hidden behind.
idea: Counts boxes from right across to left, turns right to see the hidden rear box, looks farther right to confirm it, then returns square.

prompt: Parcel damage. You trace a crushed corner and inspect the underside.
idea: Studies the crushed parcel corner low in a left tilt, follows its right edge through a body turn, rotates left to the underside with a right tilt, then straightens square.

prompt: Hand truck load. You tilt a stack back and test its balance.
idea: Braces low under the hand-truck stack, tilts the load backward, checks left and right balance, then lets small corrections settle.

prompt: Hand truck threshold. You pause at a lip then lift and roll over it.
idea: Pauses low at the threshold, compresses beneath the hand-truck load, lifts over the lip, then cushions the far side and settles.

prompt: Drawer filing. You open a drawer locate a tab and insert a sheet.
idea: Draw the file drawer open, scan its tabs low right-left, select the central slot, then insert the sheet and rise.

prompt: File divider. You separate two sections and inspect the gap.
idea: Check both file sections low right-left, open them with opposing turns, inspect the central gap, then raise to the tab and square up.

prompt: Document sorting. You compare two headings then move one sheet to a stack.
idea: Compares document headings low right and left, lifts the right-hand selection, turns left to its stack, then lowers it farther left and returns square.

prompt: Index lookup. You scan tabs overshoot then return to the correct one.
idea: Scans the index tabs from far right through the middle to far left, realizes the overshoot, reverses to the right tab, then centers over the selection.

prompt: Page separation. You try to turn one page and separate two stuck sheets.
idea: Dips for a page turn, lifts the stuck pair, pauses in a left tilt to separate them, then retries a smaller lift and straightens.

prompt: Page flattening. You hold a curled page down and inspect the text.
idea: Presses the curled page low, reads from right to left, tips left at the rising right corner, then represses it and returns center.

prompt: Book stand. You raise a book and settle it against a support.
idea: Raise the book and turn slightly right to place it, lower level, then check its lean in a left-right tilt and square it.

prompt: Binding spine. You press a spine square and inspect the hinge.
idea: Aligns the book spine through low right-to-left turns, presses it square, looks left with a left tilt to inspect the hinge, then returns centered.

prompt: Laminator feed. You align a pouch and follow it entering a slot.
idea: Compare pouch edges right-left, center and feed the laminator, wait for travel, then check the left exit and return.

prompt: Laminator jam. You notice a pouch stall and ease it back.
idea: Follow the pouch low until it stalls, stop and withdraw it, compare its right and left edges, then center for a reset.

prompt: Scanner lid. You lower a lid then check the display.
idea: Follows the scanner lid downward, pauses at closure, raises toward the display on the left, then returns centered after checking the screen.

prompt: Scanner alignment. You place a sheet against two guides and close the lid.
idea: Check the scanner guides right-left, center the paper corner, lift toward the lid, then lower the cover and withdraw.

prompt: Printer paper. You fan a stack align it and feed the tray.
idea: Fans the printer stack through right-to-left turns, compares both edges with small alternating checks, feeds it centrally, then lifts to inspect.

prompt: Printer jam. You follow a stuck sheet and draw it out evenly.
idea: Dip close to the jammed sheet and pause, draw it evenly backward, then compare the right and left edges and center.

prompt: Printer output. You watch a page emerge and check its top line.
idea: Watches the page emerging low-forward, lifts slightly with it, follows the top line right to left, then returns centrally to read.

prompt: Toner cartridge. You remove a cartridge align its replacement and seat it.
idea: Withdraws the toner cartridge from low, turns right to remove it, brings the replacement from the left, then centers and presses it home before releasing.

prompt: Paper tray guide. You adjust two guides snugly around a stack.
idea: Checks the right paper guide and turns it inward, does the same on the left, then compares their spacing in a short repeated scan and centers.

prompt: Shredder feed. You align a sheet and watch it disappear.
idea: Aligns the sheet low over the shredder, follows it downward into the slot, lifts after it disappears, then rechecks the opening and relaxes.

prompt: Shredder snag. You stop a crooked sheet and reverse it out.
idea: Finds the crooked shredder sheet low in a left tilt, stops, lifts it back out, then straightens for a slower second feed and withdraws.

prompt: Desk cable. You trace a tangled cable and pull one loop free.
idea: Traces the cable loop right to left through a low body arc, tips left at its crossing, lifts the loop rightward free, then follows the released line left and centers.

prompt: Cable organizer. You thread a lead through a narrow slot.
idea: Tilt left over the organizer slot, advance the lead low and withdraw after seating it, then check alignment right-left and center.

prompt: Monitor height. You raise a screen and inspect its top edge.
idea: Follow the monitor upward, center on its new top edge, compare the upper corners right-left, then ease to a comfortable level view.

prompt: Monitor tilt. You adjust a screen angle and test the view.
idea: Tips the viewing angle backward with a right lean, moves forward to test the screen, then levels and holds the adjusted view.

prompt: Desk lamp. You swing a lamp over a work area and lower it.
idea: Follows the lamp high from right to left, looks farther left into the swing, brings the body beneath it, then lowers toward the lit patch and centers.

prompt: Lamp focus. You narrow a light beam and inspect its edge.
idea: Looks up at the lamp, turns its focus control right to left, lowers to the light boundary, scans both edges, then returns square.

prompt: Chair height. You lower briefly then rise to a new seated level.
idea: Lowers the chair level, pauses, rises to the new seated height, checks the work surface below, then settles upright.

prompt: Chair wheel. You inspect a stuck caster then test the roll.
idea: Dips deeply to the stuck caster with a left tilt, rises to release it, tests a short forward roll, then steadies at the stop.

prompt: Keyboard key. You inspect a stuck key and press it twice.
idea: Inspects the stuck key closely, lifts slightly, presses twice in separated small nods, then raises to check the keyboard response.

prompt: Keyboard cleaning. You trace a row and lift debris from a gap.
idea: Scan the key row right-left, tilt left at the debris and lift it free, then recheck both sides and center.

prompt: Mouse cable snag. You feel a drag follow the cable and free it.
idea: Checks the mouse drag, follows the cable low right around its loop to the left, lifts the snag free, then returns forward and squares the body.

prompt: Trackball cleaning. You lift a ball inspect its socket then reseat it.
idea: Lifts the trackball from low, dips into the empty socket with a left tilt, clears its interior with tiny motions, then raises and reseats the ball square.

prompt: Stylus docking. You align a stylus with a small holder.
idea: Align the stylus low in a left tilt, straighten and lower it, compare its seat right-left, then lift centrally.

prompt: Tablet rotation. You turn a tablet and check the newly oriented view.
idea: Rotates the tablet right to left, follows its far left edge, centers on the new view, then lowers for a short reading scan and releases the body.

prompt: Phone stand. You set a phone upright and adjust its lean.
idea: Sets the phone upright low, tips its lean backward with a right roll, then levels to inspect the screen and settles.

prompt: Phone cable. You align a tiny plug and connect it gently.
idea: Dips close to the tiny phone plug with a left tilt, squares its alignment, advances gently, then pauses on the seated connection and withdraws.

prompt: SIM tray. You line up a narrow tray and ease it into a slot.
idea: Tilts low over the SIM tray, straightens and feeds it in two stages, withdraws to inspect both sides, then centers.

prompt: Memory card. You inspect a card notch and seat it the correct way.
idea: Inspect the card notch in a low left tilt, rotate the card right-left, then square it and press into the slot before checking.

prompt: USB reversal. You try a connector withdraw it flip it and retry.
idea: Tries the USB connector forward-low, withdraws from the failed fit, flips it right to left, then centers for another insertion and releases.

prompt: Battery compartment. You open a cover compare terminals and close it.
idea: Lifts the battery cover, compares the low terminals right and left with a second check, then centers to close the compartment and withdraws.

prompt: Battery spring. You compress a cell against a spring then lower the other end.
idea: Compress the battery against its spring in a left lean, center and lower the other end, then check right-left before releasing.

prompt: Remote cover. You slide a cover until it clicks and inspect the seam.
idea: Slides the remote cover from low right to left, pauses at the click, rechecks the right edge, then presses left again and centers.

prompt: Watch strap. You thread a strap through a buckle and secure its tail.
idea: Threads the watch strap low through a right-to-left crossing, presses its tail centrally, checks both loop edges, then returns square.

prompt: Watch winding. You turn a small crown and check the face.
idea: Tilts left to the watch crown, winds it through small repeated right-to-left turns, then squares the face for a long reading and eases up.

prompt: Clock setting. You compare hands adjust them and verify the result.
idea: Checks the clock hands level, lowers into a right-to-left adjustment, then returns to inspect the new time and releases the body.

prompt: Alarm switch. You find a small switch move it then check an indicator.
idea: Search the alarm controls low right-left, move the switch with a small opposing turn, then rise to check the indicator and square up.

prompt: Calendar tear. You lift a page tear it free and inspect the next one.
idea: Lifts the calendar page, tears it across a right-to-left body pull, lowers to read the new page from right to left, then returns square.

prompt: Sticky note. You peel a note align it and press its top edge.
idea: Peels the sticky note upward, moves it left into position, lowers centrally, then smooths its top edge from right to left and releases.

prompt: Whiteboard wipe. You erase a broad area and revisit a remaining mark.
idea: Erases the board right through center to left, drops to a remaining mark, scrubs it with short side passes, then checks the right edge and centers.

prompt: Whiteboard writing. You trace a line then step back to inspect it.
idea: Writes a level line right through center to left, withdraws to inspect the whole span with a slow return scan, then raises the view centrally.

prompt: Marker cap. You pull a tight cap off then inspect the tip.
idea: Brace against the tight cap, pull upward with a strained tremble, then inspect the exposed marker tip closely and relax.

prompt: Dry marker. You try a stroke pause shake and try again.
idea: Tries the marker from right to left, stops at the dry stroke, shakes it briefly, then resets right for a shorter second pass and centers.

prompt: Tape measure desk. You measure a width then recheck the starting edge.
idea: Measures the desk from far right through the middle to far left, returns to the starting edge, repeats the near measurement, then centers.

prompt: Ruler alignment. You match a ruler to two marks before drawing.
idea: Compares the ruler marks right and left in repeated checks, centers the alignment, then draws steadily from far right to left and lifts.

prompt: Compass pencil. You set a radius then trace a full circle.
idea: Checks the compass radius right and left, centers the point, then traces the circle up its right side and down its left side before lifting.

prompt: Eraser dust. You brush crumbs aside then inspect the cleared line.
idea: Brushes eraser crumbs broadly right to left, returns close to inspect the cleared line from right to left, then rises at center.

prompt: Notebook elastic. You pull a band over a cover and settle it flat.
idea: Pull the notebook band backward-up, lower it across the cover, check both edges right-left, then settle it flat centrally.

prompt: Book jacket. You align a loose jacket around a closed book.
idea: Checks the book-jacket edges low right and left, wraps it through opposing body turns, repeats a small edge check, then presses centrally and releases.

prompt: Clipboard clip. You lift a spring clip insert paper then release it.
idea: Lift the clipboard spring against a fine tremble, place the paper beneath it, then release the clip downward and check the held sheet.

prompt: Receipt roll. You feed a new roll and pull paper through the slot.
idea: Turns the receipt roll low from right to left, lifts the paper lead, advances it into the slot, then follows the emerging strip and squares up.

prompt: Cash drawer. You open a drawer sort one compartment and close it.
idea: Withdraw to open the cash drawer, scan its compartments low right-left, place an item centrally, then advance to close and release.

prompt: Coin roll. You count a row then slide coins into a wrapper.
idea: Counts coins across the row with low alternating checks, aligns the wrapper, feeds the coins centrally, then lifts slightly to inspect the opening.

prompt: Coin jam. You inspect a slot shake gently and check whether it cleared.
idea: Inspects the coin slot in a low left tilt, rocks the mechanism right then left through gentle freeing shakes, then straightens for a close check and squares up.

prompt: Ticket tear. You align a perforation and separate the stub.
idea: Traces the ticket perforation right to left, centers it, pulls the halves apart through opposing turns, then checks both pieces and returns square.

prompt: Name badge. You align a badge clip and check that it hangs straight.
idea: Aligns the badge clip low with a left tilt, straightens and presses it closed, then traces downward to check that the badge hangs straight and lifts.

prompt: Lanyard untwist. You follow a twisted strap and rotate it flat.
idea: Follows the lanyard loop low right to left, reverses the torso right to untwist it, then turns left again and follows the flattened strap toward center.

prompt: Office final sweep. You check work surface devices and floor before leaving.
idea: Check the desk low right-left and equipment high in the same order, look deeply down, then turn right to leave and center.

prompt: Camera framing. You compare frame edges before settling on a subject.
idea: Compare the frame's right and left borders in a measured sweep, center the subject, then settle slightly raised in the composed view.

prompt: Camera focus pull. You shift attention from a near object to a distant one.
idea: Begins focused close and low, withdraws toward the distant subject, raises the sightline, then steadies the far focus with relaxed ears.

prompt: Camera rack back. You return focus from a distant view to a nearby detail.
idea: Holds the distant focus high, lowers toward the near detail, advances close, then stills the recovered near plane.

prompt: Camera pan. You follow a subject crossing the frame.
idea: Leads the camera pan from the right, lets the torso follow across center to the left, tracks the subject farther left, then returns level and square.

prompt: Camera tilt. You follow a tall building from base to roof.
idea: Frames the building base low, tilts upward through its middle to the roof, then holds the overhead composition before easing slightly.

prompt: Camera dolly. You move toward a subject then stop at the framing mark.
idea: Moves the camera gradually forward toward the subject, settles at the framing mark, briefly stills, then makes a small recovery.

prompt: Camera orbit. You circle a subject while keeping it in view.
idea: Orbits with torso right and gaze left, crosses through a rightward view, counterturns torso left and gaze right, then rejoins the sightline and centers.

prompt: Camera whip pan. You turn rapidly to a new subject and stabilize.
idea: Prepares the whip pan to the right, loads the torso rightward, snaps across to the left subject, then corrects and stabilizes before centering.

prompt: Camera horizon. You correct a tilted horizon before taking a shot.
idea: Check the tilted horizon left-right, return through a smaller left correction, then level and freeze the shot before relaxing.

prompt: Camera shutter. You wait for a moment then mark a single exposure.
idea: Waits with the camera slightly raised, marks one exposure with a tiny downward dip, then holds the frame still and eases out.

prompt: Burst photography. You track motion through several exposures then stop.
idea: Tracks the subject from right through center to left, marks several exposures with small nods along the path, then returns to a steady centered frame.

prompt: Long exposure. You hold a framed view through a long exposure.
idea: Centers the long-exposure frame, settles the head and ears into stillness, sustains the exposure, then gently releases the pose.

prompt: Macro photography. You approach a tiny subject and find the focus plane.
idea: Approaches the macro subject low and close, withdraws a little, returns to the focus plane, then freezes the composition before easing back.

prompt: Macro overshoot. You move too close then back away to regain focus.
idea: Moves too close to the macro detail, stops at the blur, withdraws upward, then returns a shorter distance and holds the recovered focus.

prompt: Landscape foreground. You check nearby rocks before looking toward the horizon.
idea: Check foreground rocks low right-left, lift toward the horizon and survey its span, then center.

prompt: Portrait angle. You inspect a face-height angle then lower the viewpoint.
idea: Turns left at face height, tips left to inspect the portrait angle, then lowers the viewpoint while leveling and settles centered.

prompt: Silhouette metering. You look past a foreground outline toward a bright background.
idea: Looks around the foreground silhouette to the right, shifts the body right to clear it, then lifts toward the bright background and centers square.

prompt: Backlight flare. You notice glare and change the viewing angle.
idea: Notices glare high, tilts left to change the light angle, looks right as it clears, then returns to a lower centered frame.

prompt: Reflection framing. You lower to a reflective surface and adjust the angle.
idea: Lowers toward the reflection, rolls left and right to search its angle, narrows the corrections, then steadies low and oblique.

prompt: Low-angle shot. You get below a subject and look upward.
idea: Lowers beneath the subject, looks upward from the low viewpoint, adjusts a slight left tilt, then levels and holds the low-angle frame.

prompt: Overhead shot. You look straight down while remaining tall.
idea: Rises tall above the subject, pitches down while keeping the height, makes a small framing adjustment, then holds the overhead view.

prompt: Tracking runner. You follow a subject through the frame and settle at the finish.
idea: Tracks the runner from the right as the body follows across center to the left, raises the final sightline at the finish, then settles square.

prompt: Tracking toss. You follow an object rising and falling through a shot.
idea: Follows the tossed object upward, waits through its apex, tracks it down through the frame, then lifts from the landing.

prompt: Tripod setup. You spread supports and check the head level.
idea: Checks the tripod feet low right and left, spreads the support through opposing turns, rises to the head, then makes small leveling corrections and centers.

prompt: Tripod leg. You adjust one leg then recheck the horizon.
idea: Dips low right to adjust the tripod leg, rises to the horizon with a left tilt, makes a small correction, then levels centered.

prompt: Tripod lock. You tighten a joint and test that the head stays put.
idea: Tightens the tripod joint right to left under a low gaze, tests it in a left tilt, then raises square and holds to verify the lock.

prompt: Monopod brace. You plant a support and steady a long lens.
idea: Presses the monopod support low into place, rises behind the long lens, absorbs small balancing motion, then fixes the forward composition.

prompt: Gimbal balance. You let a camera settle and correct its tilt.
idea: Follows the gimbal's left and right tilts, catches a smaller left return, then lets the remaining oscillation settle centered.

prompt: Gimbal walk. You keep your view level through a moving step.
idea: Keeps the gimbal view level as a step lowers the height, restores it smoothly, then carries a small settled glide and stops.

prompt: Lens change. You remove one lens align another and seat it.
idea: Removes the lens low to the right, looks left for its replacement, centers the mount, twists the new lens left into place, then squares up.

prompt: Lens cap. You remove a cap then inspect the glass.
idea: Lifts the lens cap from low, turns left to set it aside, then returns close to inspect the glass and withdraws.

prompt: Lens hood. You rotate a hood into place and check its alignment.
idea: Turn the lens hood right-left into its mount, return slightly right to test the stop, then raise the view and release the body square.

prompt: Lens dust. You tilt a lens to find a speck and inspect it close.
idea: Tilts the lens left and right to find a dust speck, narrows the reflective adjustment, then leans close to the fixed spot and centers.

prompt: Filter threading. You start a filter gently then turn it home.
idea: Aligns the filter in a low left tilt, squares it, turns right then left through two gentle winding strokes, then centers to inspect the seat.

prompt: Filter cross-thread. You feel a filter catch back it off and retry.
idea: Turn the filter right-left until it catches, check pressure and back it off right, then retry gently left and center.

prompt: Polarizing sky. You rotate a filter while inspecting a high view.
idea: Watches the sky high while rotating the polarizer from right through center to left, makes a small final angle correction, then holds centered.

prompt: Neutral density. You fit a dark filter then readjust the view.
idea: Fits the dark filter with low right-to-left turns, gives a small snugging rotation, then raises to inspect the changed view and squares up.

prompt: Flash bounce. You look toward a ceiling then return to the subject.
idea: Check the ceiling high right-left for the bounce angle, then return to the subject at forward level and settle the frame.

prompt: Flash recycle. You wait for a flash to recharge then take another shot.
idea: Waits slightly raised for flash recharge, dips for an exposure, rises and waits again, then marks a second small exposure and settles.

prompt: Softbox angle. You adjust a light and inspect the shadow direction.
idea: Looks up at the softbox, adjusts it right to left with the torso, looks farther left along the shadow, then lowers to the lit area and centers.

prompt: Reflector placement. You move a reflector until light reaches the subject.
idea: Tilts the reflector left and checks the light to the right, tilts right and checks left, then makes small angle corrections before centering on the lit subject.

prompt: Light meter. You check a reading near a subject then step back.
idea: Advances level beside the subject, lowers to read the light meter, rises to compare the scene, then withdraws and settles.

prompt: Color chart. You present a chart square and hold it steady.
idea: Centers the color chart, raises it slightly into square presentation, freezes for the reference frame, then lowers and releases the pose.

prompt: White balance. You inspect a neutral target then return to the scene.
idea: Study the neutral target, lower into a right-left control adjustment, then lift to scan the scene and center.

prompt: Slate clap. You display a slate then close it with one clear beat.
idea: Raises the slate high for display, holds the mark, closes it with one clear downward snap, then pauses and releases upright.

prompt: Slate reset. You notice a missed clap and set up a second take.
idea: Prepares and makes the missed slate clap, stops, lifts to reset square, then repeats a clear downward beat and recovers.

prompt: Boom microphone. You follow a speaker position from above.
idea: Follows the speaker high from right through a rightward body turn to the left, then centers the boom overhead and releases the torso.

prompt: Boom dip. You notice the microphone entering frame and lift it out.
idea: Notices the boom dipping into frame, checks the low position, lifts it tall out of view, then holds the corrected overhead placement.

prompt: Camera cable. You track a cable snag before continuing the move.
idea: Stops the camera move at a cable snag, dips to trace the loop right to left through the torso, then raises and resumes square.

prompt: Film magazine. You seat a magazine and check its latch.
idea: Lowers the film magazine, aligns it through opposing turns, presses centrally, then tips left to inspect the latch and squares up.

prompt: Film threading. You follow film around rollers and into a take-up spool.
idea: Thread the film low right-left around the rollers, center the loop, turn toward the right spool and follow left, then lift square.

prompt: Film advance. You turn a lever and verify the frame counter.
idea: Turns the film-advance lever right to left, lowers to the frame counter, then centers for a steady reading and withdraws.

prompt: Film rewind. You turn a crank until tension releases.
idea: Starts the rewind crank on the right, turns through center to the left, carries the winding rhythm until tension releases, then stops and dips to inspect.

prompt: Darkroom tray. You rock a tray and watch an image emerge.
idea: Rocks the darkroom tray low from left to right, continues its gentle agitation, then lets the rocking fade and leans close to the emerging image.

prompt: Darkroom timer. You check a clock then lower a print into a tray.
idea: Lifts level to check the darkroom timer, holds the timing, then lowers the print carefully into the tray and eases away.

prompt: Print tongs. You lift a wet print and let it drain.
idea: Lifts the wet print from low, tips right to drain, steadies it through small hanging sways, then levels and lowers it gently.

prompt: Print inspection. You view a print under light from two angles.
idea: Raises the print toward the light, checks it in left and right tilts, narrows the viewing adjustment, then levels at center.

prompt: Contact sheet. You scan small frames then stop on one image.
idea: Scans the contact sheet low right and left across successive rows, then centers on one frame and leans closer to inspect it.

prompt: Negative loupe. You lower to a tiny frame and hold focus.
idea: Lowers the loupe close to the negative, tilts left to find focus, straightens over the frame, then holds the low inspection.

prompt: Projection focus. You watch a blurred screen sharpen after adjustment.
idea: Watch the high projection, lower to rock the focus right-left, then return square to the sharpened screen and steady.

prompt: Projector reel. You follow a reel turning then check the film path.
idea: Follows the projector reel with a circling tracking rhythm, lowers along the right film path, checks its left return, then centers.

prompt: Projector jam. You notice the image stop and inspect the mechanism.
idea: Watches the projected image high, freezes at the jam, dips close in a left tilt, then turns right to inspect the mechanism and squares up.

prompt: Screen unfolding. You raise a screen and inspect its corners.
idea: Raises the projection screen, checks its high right and left corners, then makes a small leveling correction and returns center.

prompt: Screen wrinkle. You trace a crease and pull the surface taut.
idea: Traces the screen crease downward, draws backward to pull the surface taut, checks its level with small balancing motions, then settles.

prompt: Backdrop roll. You follow a backdrop lowering behind a set.
idea: Follow the backdrop from high to low, scan its bottom edge right-left, then return centered once it settles.

prompt: Backdrop snag. You notice a roll catch and free one side.
idea: Stops high at the backdrop snag, turns left to inspect the caught side, dips to free it, then raises nearer left to recheck and centers.

prompt: Set mark. You find a floor mark and align over it.
idea: Search the floor mark low right-left, center above it and sink slightly into alignment, then rise square into position.

prompt: Eyeline marker. You locate a small mark at face height and hold it.
idea: Searches for the eyeline mark from right to left, centers on it at face height, raises slightly, then holds the fixed gaze.

prompt: Scene continuity. You compare a prop position with a reference image.
idea: Compares the low reference on the right with the set on the left, checks the mismatch nearer left, then returns centrally to reassess.

prompt: Prop reset. You return a fallen prop to its marked position.
idea: Follows the fallen prop low, retrieves it upward, carries it left to its mark, then lowers precisely and returns center.

prompt: Stand sandbag. You lower a weight around a light stand and check stability.
idea: Braces low with the sandbag, lowers it around the stand through right-to-left turns, rises into a left tilt to test stability, then squares up.

prompt: C-stand arm. You loosen an arm swing it and retighten.
idea: Loosens the stand arm high from right to left, follows its swing farther left, lowers to turn the lock right then left, and returns square.

prompt: Flag shadow. You slide a flag until a shadow edge reaches its mark.
idea: Tracks the flag's shadow edge from right through center to left, makes a small last adjustment, then lowers to inspect its mark and centers.

prompt: Barn door. You close a light flap then inspect the shaped beam.
idea: Looks up at the light flap, closes it through a right-to-left inward turn, then lowers to the shaped beam and returns square.

prompt: Diffusion frame. You raise a frame and check it stays level.
idea: Raises the diffusion frame tall, corrects a left lean and then a right one, reduces the balancing motion, then holds level.

prompt: Light cable coil. You wind a cable and correct one reversed loop.
idea: Winds the light cable right to left, reverses right to fix a wrong loop, then resumes a smaller coiling rhythm and settles centered.

prompt: Audio recorder. You check level meters while making a short test.
idea: Watches the recorder level meters, gives a short forward testing phrase with a small pulse, then lowers to check the reading and relaxes.

prompt: Headphone check. You tilt one ear toward the feed then center.
idea: Tilts left to hear one headphone feed, holds it briefly, switches to a right tilt, then centers with a small listening sway.

prompt: Lav microphone. You inspect a tiny clip and fasten it level.
idea: Inspects the lav clip in a low left tilt, centers to fasten it with one dip, then checks the placement to the left and returns straight.

prompt: Windshield fitting. You slide a cover over a microphone and check its end.
idea: Slides the microphone cover forward-low, stops at the seated end, turns left to inspect its tip, then returns centered and withdraws.

prompt: Field recording. You aim toward a distant sound then hold completely still.
idea: Raises toward the distant sound on the right, turns farther right to aim, freezes completely for the field recording, then gently returns center.

prompt: Sound slate. You wait in silence then make one visible cue.
idea: Waits silently level, raises for the sound-slate cue, dips sharply once, then stills before easing upright.

prompt: Foley footsteps. You mime two differently weighted steps on a surface.
idea: Prepare a light foley step and dip shallowly, reset higher, then mark a heavier rolling step and release its weight.

prompt: Foley door. You mime a slow creak then a firm closure.
idea: Turns the imagined door slowly right into a creak, pauses, draws back before closing left with a downward snap, then returns square.

prompt: Foley paper. You follow a sheet crumpling then opening.
idea: Crumples the foley sheet through low opposing turns and small compressing pulses, then opens it right to left while rising and returns square.

prompt: Foley rain. You build fine movement then let it taper off.
idea: Builds fine foley rain movement low, grows into a denser pattering pulse, then tapers to smaller drops and stillness.

prompt: Stop motion. You move a tiny prop one step and recheck the frame.
idea: Moves the stop-motion prop one precise low step, pauses to preserve its position, then raises to inspect the frame and holds.

prompt: Animation peg. You align punched paper over registration pins.
idea: Check the animation-paper holes low right-left, center them over the pins, lower onto the pegs, then lift to inspect.

prompt: Rotoscope trace. You follow a moving contour and pause at a bend.
idea: Follows the rotoscope contour from right through the near curve to left, stops close at the bend, then eases back to center.

prompt: Storyboard panel. You read a sequence then return to an earlier frame.
idea: Reads storyboard panels low from right to left and farther left, backtracks through the middle to the earlier right frame, then centers.

prompt: Editing cut. You watch two shots meet then replay the transition.
idea: Watches the editing cut level, dips briefly at the transition, resets to replay, then holds the second viewing and settles.

prompt: Editing scrub. You scan a sequence backward then forward to a frame.
idea: Scrubs the sequence from left through center to right, reverses forward through center toward the left, then settles on the central frame.

prompt: Timeline trim. You move an edge slightly then check the result.
idea: Moves the timeline edge a little from low right to left, pauses at the trim, then raises to inspect the result and centers.

prompt: Color comparison. You compare two views then inspect a small patch.
idea: Compares the color views right and left, repeats a smaller comparison sweep, then centers low and close over the chosen patch.

prompt: Render wait. You watch a progress indicator reach its endpoint.
idea: Watches the render indicator crawl from right through center to left, stills at its endpoint, then returns forward with relaxed ears.

prompt: Projector alignment. You match image corners to a screen.
idea: Checks the projected image high right, high left, low left, then low right, and returns to a level centered alignment.

prompt: Audience sightline. You inspect a screen from low and high positions.
idea: Lowers level to test the audience's low sightline, rises tall to inspect the high view, then centers at a middle height and settles.

prompt: Lens packing. You inspect glass then lower a lens into a padded slot.
idea: Inspect the raised lens with left-right tilts, level it and lower into padding, check both slot edges, then return upright.

prompt: Camera shutdown. You check the final frame then lower and turn away.
idea: Checks the final frame level, lowers into the camera controls through right-to-left turns, returns to the frame once, then turns right away and squares up.

prompt: Barber cape. You settle a cape around a client and check the neckline.
idea: Settle the cape inward from right and left, lower close to its neckline, compare opposing tilts, then level the collar.

prompt: Hair section. You lift a section of hair and inspect its ends.
idea: Lifts the hair section from low, tips left to inspect its ends, makes a small viewing adjustment, then levels at the cutting line.

prompt: Hair trimming. You compare a section length before one careful cut.
idea: Compare hair length right-left, center the section and rise to prepare, then make one careful cutting dip and release.

prompt: Hair clipper line. You trace a straight boundary and inspect its corner.
idea: Traces the clipper boundary from low to high, turns left to inspect its corner, then returns to center and settles.

prompt: Hair dryer pass. You follow a warm airflow across a section.
idea: Follows the dryer airflow right with a left tilt, crosses level through center, then follows it left with a right tilt before centering.

prompt: Salon mirror check. You inspect a finished shape from both rear angles.
idea: Checks the finished haircut far right with the torso following, compares the far-left rear angle, then returns head and body upright.

prompt: Razor stropping. You draw a blade across a strap and reverse it.
idea: Draws the razor low from right across to left, reverses for a deliberate return pass, then centers clear of the strop.

prompt: Barber chair recline. You follow a chair reclining then lean toward the work.
idea: Follows the barber chair reclining into a backward right tilt, pauses, then levels and leans forward-low toward the work before settling.

prompt: Eye chart test. You look toward successive lines on a distant chart.
idea: Reads the eye chart from its high line through progressively lower lines, pauses on the smallest row, then returns centered level.

prompt: Lens trial. You compare the view through two lenses.
idea: Compare the first lens with a left tilt and the second with a right tilt in one slow weighing motion, then level the view and hold.

prompt: Optician fit. You check a frame at both temples then face forward.
idea: Checks the frame at one temple with a left tilt and rightward look, checks the other with a right tilt and leftward look, then faces forward still.

prompt: Ear inspection. You present one side and hold still.
idea: Turns left and tilts left to present one ear, holds still for inspection, then gently releases the tilt and returns center.

prompt: Dental mirror. You tilt back and follow a mirror checking one side.
idea: Tilts back with a slight right roll for the dental mirror, holds the view, follows the mirror left while leveling, then returns centered.

prompt: Dental rinse. You lean forward to rinse then return upright.
idea: Leans deeply forward to rinse, pauses low, then rises in two measured stages and settles upright.

prompt: Dental light. You follow a light being positioned overhead.
idea: Tracks the dental light overhead from right to left, centers beneath it, then freezes the final viewing pose before gently relaxing.

prompt: Stethoscope listen. You lean slightly forward and remain still for listening.
idea: Leans slightly forward for the stethoscope, centers the low pose, holds quietly for listening, then rises gently.

prompt: Blood pressure cuff. You look at a cuff tightening then hold still.
idea: Looks low left toward the tightening cuff, centers and holds still for the reading, then rises after the pressure releases.

prompt: Pulse timing. You lower attention to a wrist and wait through a count.
idea: Lowers attention close to the wrist, settles for the timed pulse count, waits still, then lifts without turning.

prompt: Bandage tension. You inspect a wrap and adjust its overlap.
idea: Follows the bandage overlap low right to left with a small circling inspection, centers over the seam, then lifts slightly after the adjustment.

prompt: Splint alignment. You compare two ends before holding them straight.
idea: Compare the splint ends low right-left, center them level and hold their alignment still, then release gently.

prompt: Crutch fitting. You look at height markers then test an upright stance.
idea: Reads the crutch height marks from low upward, settles into a tall level stance, tests small balancing shifts, then steadies upright.

prompt: Walker step. You brace forward then move into a stable upright stance.
idea: Braces forward-low over the walker, pauses to establish support, rises into an upright stance, then steadies with small balance corrections.

prompt: X-ray position. You turn into a marked angle and hold without moving.
idea: Turns through the marked X-ray angle from right to left, checks farther left, centers the head, holds still for the image, then releases the body.

prompt: Scan alignment. You place your head against an imagined support and stay still.
idea: Advances slowly toward the scan support, centers the head level against it, holds completely still, then withdraws gently.

prompt: Hearing booth. You turn toward a faint tone then return center.
idea: Turns a little left toward the faint booth tone, pauses still to listen, then returns to center and releases the ears.

prompt: Pharmacy label. You compare a bottle label with a written instruction.
idea: Compares the low bottle label on the right with instructions on the left, makes a second small reading sweep, then centers over the bottle and pauses.

prompt: Pill counting tray. You follow tablets into a narrow channel.
idea: Follows the tablets low from right to left and farther left into the channel, tips right with their downward pour, then levels and centers.

prompt: Mortar compounding. You grind a mixture then inspect its fineness.
idea: Grinds the mixture in low circling torso motions, slows the pressure, then leans close in a left tilt to check fineness and squares up.

prompt: Vial stopper. You align a cap and press it evenly.
idea: Check stopper alignment low right-left, center above the vial, press evenly downward, then lift away.

prompt: Specimen bag. You place a labeled container and close its seal.
idea: Lower the labeled container into its bag, close the top through opposing turns, then inspect the seam right-left and center.

prompt: Fire hose brace. You lean against an imagined nozzle reaction.
idea: Advances low with the hose, braces backward into a right tilt against the nozzle reaction, absorbs small pressure pulses, then levels under load.

prompt: Hose nozzle turn. You adjust a nozzle and inspect the stream direction.
idea: Turns the hose nozzle low right to left, makes a small final adjustment, then raises into a steady forward stream watch and squares the body.

prompt: Hydrant coupling. You align a hose connector and turn it home.
idea: Aligns the hydrant coupling low, screws it right to left through repeated turns, then tips left to inspect its seat and returns square.

prompt: Fire ladder sight. You look from ladder feet to the upper landing.
idea: Check the fire-ladder feet right-left, center between them, trace upward to the high landing, then ease the gaze.

prompt: Smoke crawl. You stay low and check the path in short looks.
idea: Stays sunk low while checking the smoke path right and left, carries short alternating looks, then centers ahead without rising.

prompt: Door heat check. You approach a door pause and withdraw to assess.
idea: Approaches the door low, pauses to assess the heat, withdraws upward toward the left, then returns centered at a distance.

prompt: Extinguisher aim. You sight low and sweep a nozzle across a base.
idea: Sights the fire base downward, sweeps the extinguisher from right through center to left, repeats a controlled base sweep, then centers.

prompt: Rescue blanket. You spread a blanket and lower it carefully.
idea: Spreads the rescue blanket broadly from right to left, centers above its placement, lowers it softly, then withdraws upright.

prompt: Stretcher lift. You brace with a load and raise it level.
idea: Braces low under the stretcher, raises head and height together into a level carry, steadies small balance shifts, then holds the load still.

prompt: Stretcher threshold. You pause at a lip and cushion a crossing.
idea: Watches the stretcher threshold low, pauses at the lip, raises the load over it, cushions the far-side descent, then levels.

prompt: Lifeguard scan. You scan water level then inspect a near area.
idea: Scans the water broadly from right through center to left, then lowers close to a near left area and returns centered.

prompt: Rescue ring throw. You wind back and cast a buoyant ring.
idea: Winds the rescue ring backward-high with torso right and gaze left, casts forward through a leftward turn, then follows its flight and squares up.

prompt: Safety harness check. You inspect two fasteners then tug the center strap.
idea: Inspects the harness fasteners low right and left, centers the strap, gives it a small backward tensioning rhythm, then releases upright.

prompt: Traffic baton. You signal a broad stop then direct flow sideways.
idea: Rises tall for the baton stop, holds the signal, turns right then left to direct the route, looks farther left, then returns square.

prompt: Crossing check. You watch both lanes then face the crossing.
idea: Checks the right traffic lane and pauses, checks the left lane and pauses, then faces the crossing square with attentive ears.

prompt: Rail points check. You trace two diverging rails before choosing a line.
idea: Traces the diverging rail right and farther right, checks the left branch and its far line, then centers over the chosen route.

prompt: Rail coupling check. You inspect an undercarriage joint from both sides.
idea: Sinks beneath the rail coupling, inspects from the right in a left tilt and from the left in a right tilt, then levels and rises clear.

prompt: Track gauge. You compare rail spacing then read a central mark.
idea: Compare rail spacing low right-left, center close over the gauge, pause on the mark, then lift from the reading.

prompt: Survey stake. You align a stake with a distant marker then plant it.
idea: Checks the stake low, sights the distant marker high, raises against the planting stroke, then drives down and recovers.

prompt: Survey tape. You follow a taut line and inspect its endpoint.
idea: Follows the taut survey tape from far right through both middle positions to far left, reads the endpoint, then returns center.

prompt: Masonry plumb. You trace a wall upward and check its vertical edge.
idea: Traces the masonry wall upward, tilts left to compare its edge, makes a small plumb correction, then centers high.

prompt: Scaffold clamp. You look up at a joint and tighten it.
idea: Looks up at the scaffold joint on the right, turns its clamp right to left through repeated tightening strokes, then centers and releases the torso.

prompt: Roof tile inspection. You follow an overlapping edge and peek beneath it.
idea: Follows the roof-tile overlap low right to left, dips beneath its edge in a left tilt, then levels and returns center.

prompt: Chimney sweep. You follow a brush rising inside a narrow shaft.
idea: Watches the chimney brush rise through working strokes, follows it higher, then drops the gaze to check the shaft opening and relaxes.

prompt: Glass lifting. You raise a large pane and hold it vertical.
idea: Braces low beneath the glass pane, raises it level, corrects a small left lean, then steadies it with fine balancing motion and centers.

prompt: Glazier fit. You align a pane with a frame and ease it in.
idea: Check the pane's upper corners right-left, lower to the frame, then ease forward into the fit and withdraw.

prompt: Stone slab placement. You lower a heavy slab and inspect the seam.
idea: Lower the heavy slab with a loaded tremble, compare the right and left seam, then lift from the settled placement.

prompt: Carpet stretching. You pull against a carpet edge then smooth the result.
idea: Pulls the carpet edge backward-high with small tensioning tugs, then lowers to scan the smoothed surface right and left before centering.

prompt: Floor sanding. You follow a broad pass and inspect a remaining strip.
idea: Works the sander forward-low through broad passes, stops the working rhythm, then inspects the remaining strip right and left and centers.

prompt: Window restoration. You inspect putty along an old frame.
idea: Inspects putty high on the right, traces downward across the left bottom edge, returns low right for a closer check, then centers.

prompt: Locksmith key blank. You compare a key profile with a reference.
idea: Compare the key blank low right-left, examine its profile with opposing tilts, then center close and lift.

prompt: Lock cylinder test. You turn a fitted key and watch the bolt.
idea: Turns the fitted key right to left, follows the bolt releasing farther left, checks the near edge, then returns square.

prompt: Watchmaker loupe. You lean into a tiny mechanism and hold exact focus.
idea: Dips close through the watchmaker's loupe, tilts left for exact focus, centers over the mechanism, then freezes the inspection.

prompt: Watch gear seating. You lower a tiny gear and check that it lies flat.
idea: Lowers the tiny gear slowly, checks its seat in left and right tilts, makes a minute leveling correction, then straightens.

prompt: Clock escapement. You follow a small regular tick then stop to inspect.
idea: Follows the escapement's small regular tick, stops low to inspect it in a left tilt, then levels and withdraws.

prompt: Shoe last. You pull material over a form and inspect the toe.
idea: Pulls the shoe material backward with small loaded tugs, then lowers left to the toe in a left tilt and returns centered.

prompt: Sole alignment. You match a sole to an upper and press the edge.
idea: Match sole and upper low right-left, center their edges, press down evenly, then lift from the joined shape.

prompt: Heel repair. You inspect a worn edge then seat a replacement.
idea: Checks the worn heel in a low left tilt and then a right tilt, raises the replacement, seats it squarely downward, then releases.

prompt: Shoe stitching. You follow a curved seam around a toe.
idea: Stitches the toe seam low right around a rightward body arc, repeats small working dips, carries the seam left, then centers at its join.

prompt: Hat shaping. You steam a brim then bend it into a curve.
idea: Draw away from steam into a right tilt, shape the brim through left-right curves, then hold its form and level.

prompt: Hat fitting. You inspect brim level from both sides.
idea: Tilt left to inspect the right brim edge and right to compare the left, then raise and settle the hat level.

prompt: Upholstery tuck. You press fabric into a crease and inspect the tension.
idea: Presses the upholstery into its crease with small low tucking dips, rises to compare tension on the right and left, then centers.

prompt: Upholstery pull. You draw fabric taut and secure one edge.
idea: Draw upholstery backward-up and tremble under tension, gather for the fastening beat, then dip sharply to secure it and release.

prompt: Picture hanging. You raise a frame and correct its tilt.
idea: Raises the picture frame, corrects its left and right tilts, narrows the adjustment, then centers the level frame and relaxes.

prompt: Frame miter. You compare two corners before joining them.
idea: Compare the miter corners right-left, turn them inward from opposing sides, then press the joint centrally and release.

prompt: Art conservation. You inspect a fragile patch and make one gentle dab.
idea: Inspects the fragile patch close in a left tilt, stills for alignment, lifts slightly before one gentle dab, then withdraws square.

prompt: Archive handling. You lift a delicate sheet and lay it flat.
idea: Lifts the archival sheet slowly from low, steadies it level, lowers it flat with care, then withdraws from the placement.

prompt: Museum mount. You align an object with a support and check its lean.
idea: Lowers the museum object into its support, checks the lean in opposing tilts, makes a small balance adjustment, then levels.

prompt: Book repair. You lift a loose page align its hinge and press it.
idea: Lifts the loose book page, shifts it left to align its hinge, returns centrally, then presses down gently and releases.

prompt: Instrument repair. You inspect a key mechanism then test its travel.
idea: Dips close to the instrument key, tests its travel with two shallow nods, then stills over the mechanism and lifts.

prompt: Piano tuning pin. You turn a small pin then listen still.
idea: Adjusts the piano pin low from right to left, raises to listen centered, holds still for the pitch, then eases upright.

prompt: Bow rehairing. You draw a bundle taut and inspect its straightness.
idea: Draws the bow hair taut backward and up, checks its straight strand from right to left, then returns to a level centered view.

prompt: Reed adjustment. You inspect a thin tip and test it at a new angle.
idea: Inspects the reed low in a left tilt, rises to test the angle square, then checks a right tilt and returns to centered focus.

prompt: Drum tension. You compare two lugs and test the head center.
idea: Compares the drum lugs low right and left, tightens through opposing turns, then centers for a small testing dip and relaxes.

prompt: Guitar bridge. You inspect a low bridge from either side.
idea: Lowers close to the guitar bridge, inspects its left and right angles, makes a smaller viewing correction, then lifts level.

prompt: Violin soundpost. You peer through a narrow opening and adjust the angle.
idea: Sink toward the violin opening, roll left-right to locate the soundpost, then center the viewing angle and hold close.

prompt: Welding seam. You sight a seam before following it steadily.
idea: Sights the weld seam low on the right, squares the approach, tracks steadily to the left without lifting, then centers over the end.

prompt: Weld inspection. You follow a bead and pause over one irregularity.
idea: Inspects the weld bead low right to left, stops over its irregularity, tilts left and leans closer, then withdraws centered.

prompt: Forge bellows. You compress a bellows then let it reopen.
idea: Raises above the forge bellows, compresses it twice in grounded downward pulses, follows the last reopening, then relaxes.

prompt: Hot metal quench. You lower a hot piece and retreat from steam.
idea: Lowers the hot metal deeply into the quench, recoils backward-up in a right tilt through the steam, then levels at a distance and settles.

prompt: Anvil shaping. You deliver two blows at separate spots.
idea: Raise over the right anvil spot and strike, lift across to the left, deliver a second ringing beat, then recover centered.

prompt: Metal temper color. You tilt a piece toward light and inspect its surface.
idea: Raises the tempered metal toward the light, tilts left to examine the color, makes a slight reflective correction, then lowers cautiously and levels.

prompt: Glassblower gather. You rotate an imagined pipe and inspect a glowing gather.
idea: Rotates the glassblowing pipe from right through center to left beneath a level gaze, keeps a small rolling rhythm, then lowers to inspect the gather.

prompt: Glassblower shape. You roll a form then raise it to inspect symmetry.
idea: Rolls the glass form low through right-to-left body turns, sustains the shaping rhythm, then raises it centrally for a tall symmetry check and squares up.

prompt: Glass cooling. You set a fragile piece down and wait.
idea: Lowers the fragile glass gently, waits over the cooling piece, then withdraws a little and lifts clear.

prompt: Potter wire cut. You draw a wire beneath a pot then lift the freed form.
idea: Draws the cutting wire low from right to left beneath the pot, pauses at the release, then centers and lifts the freed form slowly.

prompt: Florist stem trim. You measure a stem against a vase and shorten it.
idea: Compares the stem low with the vase height, lifts slightly against the trim, makes one small downward cut, then settles to inspect.

prompt: Florist arrangement. You place a tall stem then inspect the whole outline.
idea: Raises the tall flower stem, turns left to position it, lowers into the arrangement, then centers and looks up over its outline.

prompt: Bouquet wrapping. You circle stems with paper and tighten the base.
idea: Wraps the bouquet through low right-to-left turns, checks both paper edges, centers the base, then draws backward-up to tighten and releases.

prompt: Wreath binding. You follow a circular frame and secure one loose section.
idea: Circles the wreath low with a gentle winding rhythm, checks the loose section right and left, then presses it centrally and lifts.

prompt: Sword drawing. You mime drawing a long blade and presenting it.
idea: Looks low across the right side, turns the body right to draw the sword, rises through a leftward reveal, then looks farther left and returns square.

prompt: Sword sheathing. You sight an imagined sheath and lower a blade carefully.
idea: Sights the sheath low on the right, raises the blade slightly into line, lowers it carefully, then returns centered after seating it.

prompt: Shield deflection. You brace behind an imagined shield then redirect a blow.
idea: Braces low behind the shield on the right with a left tilt, rises into a leftward deflection, absorbs a small recoil, then returns square.

prompt: Spear thrust. You coil before sending an imagined spear straight ahead.
idea: Coils backward-high with torso right and gaze left, drives the spear straight forward, then rebounds from the thrust and squares up.

prompt: Halberd sweep. You mime a wide low sweep with a heavy polearm.
idea: Winds the halberd high to the right, sweeps the heavy arc low toward the left, follows farther left, then returns head and torso square.

prompt: Staff vault. You plant an imagined staff and rise over it.
idea: Plants the staff forward-low, rises over it into a tall leftward crest, cushions the landing, then returns square.

prompt: Bowstring test. You pull an imagined string then release its tension gently.
idea: Draws the imagined bowstring backward, holds the loaded position through a slight tension tremble, then releases slowly forward and settles.

prompt: Quiver reach. You look over a shoulder then return with an imagined arrow.
idea: Looks high behind the right shoulder, reaches farther right with the torso, then brings the imagined arrow low into central alignment and squares up.

prompt: Helmet visor raise. You look through a narrow slit then lift an imagined visor.
idea: Peer low through the visor slit, lift it high, scan the opened view right-left, then center.

prompt: Armor weight. You settle under an imagined heavy suit then straighten.
idea: Sinks under the armor's weight, corrects left and right balance, trembles slightly under the load, then straightens tall.

prompt: Knight kneel. You lower into a formal kneeling pose and rise.
idea: Lowers head and height together into a formal kneel, holds the respectful pose, then unfolds slowly and settles upright.

prompt: Castle portcullis. You watch a gate rise then duck under it.
idea: Watches the portcullis climb overhead, pauses at its height, compresses low beneath the opening, then advances through and rises.

prompt: Dungeon key. You turn an enormous imagined key and inspect the door.
idea: Loads the giant key low on the right, stalls under resistance, works a small freeing turn, then rotates left and looks forward at the released door.

prompt: Treasure lid. You strain against a heavy chest lid and look inside.
idea: Braces low against the treasure lid, pulls upward through small loaded efforts, raises the heavy lid high, then peers into the chest and withdraws.

prompt: Treasure map unfurl. You open a rolled map and trace its route.
idea: Unfurls the map through broad right-to-left turns, lowers to trace a winding route right then far left and inward, then centers over the destination.

prompt: Spy periscope. You peek above cover scan then sink out of sight.
idea: Rise level above cover, scan right-left and center, then sink compactly out of sight.

prompt: Spy corner. You lean around cover then withdraw without turning fully.
idea: Leans low left around cover, extends the gaze right while leveling, pauses on the hidden view, then retracts to center.

prompt: Secret panel. You press an imagined catch then watch a wall move.
idea: Presses the secret catch low, follows the panel opening right, lets the torso track its widening movement left, then looks through farther left and squares up.

prompt: Laser grid. You mime passing beneath one beam and around another.
idea: Ducks under the first laser beam, tilts left around the next obstruction with a rightward body turn, centers low, then tilts right to clear it and rises square.

prompt: Tripwire. You spot a thin line and lift carefully over it.
idea: Inspects the tripwire closely below, rises carefully over it, absorbs a small balance shift, then lands softly and levels.

prompt: Grappling line. You look high throw a hook and test its hold.
idea: Looks high and coils the grappling throw right with gaze left, releases through the leftward turn, then leans backward in a right tilt to test the hold and centers.

prompt: Rope bridge sway. You cross a fantasy bridge that swings beneath you.
idea: Crosses the rope bridge low with a left correction and rightward turn, counters right while turning left, then rides broad sways before centering.

prompt: Suspended platform. You wait for a moving platform then step onto it.
idea: Tracks the moving platform right to left, watches a smaller return swing, lowers to prepare the step, then rises aboard and steadies centered.

prompt: Indiana hat. You duck under a closing door then look back at an imagined hat.
idea: Sees the closing door high, ducks sharply under it, looks far left behind for the hat, then rises forward after retrieving it.

prompt: Boulder chase. You look behind then lean into an escape run.
idea: Looks far left behind at the boulder, turns the body left to confirm it, squares into an escape lean, then runs with energetic forward bounces and eases.

prompt: Rolling barrier. You watch a large obstacle pass then move through.
idea: Tracks the rolling barrier from right to left, waits for it to clear, centers low, then advances through the gap and rises.

prompt: Wizard gathering. You gather an imagined spell upward before releasing it.
idea: Gathers the spell low on the right, rises in a leftward coil with pulsing height, then lifts against a forward snap and releases square.

prompt: Wizard shield. You brace as if forming a barrier then hold it.
idea: Crouches to gather the wizard shield, expands upward and forward, locks the barrier briefly, then absorbs a small energy ripple and relaxes.

prompt: Spell interrupted by echo. You begin an incantation but its returning echo triggers the release before you finish.
idea: Inhales deeply backward with a slight left tilt, freezes at the returning echo, snaps forward too early, recoils, then regathers in a cautious tremble.

prompt: Wizard misfire. You begin a spell recoil inspect then try again.
idea: Raises to begin the spell, dips against its failed burst, recoils backward in a right tilt, then lowers to inspect and prepares a renewed release.

prompt: Staff illumination. You touch an imagined staff down and watch its tip brighten.
idea: Raises slightly before touching the staff down, follows its brightening tip upward, watches a gentle glow pulse, then settles beneath it.

prompt: Portal opening. You follow a widening imaginary doorway and step toward it.
idea: Opens the portal with broad right-to-left turns, follows its widening height, then centers and advances toward the doorway before squaring up.

prompt: Portal closing. You watch an opening shrink and retreat from it.
idea: Watch the portal's high right and left edges, follow the narrowing gap centrally, then lower and draw back as it closes.

prompt: Teleport arrival. You appear from a low compact pose and orient yourself.
idea: Compact low before teleporting, burst upward and freeze on arrival, then orient with a right-left scan and center.

prompt: Time freeze. You stop midway through a sweeping movement.
idea: Sweeps from a rightward body turn into a high leftward pose with a right roll, freezes time off-center, then slowly releases square.

prompt: Time rewind. You reverse a completed gesture back to its starting pose.
idea: Completes a downward leftward gesture, reverses through the same low path toward the right, then rises back to the centered starting pose.

prompt: Gravity reversal. You mime being pulled upward then returning to normal.
idea: Rises unusually tall under reversed gravity, suspends there, drops when weight returns, then damps small balance shifts into neutral.

prompt: Invisible weight. You struggle to lift an object that stays on the ground.
idea: Braces over the invisible weight, lifts against it in repeated loaded attempts, sinks after the failure, then gathers for one slower retry and releases.

prompt: Shrinking potion. You mime getting smaller while inspecting your changed height.
idea: Shrink through two lower levels, inspect the changed world right-left, then center in the smaller posture.

prompt: Growing potion. You mime growing tall then inspect the room above.
idea: Grows upward through two height surges, checks the upper room right and left, then steadies the newly tall pose with small sways.

prompt: Royal scepter. You raise an imagined ceremonial object and present it.
idea: Looks low right toward the scepter, turns to raise it, presents it tall at center, then squares the body and holds the ceremony pose.

prompt: Royal procession. You advance with an even elevated posture then halt.
idea: Advances in a tall royal procession with even small vertical beats, turns slightly left on arrival, then halts square and still before relaxing.

prompt: Crown fitting. You lower an imagined crown and test its balance.
idea: Raises beneath the crown, settles slightly as it lands, checks left and right balance, then lets tiny corrections fade level.

prompt: Throne settling. You sit slowly into an imagined high-backed throne.
idea: Holds tall above the throne, lowers level into the seat, leans back with a right tilt, then levels into a settled regal rest.

prompt: Scroll proclamation. You unroll a scroll read then address the distance.
idea: Unroll the proclamation with right-left body turns, read low across its sides, then rise square to address the distance.

prompt: Banner planting. You drive a pole into the ground and look up its length.
idea: Raises the banner pole against the planting stroke, drives it down, follows the planted shaft upward, then steadies the high flag view.

prompt: Explorer lens. You inspect a strange marking then compare it to a map.
idea: Inspects the strange marking close in a left tilt, lowers toward the map on the right, compares the marking on the left, then returns centered and levels.

prompt: Ancient mechanism. You turn an imagined wheel and watch stone doors separate.
idea: Strains the ancient wheel from right to left through small loaded turns, watches the doors separate right and left, then returns square.

prompt: Pressure plate. You feel a tile sink and freeze before lifting away.
idea: Feels the pressure plate sink, freezes low, lifts carefully off it, then checks the tile below and withdraws.

prompt: Falling sand trap. You look up at sand then duck and search for an exit.
idea: Looks up at falling sand, recoils in a right tilt, ducks low, scans right and left for an exit, then centers beneath the fall.

prompt: Drawbridge crank. You turn a heavy crank then watch a bridge lower.
idea: Works the drawbridge crank from right through center to left with heavy repeated turns, then follows the bridge lowering and returns square.

prompt: Capstan push. You brace against a large wheel and walk it around.
idea: Braces forward-low against the capstan, pushes through a broad right-to-left body arc with loaded walking pulses, then releases centered.

prompt: Winch pawl. You advance a crank and pause to let a catch engage.
idea: Turns the winch crank right to left, dips to watch the pawl engage, resets right, then advances left again and centers.

prompt: Ratchet strap release. You unload a ratchet and let tension out carefully.
idea: Draws back to unload the ratchet, turns the release right then left low, then lets the tension descend gradually and returns square.

prompt: Spring clamp. You compress jaws position them and let them close.
idea: Compress the spring clamp low and advance it onto the work, release its jaws, then check placement right-left and center.

prompt: Toggle latch. You pull a lever over center then inspect the catch.
idea: Loads the toggle lever on the right, pulls it left and slightly upward over center, drops into the latched stop, then returns square to inspect.

prompt: Cam lock. You turn a cam and watch two panels pull together.
idea: Compares the cam-lock panels low right and left, turns the cam right to left as they draw together, then centers over the closed joint and releases.

prompt: Bayonet fitting. You insert a part then quarter-turn it into place.
idea: Inserts the bayonet fitting forward-low, quarter-turns it right to left into place, then withdraws centrally to inspect the locked part.

prompt: Dovetail slide. You align an angled rail and slide a part along it.
idea: Inspects the dovetail in a low left tilt, squares the rail, starts on the right, then slides left and lifts centered after the fit.
