prompt: Snap-fit tab. You flex a tab lower it into a slot and release.
idea: Flexes the snap tab downward under tension, lifts slightly to align it, settles into the slot, then briefly stills at release and withdraws.

prompt: Telescoping pole. You extend sections and lock the final joint.
idea: Extends the pole upward in two stages, locks its high joint with right-to-left turns, then centers to inspect the extended length.

prompt: Folding hinge. You open a joint until straight and test its lock.
idea: Opens the hinge right to left until straight, levels the head, tests the lock with a small forward pulse, then returns square.

prompt: Ball joint. You adjust an angle then tighten and recheck.
idea: Test the ball joint in left-right tilts, tighten it through opposing turns, recheck the selected left angle, then level square.

prompt: Flexible arm. You bend a support into an arc and inspect its end.
idea: Bends the flexible arm from low right around a rising arc, turns left toward its high tip, then makes a small checking sway and centers.

prompt: Suction cup. You press a cup flat and test its seal.
idea: Presses the suction cup flat, holds the seal, draws back slightly to test it, then gives a tiny checking tug and relaxes.

prompt: Vacuum release. You lift a seal edge and watch the cup detach.
idea: Finds the suction edge low in a left tilt, loads a slight downward counterpressure, lifts suddenly as it detaches, then steadies level.

prompt: Velcro peel. You pull a fastening strip back along itself.
idea: Starts the fastening strip low, peels it backward-up through small resisting pulses, then turns left to inspect the free strip and centers.

prompt: Magnetic clasp. You bring two halves together and check alignment.
idea: Compares the magnetic clasp halves low right and left, brings them together centrally, then gives a tiny confirming nod and lifts.

prompt: Press stud release. You pull against a snap until it separates.
idea: Pull backward against the press stud with a strained tremble, dip against its resistance, then rise as it separates and return upright.

prompt: Bungee tension. You stretch a cord then ease it back slowly.
idea: Stretches the bungee backward and up, steadies its loaded tremble, then eases forward through two measured stages and relaxes.

prompt: Hook-and-eye. You align a small hook and lower it into an eye.
idea: Aligns the hook in a low left tilt, centers above the eye, advances carefully, then lowers the last small amount and withdraws.

prompt: Chain link. You inspect an open link then close it around another.
idea: Check chain links low right-left, close the open link with opposing inward turns, then dip centrally to verify contact and release.

prompt: Split ring. You pry a ring open feed an item around and inspect closure.
idea: Pries the split ring open in a low left tilt, lifts the gap, feeds the item around through right-to-left turns, then checks the closed join centrally.

prompt: Cord cleat. You pull a cord down and let a cleat grip it.
idea: Raises to take the cord, pulls down under tension, pauses as the cleat grips, then tests backward with a small tug and relaxes.

prompt: Drawstring. You pull two ends evenly and inspect the gathered opening.
idea: Pulls the drawstring ends through opposing low turns, centers their even tension, rises to tighten, then looks down at the gathered opening and releases.

prompt: Cord lock. You compress a lock slide it and release at the mark.
idea: Compresses the cord lock low on the right, slides it left under pressure, releases at the mark, then centers to inspect the new position.

prompt: Zipper slider. You seat both sides of a zipper before pulling up.
idea: Checks both zipper sides low right and left, centers them in the slider, starts with a small tug, then follows the zip upward and settles.

prompt: Gear mesh. You bring two gears together and test a small rotation.
idea: Compare the gears low on each side, bring them centrally together, test their mesh through a right-left rocking turn, then release square.

prompt: Belt pulley. You place a belt over a wheel and rotate it into its groove.
idea: Places the belt low around the wheel, rotates it right to left into its groove, sustains a small seating turn, then inspects the edge in a left tilt and centers.

prompt: Chain sprocket. You guide a chain onto teeth and turn it through.
idea: Guides the chain low right around the sprocket, turns through to the left with repeated feeding pulses, then raises to inspect alignment and squares up.

prompt: Flywheel spin. You give a wheel one push and follow its coast.
idea: Winds the flywheel to the right, pushes it left into motion, follows its coasting rhythm, then reduces the tracking and holds centered.

prompt: Handwheel stop. You turn toward a limit then ease off at the stop.
idea: Turns the handwheel from right through center toward the left limit, pauses under load, eases back a little, then returns square.

prompt: Rack-and-pinion. You turn a knob while following a straight sliding carriage.
idea: Turns the rack-and-pinion knob right to left, follows the carriage sliding low from right to left, then centers at its stop.

prompt: Lead screw. You advance a carriage slowly then reverse it to a mark.
idea: Advances the lead screw right to left, pauses beyond the mark, reverses right slowly, then centers to inspect the corrected position and releases.

prompt: Worm gear. You turn a handle and watch a slow heavy movement.
idea: Turns the worm-gear handle from right through center to left, sustains its repeated effort, then watches the heavy mechanism rise and centers.

prompt: Lever fulcrum. You press one end and watch the far end lift.
idea: Presses the lever's near end deeply, follows the far end lifting across to the left, then eases off and returns centered.

prompt: Counterweight lift. You release a load and follow the balancing weight.
idea: Releases the low right load, follows the opposite counterweight rising left, watches its small settling bounce, then centers.

prompt: Scissor jack. You turn a screw and watch crossed supports rise.
idea: Turns the scissor-jack screw low right to left through repeated strokes, follows the supports rising in stages, then centers over the raised platform.

prompt: Hydraulic pump. You make two pumping strokes then watch a platform rise.
idea: Raises for the hydraulic pump, presses twice through a measured nodding rhythm, then follows the platform rising and settles.

prompt: Pressure release. You turn a valve and follow a platform descending.
idea: Turns the pressure-release valve low right to left, lifts to the platform, then follows its measured descent and returns square.

prompt: Air bellows. You compress a chamber then let it refill.
idea: Compresses the air bellows deeply, pauses under pressure, lets it refill upward, then repeats a gentler compression and recovery.

prompt: Siphon priming. You watch a tube fill and then follow its outflow.
idea: Watches the siphon tube fill from high to low, turns toward the left outlet, follows the outflow nearer left, then centers.

prompt: Check valve. You test one direction then reverse to feel the stop.
idea: Tests forward flow through the check valve, withdraws, attempts the resisted direction, then freezes at the stop and releases.

prompt: Float switch. You raise a float and inspect the triggered response.
idea: Raises the float from low, pauses at the switch point, turns left to inspect the triggered indicator, then returns centered.

prompt: Limit switch. You advance an object to a stop and observe the switch.
idea: Advances low toward the limit switch, stops at contact, turns left to inspect its response, then withdraws centered.

prompt: Safety interlock. You close a guard and verify that it seats.
idea: Lowers the safety guard into place, checks the right and left seating edges, gives a small central testing nod, then rests square.

prompt: Mechanical reset. You release a catch return a slider and test it again.
idea: Dips to release the catch, returns the slider right, centers before moving it left, then tests forward and withdraws square.

prompt: Head switch access. You position beside a switch press with a deliberate tilt and release.
idea: Checks the head switch on the left, tilts right into deliberate contact, releases fully square, then gives one brief confirming look and returns.

prompt: Chin joystick. You lower onto an imagined chin control and steer through a corner.
idea: Lowers onto the chin joystick, steers right through center toward the left corner, lifts clear of the control, then checks ahead and settles.

prompt: Sip control. You approach an imagined mouth tube hold alignment and withdraw.
idea: Approaches the sip tube low-forward, squares the alignment and holds, withdraws upward, then checks the tube from the left and centers.

prompt: Puff control. You prepare a breath then give one short directed input.
idea: Draws back and rises for a directed breath, leans forward in one short puff, withdraws, then looks left to watch the result and centers still.

prompt: Eye gaze calibration. You fix on a sequence of targets around a display.
idea: Fixes the display center, checks high right then high left, lowers through the left and right targets, then returns square after calibration.

prompt: Eye gaze dwell. You settle on one target and wait for activation.
idea: Scans two gaze targets right and left, centers precisely for the dwell, holds the activation, then lifts slightly and checks the result below.

prompt: Gaze overshoot. You pass a target backtrack and hold the corrected position.
idea: Sweeps right through center past the target to the left, pauses, backtracks through center toward the right, then fixes center longer and relaxes upward.

prompt: Switch scanning. You wait through successive choices and make one selection.
idea: Follows the switch choices right, center, and left with measured stops, returns to the chosen central option, gives a small selection nod, then releases.

prompt: Scanning missed target. You let an option pass then wait for its next cycle.
idea: Watches the missed scan option pass from right through center to left, waits on the returning rightward cycle, then finds the left option again and confirms at center.

prompt: Switch double activation. You release a held control fully before selecting again.
idea: Contacts the switch on the left with a right tilt, pauses, releases fully upright, waits, then makes a shorter second contact and clearly withdraws.

prompt: Large button press. You align over a broad pad and press without sliding.
idea: Check the broad button's edges right-left, center and rise slightly, press straight down, then lift to verify from above.

prompt: Keyguard opening. You line up with one opening among surrounding keys.
idea: Scans the keyguard low right and left, tilts left to judge depth, centers for a gentle advance, then withdraws and checks the selected position again.

prompt: Keyguard misentry. You touch an edge withdraw and realign with the intended hole.
idea: Dips against the wrong keyguard edge, stops, rises into a left tilt to realign, then centers for a slower second descent and checks the result.

prompt: Mouth stylus target. You sight a small target and make a controlled forward touch.
idea: Raises level with the stylus target, looks down to center it, advances into a controlled touch, then retracts on the same line and relaxes.

prompt: Mouth stylus lift. You finish a mark then clear the surface before repositioning.
idea: Finishes the stylus mark low, lifts vertically clear, turns left to reposition, lowers for a brief second mark, then withdraws fully to center.

prompt: Forehead pointer. You touch one high target then retract without dragging.
idea: Lifts toward the high forehead-pointer target, advances to contact, holds briefly, retracts, then lowers to inspect the response and centers.

prompt: Head mouse drag. You hold a selection while moving it across a screen.
idea: Fixes the head-mouse selection on the right, drags it smoothly through center to the left, pauses to release with a small lift, then returns square.

prompt: Head mouse recenter. You reach a movement limit and reset the working position.
idea: Reaches the head-mouse limit right, resets the torso and gaze toward center, resumes a leftward movement, then makes a smaller right correction and squares up.

prompt: Trackpad edge. You lift clear of an edge and restart a cursor stroke.
idea: Follows the trackpad stroke low right to left, lifts at the edge, returns farther right, then lowers for a shorter right-to-left pass and centers.

prompt: Ball control reversal. You roll an imagined control one way then reverse to a target.
idea: Rolls the ball control right to left, stops centrally, reverses right and eases back left, then lowers to inspect the target and rises square.

prompt: Foot switch cue. You look down to place a foot then face the screen for activation.
idea: Checks the foot-switch placement low left, centers and raises toward the screen, makes a small confirming nod, then resumes the upright watch.

prompt: Knee switch positioning. You inspect a side control before aligning your seated posture.
idea: Inspects the knee control low left, turns the seated body slightly toward it, centers and sinks level, then checks the control once more and settles square.

prompt: Elbow pad contact. You mime settling onto a broad side control then lifting away.
idea: Looks left toward the elbow pad, lowers nearer left with a right roll into contact, then centers and lifts away before checking the released position.

prompt: Joystick dead zone. You make a small input notice no response and increase it carefully.
idea: Tries a small rightward joystick input, returns center when nothing happens, increases the leftward input with a body turn, then checks farther left and releases square.

prompt: Joystick spring return. You release a deflected control and watch it center.
idea: Follows the joystick deflection right with the torso, waits, releases gradually to center, checks low, then returns to the forward view.

prompt: Accessible latch. You push a broad lever down then pull a door open.
idea: Sights the broad latch low, rises to prepare, presses it downward, then turns right to left to open the door and looks through before centering.

prompt: Lever handle clearance. You approach a handle at an angle then square before pressing.
idea: Approaches the lever in a low left tilt, squares and presses forward, withdraws, then turns right to left and looks through the opened leftward gap before centering.

prompt: Push plate door. You align with a large plate and move through after it opens.
idea: Align low with the push plate and press forward, pause as the door opens, then check its edges right-left and move through centered.

prompt: Automatic door sensor. You enter a sensing zone pause then pass through.
idea: Enter the sensor zone and stop, watch the automatic door edges right-left and wait for clearance, then rise forward through the opening.

prompt: Door hold interval. You wait for a door to finish opening before crossing.
idea: Watches the door open from right through center to left, waits square until it clears, advances through, then glances far left behind and returns forward.

prompt: Reach extender. You align an imagined grabber close it and lift a distant object.
idea: Sights the distant grabber target low far right, advances nearer right and grips, lifts slowly, carries it left toward the body, then centers for a close check.

prompt: Grabber slip. You feel an object slide then reset the grip and lift again.
idea: Begins lifting with the grabber, drops low as the object slips, stops, realigns in a left tilt, then lifts slowly and steadies the recovered object.

prompt: Page turner device. You watch a page lift cross and settle flat.
idea: Watches the page rise in a leftward arc, follows it down nearer left, waits for it to settle, then reads right to left and centers.

prompt: Page turner stall. You notice a page stop halfway and reset before retrying.
idea: Follows the stalled page upward, checks the stop, lowers into a left tilt, resets square, then repeats the leftward arc and watches it settle.

prompt: Book cradle angle. You raise a page toward eye level and inspect its tilt.
idea: Raise the cradle to eye level, check it with a left-right tilt, center to read, then lower to inspect both supports and settle.

prompt: Electronic magnifier. You position over print then follow one enlarged line.
idea: Lowers the electronic magnifier close to the print, reads one line right to left, returns right for the next lower line, then reads left again and centers.

prompt: Magnifier return sweep. You finish a line and locate the start of the next one.
idea: Finishes the magnified line right to left, lifts clear, returns right, lowers to the next line, then resumes leftward reading and centers.

prompt: Tactile map orientation. You inspect a raised map edge then align toward the route.
idea: Inspects the raised-map boundary low right and left, turns the body right to left to match its orientation, then raises ahead and squares up.

prompt: Braille line tracking. You mime following a tactile line then moving to the next.
idea: Follows the tactile line steadily from low right to left, returns to the right start one level lower, then reads a second shorter pass and centers.

prompt: Braille display advance. You finish a line activate advance and inspect the new line.
idea: Reads the braille line low right to left, dips once to advance, lifts slightly on the return right, then reads the new line leftward and centers.

prompt: Tactile button search. You find a raised marker before pressing its associated control.
idea: Searches the tactile controls in a low left tilt from right to left, centers over the raised marker, presses its control, then withdraws to check the response.

prompt: Raised dot alignment. You compare a marked control with its neighbor.
idea: Compares the marked control low right with its neighbor left, returns to the right mark, makes one careful downward contact, then lifts centered.

prompt: Talking scale. You place an object then hold still while awaiting the result.
idea: Places the object on the talking scale, waits still after releasing it, raises to listen, rechecks the object low, then returns square.

prompt: Talking thermometer. You hold a sensor steady then lift to attend to its result.
idea: Positions the talking thermometer low, holds the sensor still, lifts gently to hear the result, checks left, then centers quietly.

prompt: Vibrating timer. You feel a cue then inspect and reset the device.
idea: Reacts to the vibrating timer with a short tremble, lowers to its control, resets it right to left, then centers and waits for confirmation.

prompt: Tactile timer dial. You locate a raised notch and rotate to a marked setting.
idea: Finds the timer notch in a low left tilt, squares it, turns right to left toward the mark, backs off slightly right, then raises to check and centers.

prompt: High contrast edge. You inspect a marked step before moving over it.
idea: Inspects the marked step low right and left, centers and compresses, rises over the edge, then lands with a small settling correction.

prompt: White cane arc. You mime checking the ground in a broad side-to-side arc.
idea: Checks the ground with the cane in a broad right-to-left arc, repeats the sweep level, pauses centrally, then lifts to inspect the route ahead.

prompt: Cane obstacle contact. You stop at a sensed obstruction and inspect an alternate route.
idea: Stops low at the cane contact, inspects the obstruction right and farther right, scans the opposite left route, then turns left and rises forward square.

prompt: Cane dropoff. You notice an edge ahead and withdraw to a stable position.
idea: Dips at the detected dropoff, freezes, withdraws upward, checks both low sides from stability, then centers and settles.

prompt: Curb ramp alignment. You find the ramp center before descending.
idea: Compare the ramp edges right-left, recheck the right approach, center and descend, then rise to inspect the path beyond.

prompt: Curb ramp exit. You watch a slope flatten and return to level posture.
idea: Follow the ramp flattening beneath a low gaze, rise to level, check right-left in a measured sweep, then steady centrally.

prompt: Wheelchair brake. You look beside the seat set a brake and test stillness.
idea: Looks beside the chair low left, shifts toward the brake, centers for a small forward test, checks right, then holds and rises square.

prompt: Wheelchair footrest. You inspect a footplate swing it aside and recheck the gap.
idea: Inspects the footrest deeply low left, swings it farther left with the body, checks the central gap from both low sides, then rises square.

prompt: Wheelchair transfer board. You check both ends of a bridge before shifting across.
idea: Checks both transfer-board ends low right and left, sinks level at center, shifts through a careful right-to-left turn, then rises at the far side square.

prompt: Wheelchair threshold. You pause at a raised strip then pass it with a controlled lift.
idea: Watches the threshold low, stops, compresses for the lift, rises over the strip, then cushions the landing and rechecks ahead.

prompt: Wheelchair narrow turn. You judge two clearances then pivot within the gap.
idea: Compares both narrow-turn clearances, counterlooks left while pivoting right, rotates left to straighten, then checks both sides again and centers.

prompt: Wheelchair reverse. You check behind then realign with a narrow space.
idea: Checks far left behind, turns the body left then counterturns right beneath a leftward gaze, compares the side edges, and straightens through a final leftward correction.

prompt: Chair armrest clearance. You check a removable side support before passing through.
idea: Checks the armrest low left, rises and turns left to clear it, looks farther left, then returns low to compare the gap edges and settles square.

prompt: Seat cushion positioning. You compare cushion edges and settle centered above it.
idea: Checks the cushion edges low right and left, centers and lowers level, pauses, then rises slightly to compare the seated alignment and settles.

prompt: Transfer bench. You inspect a bench edge then shift to the center.
idea: Inspects the bench's far right edge, dips nearer right, turns carefully from right to left, then levels and checks the new center.

prompt: Shower seat. You check seat position lower steadily then inspect nearby controls.
idea: Lowers level onto the shower seat, pauses, looks low left toward the controls and farther left to check them, then centers in a stable seated pose.

prompt: Grab rail. You sight a support lean toward it and stabilize.
idea: Sights the grab rail to the left, approaches nearer left and loads it low, then rises while aligned and checks the support once more before centering.

prompt: Bed rail. You locate a support beside a bed before rising.
idea: Finds the bed rail low right, turns toward it and compresses, rises steadily through a slight left correction, then levels the balance and squares up.

prompt: Bed height adjust. You watch a sleeping surface move to a useful level.
idea: Watches the bed surface rise in stages, pauses at the useful height, checks the right and left edges, then returns to level center.

prompt: Recliner return. You follow a seat moving from reclined to upright.
idea: Follows the recliner forward from a backward right tilt, lowers slightly into upright seating, checks the control through opposing turns, then centers.

prompt: Lift sling alignment. You compare two suspension sides before a slow rise.
idea: Checks the sling sides low right and left, centers level for the slow rise, makes tiny opposing balance corrections, then stills at height.

prompt: Walker doorway. You sight a doorway then center the frame before advancing.
idea: Checks the doorway edges right and left, squares the walker low, advances through, then rises and looks far left behind to verify clearance before centering.

prompt: Rollator seat turn. You stop check the seat then rotate into alignment.
idea: Stops and checks the rollator seat rearward left, rotates carefully right then left into alignment, centers, then lowers level and settles.

prompt: Forearm crutch cuff. You check a cuff position then test a supported stance.
idea: Checks the crutch cuff low left, rises level, loads the support with a slight left tilt, then steadies and returns forward.

prompt: Cane height check. You compare a handle with a comfortable support level.
idea: Follows the cane handle from low to the support height, checks its leftward alignment, sinks slightly into the stance, then returns level center.

prompt: Reacher shelf. You sight an object high above then bring it down gradually.
idea: Sights the high shelf object on the right, aligns the body beneath it, rises a little to grip, then follows the retrieval down into a close centered inspection.

prompt: Easy-open ring. You hook a large pull ring and draw it backward.
idea: Hook the large ring below, draw backward with a loaded tremble, then lift it open and inspect the edge in a left tilt.

prompt: Adaptive jar mat. You brace a jar against a surface before turning its lid.
idea: Brace the jar on its mat, turn right-left against resistance and reset, then rock through the retry and rise to inspect.

prompt: One-handed board. You place an item against a stop and verify it cannot slide.
idea: Places the item against the board stop, checks its low right and left clearance, gives a small central forward test, then withdraws and settles.

prompt: Rocker knife. You mime a controlled rocking cut and inspect the separated piece.
idea: Raises the rocker knife, rolls the cut down from left to right, lifts for a shallower rocking pass, then inspects the separated piece low and levels.

prompt: Plate guard. You guide a portion toward a raised plate edge.
idea: Guides the portion from low right to the left plate guard, lifts slightly at the stop, returns center, then makes a gentler second right-to-left pass and releases.

prompt: Angled spoon. You inspect a tilted utensil then raise it without spilling.
idea: Inspects the angled spoon low in a right tilt, centers it, lifts slowly without spilling, then lowers and checks the original angle before leveling.

prompt: Two-handle cup. You center over a cup lift evenly and lower carefully.
idea: Checks the cup handles low right and left, lifts evenly at center, holds level, lowers carefully, then rechecks both edges and settles.

prompt: Cup cutout. You tilt a cup while keeping your head level.
idea: Keeps the head near level while tipping the cutout cup in a right roll, lowers gently, rises and levels, then checks the rim to the left and centers.

prompt: Liquid level alarm. You pour slowly then stop at a tactile cue.
idea: Pours slowly in a low right tilt, reacts to the level cue with a small pulse, levels immediately, then withdraws and checks the filled vessel.

prompt: Kettle tipper. You tip a supported kettle then return it to its cradle.
idea: Tips the supported kettle right, follows the pour low left, returns it level to the cradle, then checks both support edges and centers.

prompt: Dispenser palm pad. You align a broad press and hold until a portion releases.
idea: Checks the dispenser pad low right and left, centers and rises slightly, presses down until the portion releases, then lifts to inspect below.

prompt: Pump attachment. You press an extended lever then verify its full return.
idea: Presses the extended pump lever downward, rises with its return, checks the left side, then centers for a small testing nod and releases.

prompt: Zipper loop. You use a large loop to draw a zipper upward.
idea: Finds the zipper loop low, pulls upward in stages, checks a snag, lowers slightly to free it, then resumes the upward track and settles.

prompt: Button hook. You feed a hook through an opening and draw a button back.
idea: Feeds the button hook low through a right-to-left turn, draws the button backward-up, then checks both joined edges below and returns square.

prompt: Dressing stick. You guide a fabric loop over an imagined support.
idea: Guides the fabric loop from low right through a rising body arc to the left, follows it farther left, then centers low with a left-tilted check and squares up.

prompt: Sock aid. You lower a prepared sleeve then draw it upward steadily.
idea: Lowers the sock aid deeply, pauses, draws it up in two steady stages, then checks both low sides and releases.

prompt: Long shoehorn. You follow a smooth insertion into a narrow shoe opening.
idea: Aligns the long shoehorn low in a left tilt, advances slowly into the opening, withdraws upward, then checks the shoe from the left and centers.

prompt: Elastic lace tension. You pull a closure even and test its give.
idea: Checks the elastic-lace ends low right and left, pulls back evenly at center, tests the give with small tugs, then releases slightly and settles.

prompt: Magnetic clothing closure. You align two fabric edges and inspect their meeting.
idea: Compares the magnetic fabric edges low right and left, brings them together, lifts to inspect the top seam in a left tilt, then traces down and levels.

prompt: Large zipper docking. You seat an oversized zipper pin squarely before pulling.
idea: Tilts low over the large zipper pin, centers and seats it gently, follows the slow upward pull, then checks the lower join again and withdraws.

prompt: Accessible game piece. You align a raised piece with a tactile recess.
idea: Searches the tactile recess low right and left, tilts left to find its edge, centers and lowers the piece, then lifts slightly to check both sides and settles.

prompt: Tactile measuring cup. You find a raised fill mark then inspect the level.
idea: Traces the raised cup scale upward from low, stops at the fill mark, tilts left for the level, then squares a close check and withdraws.

prompt: Audible measuring tape. You extend a measure hold it still and await the result.
idea: Extends the audible measure from far right across to far left, holds to hear the result, then compares its near endpoints and returns center.

prompt: Large dial thermostat. You find the grip turn to a setting then inspect.
idea: Reads the thermostat, lowers to the dial, turns right to left, reverses a smaller amount right, then raises to verify the setting and centers.

prompt: Bedside call pad. You locate a broad pad activate it and release clearly.
idea: Finds the call pad low left, centers over it, presses deliberately, then lifts fully away into an upright waiting posture.

prompt: Accessible elevator panel. You scan large buttons select one then face the doors.
idea: Scans the elevator panel vertically, dips once at the chosen button, lifts and turns right to left toward the doors, then waits centered.

prompt: Cross-thread rescue. You stop a screw that enters crookedly and back it out before trying squarely again.
idea: Stops the crooked screw under downward pressure, draws back, inspects it in a right tilt, centers for a gentle retry, then withdraws.

prompt: Stripped screw diagnosis. You notice a turning tool slipping without moving the fastener and stop before worsening it.
idea: Circles over the slipping tool from a right tilt through leftward gaze to a left tilt, stops to inspect, makes one small test, then withdraws square.

prompt: Buried fastener search. You uncover a screw hidden under accumulated material before attempting removal.
idea: Searches low right and left for the buried fastener, tilts slightly right to inspect, makes two separated clearing dips, then centers on the exposed screw.

prompt: Misaligned hinge reset. You loosen an awkward hinge position before reseating it and checking the swing.
idea: Inspects the hinge in a left tilt, eases back and centers, probes forward into alignment, then follows its reopened swing right to left and settles.

prompt: Latch preloading. You push a door inward slightly so its stuck latch can release without force.
idea: Meets the stuck latch, presses forward to preload it, holds, lifts slightly against the release, then pops free backward and checks low with a slight left tilt.

prompt: Drawer racking correction. You stop pulling a skewed drawer and square it before drawing it out again.
idea: Pulls the drawer back into a skewed left tilt and rightward glance, stops and levels, compares left and right gaps, then centers for a controlled retry and relaxes.

prompt: Cabinet catch mismatch. You discover that the catch misses its receiver and inspect the two positions separately.
idea: Tests the cabinet's closed position, stops at the mismatch, compares low left and right tilts, then centers for a corrected approach and withdraws.

prompt: Sliding track obstruction. You find debris in a track after a smooth movement suddenly catches.
idea: Follows the slider right to left until it catches, dips centrally to inspect, probes the obstruction, then checks the cleared path right and left before settling.

prompt: Key almost turns. You feel a key begin to move but avoid forcing it when the lock binds.
idea: Turns the key partly left with a right tilt, freezes at the bind, eases back square, inspects a rightward angle, then makes a smaller test and withdraws.

prompt: Key seated shallowly. You realize a key is not fully inserted before trying to rotate it.
idea: Starts the shallow key turn left in a right tilt, stops to inspect, straightens and presses it fully in, then rotates right in a left tilt and releases.

prompt: Zip slider snag. You stop a zipper before it tears trapped fabric and gently free the caught fold.
idea: Follows the zipper upward, stops at trapped fabric, dips with a slight right tilt to inspect, lifts the fold free, then resets square for a smaller retry.

prompt: Zip teeth separated. You notice that a closing slider leaves the teeth open behind it.
idea: Tracks the zipper closure right to left, looks farther left behind its movement, freezes at the open teeth, then returns low center in a left tilt to inspect.

prompt: Cord knot tightened. You stop pulling after realizing that force only makes an accidental knot smaller.
idea: Pulls against the knot, stops as it tightens, releases the load, checks left and right tilts, then centers for a light probe and withdraws.

prompt: Cord loop isolated. You separate one trapped loop from a tangle before moving the rest.
idea: Scans the tangle low right and left, fixes one loop centrally, tilts right for clearance, lifts it a little, then checks the result with a slight left tilt.

prompt: Cable route reversed. You discover that a cable was threaded around the wrong side of an obstacle.
idea: Follows the mistaken cable route right to left, draws back toward the right obstacle, centers, then checks the corrected low path right and left before settling.

prompt: Cable strain relieved. You support a connector before removing tension from the cable attached to it.
idea: Braces close to the connector, looks along the taut cable, waits while supporting it, then releases the pull and tests the relaxed connection gently.

prompt: Connector latch found. You stop pulling a plug and locate the small release feature you overlooked.
idea: Pulls the plug back until resistance stops it, leans close in a small right tilt, tips left to locate the latch, presses briefly, then withdraws smoothly with a slight left lean.

prompt: Connector inverted. You identify an upside-down plug before applying more pressure.
idea: Probes the inverted connector, stops, inspects its shape in a right tilt, turns away right to flip it, then returns square for a gentle fit.

prompt: Snap-fit overpressure. You release force when a flexible catch bends without seating properly.
idea: Presses the bending snap catch downward, strains briefly, recoils upward before forcing it, then relaxes and checks a shallower approach in a slight left tilt.

prompt: Snap-fit partial seating. You hear one side engage and check the other before calling the assembly finished.
idea: Presses the snap-fit low, jolts slightly at one side's click, pauses, compares left and right seating, then makes one controlled final central dip and releases.

prompt: Seal folded inward. You discover a gasket pinched under an edge and reseat it before closing the lid.
idea: Inspects the pinched gasket low in a left tilt, lifts the edge, checks the rim right and left, then lowers carefully at center and verifies the seal.

prompt: Seal dry test. You check that a closure sits evenly before applying its final pressure.
idea: Scans the rim right and left, probes its dry fit lightly, compares farther left and right, then centers for final pressure with a slight left lean and holds.

prompt: Cap vacuum release. You stop twisting a resistant lid and first relieve the pressure holding it down.
idea: Coils the vacuum-held cap left in a right tilt, stops to inspect, centers and braces downward, then pops upward free and settles square.

prompt: Pressure bleed pause. You release a built-up force gradually rather than letting it escape in one burst.
idea: Braces compressed against the pressure, holds the load, eases upward slowly, pauses midway, then releases into a stable neutral pose.

prompt: Leaking joint located. You follow a faint sign of leakage back to the connection that needs attention.
idea: Searches low right and left along the leak, traces upward to the central joint, inspects close in a small right tilt, then gives a gentle confirming probe and relaxes.

prompt: Leak test repeated. You check a repaired connection after clearing the old visible residue.
idea: Inspects the repaired joint in a slight left lean, wipes residue right to left, resets centrally and waits, then returns close in a small right tilt to verify.

prompt: Air pocket purged. You notice trapped air interrupting a steady flow and wait for the flow to become continuous.
idea: Follows the air-interrupted flow in uneven low bobs, pauses to check below, waits through the purge, then tracks one smooth downward stream and lifts.

prompt: Tube kink released. You locate a sharp bend that is stopping movement through a flexible tube.
idea: Follows the tube right to left, stops at its bend in a left tilt, draws backward to straighten it, then centers to inspect the restored path and relaxes.

prompt: Tube routed too tightly. You add slack after noticing that a turn is pulling on both ends of a tube.
idea: Checks the tube ends left and right, braces the near end centrally, relaxes its tension, then inspects the wider route right to left and centers.

prompt: Pump loses prime. You stop an ineffective repeated motion and inspect the supply before trying again.
idea: Pumps twice without effect, stops, checks the supply on the left, waits, then centers and gives one measured retry with a slight left lean.

prompt: Pump handle rebound. You keep control of a handle that springs back instead of letting it strike freely.
idea: Presses the pump handle down, braces for its spring return, rises under control, pauses at the top, then settles without another jolt.

prompt: Valve overshoot corrected. You reverse a small excess adjustment and inspect the stabilized result.
idea: Turns the valve left with a right tilt beyond its mark, stops and reverses right in a left tilt, centers, then makes a tiny checking probe and relaxes.

prompt: Valve position uncertain. You inspect the indicator before making any further adjustment.
idea: Begins the valve turn left with a right tilt, freezes, peers close with a small right tilt, changes to a larger viewing angle, then centers after confirming the indicator.

prompt: Flexible lid warped. You compare opposite edges instead of pressing harder on the first raised corner.
idea: Compares the warped lid edges left and right, tips right over the raised corner, releases upward and centers, then tries a gentler closure with a slight left lean.

prompt: Vent obstruction found. You discover that a blocked opening is causing pressure to build elsewhere.
idea: Strain low against the blocked action with a trembling effort, stop, inspect high right and left for the vent, then check the relieved result below.

prompt: Suction attachment peels. You notice one edge lifting before the whole attachment releases.
idea: Inspects the peeling suction edge low in a left tilt, braces square, recoils up into a right lean as it releases, counters left, then catches a small right return and centers.

prompt: Suction attachment reseated. You flatten the edge before applying pressure again.
idea: Checks the suction rim right and left, centers it flat, presses carefully in a slight left lean, holds contact, then eases back to verify the seal.

prompt: Bellows blocked. You stop compressing when an outlet obstruction prevents the expected release.
idea: Compresses the blocked bellows, strains through a short pulse, stops, looks right at the outlet, then releases the compression without another push and centers.

prompt: Bellows refilling. You wait for a compressed chamber to regain its shape before pressing again.
idea: Presses the bellows low, waits for the refill, rises slowly to full height, then makes one new controlled compression with a slight left lean and releases.

prompt: Reservoir level checked. You inspect the supply before blaming a tool for an interrupted output.
idea: Stops the ineffective tool motion, looks down into the reservoir with a small right tilt, holds the level check, then raises square with a confirming nod.

prompt: Blade binds midcut. You stop feeding material and ease it back before reconsidering alignment.
idea: Feeds forward until the blade binds, stops the pressure, draws back gently, checks the cut in a left tilt, then resets square.

prompt: Blade wanders from line. You detect a drifting cut early enough to stop before crossing the intended boundary.
idea: Follows the cut low right to left, drifts into a right tilt and leftward glance, stops, checks the mark with a small right tilt, then realigns square.

prompt: Cut falls short. You inspect an incomplete separation before making a small final finishing action.
idea: Prepares and makes the main cut, pauses, inspects the remaining bridge with a slight left lean, then gives a smaller finishing dip and verifies the release.

prompt: Cut reaches through early. You stop your follow-through when the material separates sooner than expected.
idea: Draws back for the cut, releases downward and checks the unexpectedly early separation, braces upward against overshoot, then inspects the left and right pieces before centering.

prompt: Tear follows the wrong grain. You stop a tear that is veering away from the intended direction.
idea: Pulls the tear steadily, veers into a left tilt and rightward glance, freezes, relaxes the tension square, then checks the new edge right to left and rests in a slight left lean.

prompt: Fold line misplaced. You reopen a partial crease after noticing that its edges will not align.
idea: Begins the misplaced fold downward, stops, compares the left and right edges, pulls back to reopen it, then returns to the corrected center.

prompt: Fold springs open. You maintain controlled pressure on a crease that will not stay closed by itself.
idea: Presses the springy fold down, releases and follows its rise, then presses again with a slight left lean, holds the crease, and checks after easing off.

prompt: Thick stack shifts. You square a stack again after the middle layers slide during handling.
idea: Lowers onto the thick stack, catches its leftward slip with a right tilt, stops and levels, compares the left and right edges, then recenters to proceed.

prompt: Thin sheet doubles. You discover that you picked up two layers when only one was intended.
idea: Lifts the doubled sheet, pauses at its unexpected weight, inspects the edge close with a small right tilt, tips left to separate it, then lowers one layer carefully and relaxes.

prompt: Adhesive grabs early. You lift an edge before an incorrectly placed surface bonds fully.
idea: Approaches the adhesive carefully, stops at early contact, lifts the edge back, checks alignment in a small right tilt, then lowers the corrected placement square.

prompt: Adhesive will not catch. You stop pressing repeatedly and inspect the contact surface instead.
idea: Makes two small adhesive presses, waits without a bond, withdraws, then inspects close in a small right tilt and checks the preparation with a slight left lean.

prompt: Wet surface smear. You notice that an inspection touch has disturbed a finish that has not set yet.
idea: Touches the wet finish lightly, recoils at the smear, freezes, inspects from farther back in a slight left lean, then waits without another touch.

prompt: Finish still tacky. You test a hidden area and decide to leave the surface alone longer.
idea: The head approaches the finish, tests downward, releases at the sticky resistance, and waits farther back.

prompt: Sanding reveals layer. You stop when abrasion exposes a different underlying material.
idea: The head sands right to left, stops over the new layer, compares its tilted edges, and withdraws centrally.

prompt: Polishing haze checked. You change the viewing angle to distinguish a surface mark from reflected light.
idea: The head studies the haze, rocks between viewing angles, rises for comparison, and makes a short polishing pass.

prompt: Edge catches cloth. You stop wiping after a rough corner snags the cleaning material.
idea: The head wipes across, catches at the corner, tilts down to inspect, and lifts clear before checking again.

prompt: Brush sheds a bristle. You inspect and remove one stray piece before continuing the finish.
idea: The head follows a brush stroke, freezes over the bristle, dips for a tiny retrieval, and rechecks level.

prompt: Roller leaves ridge. You notice a raised line at the edge of a pass and inspect before overlapping it.
idea: The head rolls left to right, revisits the raised edge, tilts down, and tests an adjacent strip.

prompt: Surface coating runs. You follow a downward drip and avoid disturbing the stable area above it.
idea: The head follows a coating run downward, stops below it, checks the stable upper area, and returns to the drip.

prompt: Dust under film. You lift a partly placed layer after noticing a trapped speck.
idea: The head lowers the film, stops over dust, leans close, peels back, and scans the cleared surface.

prompt: Thread nests underneath. You stop a smooth stitching rhythm when the underside begins to tangle.
idea: The head stitches in repeated dips, halts at the tangle, looks underneath, and releases tension before a cautious retry.

prompt: Thread breaks midpass. You notice the motion continuing without a connected thread and stop to reestablish the path.
idea: The head follows the thread across, recoils at its break, clamps, checks both ends, and aligns close again.

prompt: Thread loop missed. You retry a precise capture after the first pass fails to engage the loop.
idea: The head probes beneath the loop, examines the miss, changes tilt, and makes a smaller capture test.

prompt: Needle catches seam. You stop at a thicker crossing and reposition instead of forcing a straight continuation.
idea: The head dips into the seam, freezes against it, inspects the ridge, and lifts to retry at a new angle.

prompt: Fabric stretched unevenly. You release the load after noticing one edge pulling farther than the other.
idea: The head compares fabric edges, leans into their uneven pull, releases, and squares them for a final check.

prompt: Fabric slips from clamp. You catch a shifting edge before resetting the hold.
idea: The head holds clamp pressure, catches the slipping fabric, braces lower, and centers for a renewed grip.

prompt: Elastic twisted inside. You inspect a loop that lies crooked because the band is twisted within it.
idea: The head traces the elastic loop, tilts through its twist, reverses the angle, and checks a flat return.

prompt: Tension adjustment too far. You undo a small excess change rather than swinging to the opposite extreme.
idea: Test the excess tension with a strained pulse, stop, ease only a little, then probe the corrected balance and settle.

prompt: Loose end reappears. You discover an unsecured end after thinking the fastening was complete.
idea: The head verifies the fastening, begins settling, spots the loose end with a recoil, and dips to secure it.

prompt: Knot cinches asymmetrically. You notice one side tightening before the other and rebalance the pull.
idea: The head pulls back against an uneven knot, compares both sides, and centers for a balanced retest.

prompt: Lacing skipped eyelet. You trace the route and find the missing intermediate point before tightening.
idea: The head traces low lacing, stops at a skipped eyelet, compares neighboring sides, and dips into the gap.

prompt: Loop catches projection. You stop drawing a flexible loop after it snags on an unexpected corner.
idea: The head draws the loop taut, stops at its snag, inspects sideways, lifts over the projection, and resumes gently.

prompt: Strap fed backward. You undo an incorrect feed through a buckle before tightening anything.
idea: The head checks the strap route, pulls then stops, backs the feed out, turns right, and inspects its corrected path.

prompt: Buckle only half engages. You wait for a complete seating instead of trusting a single partial click.
idea: The head presses the buckle, recoils from partial engagement, freezes, checks each side, and finishes with one centered press.

prompt: Velcro edge lifting. You smooth from the lifted corner while avoiding pulling the rest loose.
idea: The head scans the lifted fastening edge, tilts toward it, braces, and smooths only the loose corner before checking.

prompt: Hook misses loop. You watch a fastener slide past its receiver and reset the approach angle.
idea: The head probes toward the hook, follows its miss rightward, stops, and resets for a slower square approach.

prompt: Spring clip overshoots. You control the return when a small clip snaps farther open than expected.
idea: The head compresses the clip, springs upward, catches the overshoot in a diminishing wobble, and inspects the opening.

prompt: Spring clip regripped. You release a poor grip before compressing a stiff clip a second time.
idea: Strain on the stiff clip with a fine tremble, release fully and inspect the grip, then regather and compress steadily.

prompt: Flexible tab whitens. You notice a stressed tab before it breaks and stop bending it farther.
idea: The head leans into the tab, freezes at its stress mark, examines close, and eases the load before returning cautiously.

prompt: Cord recoil contained. You guide a retracting line instead of letting its loose end whip back.
idea: The head follows the extended cord, braces against its pull, guides a gradual return, and checks the contained end.

prompt: Intermittent switch contact. You distinguish a brief connection from a reliably held activation.
idea: The head presses the switch, waits, lifts at the dropout, resets, and sustains a second test while watching closely.

prompt: Loose contact isolated. You hold one connection still while testing whether movement elsewhere causes the fault.
idea: The head steadies the near connection, briefly freezes, looks right, tests a small movement, and verifies the result.

prompt: Misleading indicator. You verify the physical result instead of trusting a light that suggests completion.
idea: The head checks the high indicator, nods provisionally, then looks down and stops to inspect the actual mechanism.

prompt: Reset held long enough. You maintain a deliberate control press through the entire reset interval before releasing.
idea: The head lowers onto reset, maintains the full quiet press, then lifts and watches for the restart.

prompt: Reset canceled by release. You realize that lifting too soon prevented a restart and repeat the hold properly.
idea: The head presses briefly, lifts too soon, studies the failed reset, and repeats with a complete held press.

prompt: Wrong control identified. You stop repeating an ineffective action after noticing that you selected the neighboring control.
idea: The head tests the wrong control, waits, tilts at the mismatch, then looks right and deliberately presses its neighbor.

prompt: Control blocked by cover. You discover that a protective flap must be moved before the control can be reached.
idea: The head approaches the blocked control, stops to inspect the flap, looks above it, and returns to an accessible press.

prompt: Safety interlock understood. You stop forcing a mechanism when another part is visibly out of its required position.
idea: Strain against the interlock in a short loaded tremble, stop firmly, then look left at the displaced part and center to wait.

prompt: Temporary fix checked. You verify that a repair survives a small deliberate disturbance.
idea: The head inspects the repair, nods, applies a gentle sideways disturbance, and rechecks before relaxing.

prompt: Repair fails under load. A connection that looked secure comes loose when you apply realistic pressure.
idea: The head checks a repair lightly, bears down, recoils as it releases, braces, and inspects the failed joint.

prompt: Repair passes unloaded. You recognize that a successful free movement does not yet prove the loaded task will work.
idea: The head makes an easy free test, nods cautiously, then gathers weight and sustains a more demanding check.

prompt: Fault follows the part. You compare two positions and find that the same component carries the problem with it.
idea: The head tests a part on the left, repeats the test on the right, and returns to inspect the component itself.

prompt: Fault stays at the position. You discover that changing the component does not move the problem.
idea: The head compares both components, returns to the original position, pauses, and confirms the persistent local fault.

prompt: Heat pause during repair. You stop repeated effort long enough for an overworked part to settle.
idea: The head stops repeated repair effort, draws back to cool, waits quietly, and returns for a small test.

prompt: Noise locates friction. You follow an irregular sound while moving a mechanism slowly to find where it catches.
idea: The head listens, sweeps slowly from right to left, stops at the friction noise, and dips to confirm its source.

prompt: Vibration confirms seating. You feel a component stop rattling after it reaches its proper position.
idea: The head feels a small rattle, presses the component home, waits for quiet, and returns to balance after checking.

prompt: Alignment mark restored. You stop adjusting when two visual references finally coincide.
idea: The head compares left and right marks, makes a centered adjustment, freezes at coincidence, and verifies close.

prompt: Witness mark moved. You notice that a reference line has shifted after a supposedly stable operation.
idea: The head checks the witness mark, performs a small working test, stops at its displacement, and tilts to inspect.

prompt: Last check catches omission. You discover one unfastened point during the final inspection rather than after release.
idea: The head scans the finished work, fixes on the omitted fastening, secures it with a small dip, and verifies again.

prompt: Return to service test. You try the complete normal sequence after a repair instead of testing only the repaired fragment.
idea: The head inspects the repair, prepares backward, releases forward, follows the working result, and finishes with a measured nod.

prompt: Stack center shifted. You pause a growing stack after noticing that its upper weight no longer sits over the base.
idea: The head looks up the stack, leans with its offset, stops, checks the base, and restores a balanced center.

prompt: Stack top removed first. You reduce an unstable load from above before attempting to move the whole assembly.
idea: The head inspects the stack top, braces beneath it, follows one controlled lowering step, and checks the improved balance.

prompt: Bottom piece trapped. You discover that the item you want cannot be removed without supporting the weight above it.
idea: The head examines the trapped bottom piece, begins pulling, stops, checks above, and waits in a supporting brace.

prompt: Tray starts tipping. You counter an uneven shift before the contents slide off an imaginary tray.
idea: The head balances the tray, follows its sudden tip, counters through a shrinking wobble, and crouches before leveling.

prompt: Liquid carried too quickly. You slow and pause after noticing the imaginary contents slosh toward an edge.
idea: The head follows the liquid's sway, stops level, lets the slosh subside, and resumes with a small controlled advance.

prompt: Weight redistributed. You compare both sides of a load before changing where you support it.
idea: Compare both sides of the load, tremble under its imbalance, then ease the pressure and find centered support.

prompt: Long object clears corner. You rotate a long item through a turn only after checking both ends.
idea: The head checks both ends, coils left for clearance, turns through to the right, and looks back left at the trailing end.

prompt: Long object tail catches. You stop moving when the far end of an imagined object hits something behind you.
idea: The head starts a leftward turn, stops at the tail's catch, looks farther behind, and carefully reverses to square.

prompt: Shared object rotated. You coordinate a gradual turn while keeping an imaginary object supported between two people.
idea: The head checks its partner left, braces, slowly coils into the shared turn, waits for coordination, and centers under support.

prompt: Object lowered onto blocks. You place a load in stages and check both supports before releasing it.
idea: The head looks down, lowers the load gradually, braces at contact, checks both blocks, and releases into center.

prompt: Soft package squashes. You stop compressing a parcel when its shape changes more than expected.
idea: The head compresses the soft parcel, stops at its collapse, withdraws, and compares the distorted sides.

prompt: Rigid package barely fits. You compare the available opening before committing to a final insertion.
idea: The head studies the opening, compares its sides, probes the rigid parcel forward, and holds at the fit limit.

prompt: Package orientation changed. You rotate an awkward parcel after a straight approach fails.
idea: The head stops a straight insertion, scans the parcel corners, rotates right, and returns for a smaller aligned probe.

prompt: Loose contents heard. You pause handling when an unexpected rattle suggests something inside is moving freely.
idea: The head gently sways the package, perks at an inner rattle, freezes, listens, and inspects without shaking again.

prompt: Fragile center unsupported. You notice that a broad object needs support in the middle rather than only at its edges.
idea: The head checks both outer edges, looks beneath the fragile middle, braces centrally, and verifies support.

prompt: Rolling load restrained. You stop a rounded object from moving while preparing a safer resting position.
idea: The head tracks the low rolling load, braces it still, checks a rightward destination, and releases into a controlled rest.

prompt: Round object placed in cradle. You align an object with a curved support before letting go.
idea: The head examines the cradle, tilts along its curve, lowers carefully, braces at contact, and checks stability before easing.

prompt: Nested objects separated. You identify where two closely fitted items are holding each other before pulling them apart.
idea: The head studies the nested seam, tilts and tests it, pulls backward under tension, then catches the sudden separation.

prompt: Nested objects reseated. You align two shapes before allowing one to settle fully inside the other.
idea: The head compares both rims, centers, lowers halfway, waits, and completes a controlled nesting descent.

prompt: Loaded container opened. You brace for the contents before releasing an opening that may shift the balance.
idea: The head checks the opening, braces low, releases the catch, absorbs the shifted contents with a wobble, and steadies.

prompt: Packing order conflict. You discover that a large item blocks the space needed for a smaller one.
idea: The head inspects the packed space, looks right to the waiting item, stops, withdraws the blocking piece, and rescans the gap.

prompt: Protective layer forgotten. You reopen a nearly finished package to add the missing separating layer.
idea: The head begins closing, freezes at the missing layer, lifts open, scans inside, and lowers again after checking.

prompt: Corner pad slipped. You notice a protective corner piece move out of position during wrapping.
idea: The head follows the wrap, recoils at the slipped pad, stops, examines the corner, and makes a careful local correction.

prompt: Wrapping tension uneven. You ease one side of a wrap before tightening the opposite side.
idea: The head compares wrap tension on both sides, leans toward the tight side, releases, and draws evenly into center.

prompt: Final flap blocked. You realize an earlier fold lies in the path of the last flap.
idea: The head lowers the final flap, stops at the overlap, inspects, lifts back, and reorders the folds before checking closure.

prompt: Tab inside instead of outside. You reopen a fold to recover a tab needed for the next stage.
idea: The head checks the closed edge, stops at the hidden tab, opens back, scans low, and dips to retrieve it.

prompt: Box diagonal tested. You check whether an awkward item fits along a diagonal rather than forcing it straight in.
idea: The head checks the straight opening, tilts across its diagonal, pauses, tests the angled fit, and withdraws.

prompt: Contents counted after packing. You reopen just enough to verify the items without disturbing the arrangement.
idea: The head opens the package slightly, scans the contents, marks two small counting beats, and closes carefully.

prompt: Label hidden by strap. You notice that the securing route would cover information needed later.
idea: The head checks the label, follows the strap across it, stops at the crossing, and considers a rightward route.

prompt: Label spans a seam. You reposition an identification label so opening the package will not tear it apart.
idea: The head examines the seam, compares neighboring faces, lifts back, and selects a centered flat surface.

prompt: Orientation mark checked. You verify which end must remain upward before moving a closed container.
idea: The head scans the orientation marks, compares the upper and lower ends, levels for carrying, and nods once.

prompt: Unpacking preserves order. You keep track of layers so the contents can be reassembled afterward.
idea: The head inspects the upper layer, follows it down, pauses at the next layer, and returns to the original reference.

prompt: Part set aside visibly. You place a removed small part where it will remain in view during the next action.
idea: The head examines the removed part, turns right to a clear spot, places it down, and checks back toward the work.

prompt: Small part nearly lost. You stop a task immediately when a tiny piece drops from the working area.
idea: The head startles upward, follows the falling piece down, freezes, scans the floor, and fixes on its location.

prompt: Part rolls under edge. You follow a small component until it disappears beneath an obstruction.
idea: The head follows the part rolling low, stops at the edge, sinks to peek underneath, and waits before reaching farther.

prompt: Matching parts compared. You inspect two almost identical pieces before choosing one for the next connection.
idea: The head compares both small parts, tilts at their difference, checks the central target, and tests a tentative fit.

prompt: Wrong-sized part removed. You notice a poor fit early and withdraw instead of forcing the assembly.
idea: The head probes into a poor fit, stops, examines the mismatch, withdraws cleanly, and resumes a searching scan.

prompt: Assembly stage reversed. You undo one completed stage because a hidden piece should have been installed first.
idea: The head checks the completed stage, freezes at the omission, reverses it, scans inside, and resets centrally.

prompt: Alignment maintained during reach. You hold the current position while shifting attention to the next needed part.
idea: The head establishes a firm brace, looks right without releasing, waits for the part, and returns to verify alignment.

prompt: Workspace cleared before release. You inspect the destination before letting a completed item move into it.
idea: The head checks the completed item, scans the receiving space, pauses, lowers into it, and verifies a stable rest.

prompt: Focus confirmed at depth. You compare a front edge and rear detail before choosing the intended focal plane.
idea: The head compares a close edge with a distant detail, tilts to judge depth, then returns to hold the selected plane.

prompt: Focus ring overshot. You pass the clearest view and deliberately reverse only a small amount.
idea: The head inspects close, leans through the focus adjustment, stops at blur, and backs off slightly to verify clarity.

prompt: Viewfinder blocked. You move a small obstruction out of the viewing path before judging the scene.
idea: The head approaches the viewfinder, stops at an obstruction, checks left, lifts away, and reenters for a clear look.

prompt: Eyepiece spacing adjusted. You compare two imperfect views before finding a comfortable centered alignment.
idea: The head compares alternate eyepiece angles, pauses, centers carefully, and holds a close comfortable alignment.

prompt: Tripod leg settles. You wait for a support to stop sinking before making a precise visual judgment.
idea: The head looks down as the tripod sinks, follows its settling, braces patiently, and levels the gaze for verification.

prompt: Tripod clamp slips. You catch a slowly tilting view after believing the support was locked.
idea: The head holds a level view, follows an unexpected clamp tilt, stops, checks below, and resets into a renewed hold.

prompt: Horizon level checked. You compare the visual horizon with the instrument's own reference before adjusting.
idea: The head scans the horizon, tilts to compare it, checks the instrument below, and returns level for confirmation.

prompt: Lens cap forgotten. You investigate a dark view and discover a simple physical obstruction.
idea: The head peers into darkness, waits, draws back to inspect the lens front, and returns to an open distant view.

prompt: Filter thread starts crooked. You back a filter away before trying to seat it squarely on a lens.
idea: The head approaches the filter thread, stops crooked, tilts to inspect, backs off, centers, and retries with a tiny advance.

prompt: Filter changes reflection. You slowly rotate a viewing aid while comparing the changing glare.
idea: The head inspects glare, slowly coils left with the filter, compares the change, turns back, and studies the revealed detail.

prompt: Light stand shadow noticed. You realize the support itself is casting a shadow into the intended view.
idea: The head checks the raised light, follows its shadow downward, turns right to assess the stand, and rechecks the central scene.

prompt: Reflector angle found. You make gradual orientation changes until reflected light reaches the desired spot.
idea: The head compares light source and target, tilts one way, checks the result, then reverses gently and holds the reflector angle.

prompt: Light spill controlled. You inspect an unwanted bright patch before narrowing the direction of illumination.
idea: The head scans high, fixes on stray light, checks the intended patch, and tilts to correct it.

prompt: Backdrop crease revealed. A change in lighting makes a previously invisible fold stand out.
idea: The head scans the scene, looks toward the light, freezes at the crease, and lowers for inspection.

prompt: Parallax measurement corrected. You move directly over a mark after realizing that an angled view shifted its apparent position.
idea: Compare the mark through left-right tilted views, center directly above it, then verify its true position without the viewing offset.

prompt: Scale zero checked. You inspect the resting reference before placing anything into the measurement.
idea: The head checks the scale baseline, stops, makes an empty test, returns, and nods confirmation.

prompt: Reading oscillates. You wait for a changing indicator to stabilize rather than taking the first visible value.
idea: The head follows the wavering indicator, stills itself, waits, and leans close to acknowledge the settled reading.

prompt: Reading viewed twice. You look away briefly and reread a difficult mark to avoid trusting a fleeting impression.
idea: The head inspects a mark, looks right, returns to reread it, and confirms with a measured nod.

prompt: Measuring end misidentified. You notice that you began at the physical edge instead of the printed reference mark.
idea: The head checks the wrong endpoint, freezes, scans inward to the reference, and restarts toward the opposite end.

prompt: Measurement exceeds range. You stop trying to force a reading past the available scale.
idea: The head follows the indicator upward, stops at its limit, draws back, and studies the range marks.

prompt: Prop enters late. You keep a clear holding pose until an expected stage object arrives.
idea: The head readies the presentation, freezes at the missed cue, looks left and waits, then dips toward center.

prompt: Prop enters early. You suspend your current motion so an unexpectedly arriving object can pass safely.
idea: The head begins a sweep, recoils at the early prop, stops, ducks beneath it, and rises centrally.

prompt: Prop handle reversed. You discreetly reorient a prop before performing the action it supports.
idea: The head examines the reversed handle, tilts, turns right to fix it, then prepares back and releases forward.

prompt: Prop catches costume. You stop a flourish to free a snag without pulling harder.
idea: The head coils left into a flourish, stops at the snag, looks down, relaxes the pull, and tests its freedom.

prompt: Prop drops out of view. You freeze the scene long enough to locate a fallen item before continuing.
idea: The head recoils, follows the fallen prop downward, freezes to scan the floor, then rises with acknowledgment.

prompt: False prop weight. You act as though a light object is heavy by delaying and straining through the lift.
idea: Inspect low and crouch beneath the supposedly heavy prop, tremble under its imagined weight, then rise slowly and settle after a high pause.

prompt: Hidden prop switch. You turn attention away briefly while changing which imagined object you present.
idea: The head presents the first item, turns right and freezes, then centers for a distinctly raised second presentation.

prompt: Reveal held for audience. You delay recovery so the audience has time to register a visual surprise.
idea: The head draws back, springs into the reveal, holds it motionless for the audience, then lowers slowly.

prompt: Reveal spoiled early. You stop the planned buildup after realizing the audience can already see the surprise.
idea: The head begins rising, freezes at the exposed reveal, checks the audience left, then examines the object and settles.

prompt: Invisible wall corner. You establish two perpendicular imaginary surfaces before turning around their edge.
idea: The head tests a front wall, stops, turns right to probe a second plane, then coils left around the corner and centers.

prompt: Invisible shrinking box. You adjust to imagined boundaries that become progressively closer.
idea: The head tests both narrowing sides, looks above, ducks beneath the shrinking ceiling, and holds compact.

prompt: Invisible rising floor. You respond to an imagined surface pushing upward beneath you.
idea: The head braces low against a rising floor, extends gradually upward, stretches, and freezes at the new height.

prompt: Invisible lowering ceiling. You progressively reduce height while checking an imagined obstruction above you.
idea: The head looks overhead, lowers cautiously, checks upward again, and ducks farther into a compressed rest.

prompt: Invisible heavy curtain. You push through a resisting hanging barrier and recover after it gives way.
idea: The head draws back from the curtain, presses into it, strains through, wobbles after release, and regains center.

prompt: Invisible sticky glove. You mime one side remaining attached while the rest of you tries to withdraw.
idea: Withdraw while the invisible glove stays caught on one side, tremble in the stuck lean, stop, then tilt opposite to work free.

prompt: Invisible magnetic pull. You try to leave but an imagined attraction repeatedly draws your attention back.
idea: The head turns right to leave, repeatedly yields to the magnetic pull, braces centrally, then withdraws slowly.

prompt: Invisible balance beam. You check an imagined narrow support before making a careful crossing motion.
idea: The head checks the beam below, levels, leans left, corrects a wobble, and holds a stable forward gaze.

prompt: Invisible door rebound. You mime a resistant door springing back after an attempted opening.
idea: The head pulls the resistant door backward, pauses under load, recoils forward with its return, and braces to inspect.

prompt: Invisible rope slack. You pull repeatedly until the imagined line finally becomes taut.
idea: The head takes up rope slack with two backward pulls, pauses at tension, then strains and holds without pulling again.

prompt: Invisible rope breaks. You lose the resistance during a full imaginary pull and must catch your balance.
idea: The head crouches to pull, leans back under load, pops free, absorbs a wobble, and returns to center.

prompt: Inlay dry placement. You compare a small insert with its opening before applying final pressure.
idea: The head inspects the inlay, checks both edges, probes lightly, lifts to compare, and seats it gently.

prompt: Inlay proud edge. You find that one edge remains raised even though the rest appears seated.
idea: The head looks low, tilts toward the proud inlay corner, stops pressure, and compares the fit from alternate angles.

prompt: Mosaic spacing corrected. You move one piece after comparing the gaps on both sides.
idea: The head compares mosaic gaps, pauses, nudges one piece, and rereads both boundaries.

prompt: Tile corner rocking. You identify an unstable corner by pressing opposite edges in turn.
idea: The head presses opposite tile edges in turn, follows the rocking response, and freezes when the loose corner is clear.

prompt: Clay wall thinned. You stop shaping when one area becomes noticeably less supported than the rest.
idea: The head follows the clay contour, sinks at its weak wall, stops, inspects closely, and releases pressure.

prompt: Clay opening recenters. You compare the rim from both sides before bringing an off-center opening back into alignment.
idea: The head compares the clay rim, circles its opening, stops centrally, and probes straight down.

prompt: Paper hinge flexed. You test a fold gently before asking it to carry a larger motion.
idea: The head flexes the paper hinge lightly, pauses, repeats a fuller dip, and inspects before settling.

prompt: Book joint stiffness. You stop opening a repaired cover when the hinge resists too strongly.
idea: The head opens the cover leftward, stops at stiff resistance, inspects the joint, and returns through a reduced arc.

prompt: Threaded bead obstruction. You identify why a bead will not slide past a thick point in the thread.
idea: The head follows the thread to its obstruction, examines close, tilts, withdraws, and makes a gentle retest.

prompt: Wire loop closes unevenly. You inspect the gap from two angles before making a small final adjustment.
idea: The head compares both wire-loop angles, centers at the gap, adjusts carefully, freezes, and verifies closure.

prompt: Wire work hardens. You stop repeatedly bending the same spot after it becomes resistant.
idea: Bend the wire sideways and return, try the opposite bend with a strained tremble, then release and inspect instead of forcing it.

prompt: Carved detail protected. You change approach to avoid striking a finished neighboring feature.
idea: The head examines the carved detail, checks the right neighbor, tilts away, and makes one restrained downward probe.

prompt: Print registration checked. You compare a new impression with reference marks before repeating the process.
idea: The head compares registration marks, studies the impression, waits for alignment, and nods confirmation.

prompt: Print pressure uneven. You inspect a weak edge before changing how the next contact is applied.
idea: The head presses, checks the weak print edge, tilts toward it, levels, and makes a more centered second contact.

prompt: Engraved line revisited. You return to a short unfinished segment without retracing the completed sections.
idea: The head scans the engraved line, isolates the gap, dips locally, and backs off to survey the whole line.

prompt: Paint edge lifted. You remove a masking edge carefully while watching whether the finish follows it.
idea: The head tracks the masking edge, peels back slowly, pauses to inspect, then continues gently and checks the exposed boundary.

prompt: Brush point reshaped. You pause to restore a tool's fine tip before returning to a small detail.
idea: The head pauses above the detail, lifts to inspect the brush tip, centers, and returns for a tiny precise touch.

prompt: Stitch length compared. You check the spacing of recent marks before making the next one.
idea: The head scans low stitch spacing, pauses over adjacent marks, nods twice in comparison, and makes the next dip.

prompt: Loose weave repaired. You identify one missing crossing and restore it without disturbing nearby rows.
idea: The head scans the weave, freezes at the missing crossing, tilts for access, repairs it with a dip, and checks the row.

prompt: Finished surface protected. You move your final inspection away from direct contact with delicate completed work.
idea: The head approaches the finished surface, stops short, leans for an oblique view, withdraws to inspect, and settles.

prompt: Serve toss abandoned. You let an awkward ball toss fall instead of forcing the planned serve.
idea: The head follows the toss up, coils backward, cancels the strike, watches the ball fall, and resets.

prompt: Serve toss retried. You inspect a poor toss, reset, and prepare a second one before striking.
idea: The head follows a poor toss up and down, resets, tracks a new rise, and snaps forward-down before recovering.

prompt: Swing checked late. You arrest an intended swing after deciding the target is unsuitable.
idea: The head coils left into a swing, freezes, unwinds stored tension, and returns to a balanced stance.

prompt: Swing follow-through blocked. You stop when an unexpected obstruction prevents completing the arc.
idea: The head coils left, swings right, halts at the obstruction, checks that side, and eases through center.
